There was another kami at this shrine, the kami said, one that appeared only to those about to form a good bond. It never showed itself to anyone with a bond about to be severed. That kami came right up to Hoshiguma's feet, but she never once saw it.

Around then, the Diet member approved separating the Kinseki Group from the Kinsekikai, and Mifune set his inauguration as chairman for the following night, timed to the fireworks festival. If Tessai would not give up his seat, Mifune needed Hannya, regarded as the token of succession. That was why he had forged the letter to lure Hoshiguma back.
Meanwhile, the yakuza and reporters who descended on the shrine lost all their hidden cameras and bugs to the foxfire raised by the kannushi, and the two slipped away by a side path.
6. What Lay Under the Ghost Stories

Some time later, gathered again at the stall, the kami took apart the kaidan Moriuchi had collected, one by one. The 'nonexistent sixteenth floor' was a button hidden behind a steel plate, and the maneki-neko ornament that vanished and reappeared was a device that sent a signal somewhere when pressed.

blocks.cap: The back-alley oden stall, where the ghost stories were peeled away one by one.

blocks.x: When Momoka mentioned that the Kinsekikai had a 'tekkaba' in that building, Hoshiguma explained that it was slang for a gambling den. The missing people who had supposedly strayed into 'hell' had most likely been silenced.

With trembling hands, Momoka took out the broken blade. It belonged to the Sanoguchi family, the haunted house's second victims. If that blade, which should have been in the evidence room, had been left half in the haunted house, then Sanoguchi might not have taken his own life. He might have been killed by Kinbee.

Momoka froze. The kaidan that had frightened her, and the entertainment career she had built on them, might all have been bait to hide the Kinsekikai. She turned to Moriuchi, but the man who had chased ghost stories all his life looked away.

Then the ninja struck. A flash drive charged with high-voltage current took down Moriuchi, then Momoka, who had leapt in to shield Hoshiguma. Moriuchi was snagged by a hook and dragged off between the buildings.
7. The Things Lined Up by the Window

After the ninja withdrew, they went to hide at Momoka's home and found it in shambles. Someone had cut off the top of the stem of 'Hasuke,' the little sapling by the window, and Momoka was furious enough to give off killing intent.

Then she introduced the things lined up by the window, one by one. The empty tower of a cloudbeast she had given away, the berry that died in a gale, the potted plant that drowned in a leak, the electronic pet that had been broken from the start. Hasuke was a sapling she had picked up beside a trash can after losing all of them.
In the last sports bag were two memorial tablets inscribed with the names 'Kazuhiko Shino' and 'Kumiko Shino.'

blocks.cap: Gokawa, Momoka's hometown. People drank water tainted with factory waste without knowing it.

blocks.x: In Gokawa, a nomadic city on the southern border, wastewater from a chemical plant had contaminated the water circulation system. Her father died when she was five or six, and her mother passed away shortly after Momoka, half-forcibly taken in by an agency, made her debut.

To hide her origins, the agency would not even let her attend the funeral, and her relatives cut ties with her. Her real name was **Haruka Shino**, but now, she said, she could only live as Momoka Hanyuu.
While packing, Momoka, her face still streaked with tears, asked whether Hoshiguma would go see the fireworks festival with her tomorrow. Hoshiguma did not know how to comfort her.
8. An Answer About That Night

Meanwhile, in Kajimachi, Tessai rescued Kichisei from the ninja. After hiding Momoka at his residence and hearing the truth behind the kaidan, the old man asked a question in return. If she suspected that Shimasu and Sanoguchi had died at Kinbee's hands, what proof was there that she was the one who killed the Diet candidate twenty years ago?

On that night twenty years earlier, Hoshiguma had gone out to stop Kinbee, accidentally killed her friend Shuuji, and lost her reason, cutting and cutting again. When she came to her senses, the Diet candidate was already dead.
She remembered nothing in between. Yet the reason she had always answered that she was the killer lay with her father.
Long ago, on the day a gang called the 'Wandering Vicious Oni' attacked Kajimachi, her father was seized by madness, killed Tessai's first son, and even turned his blade on his young daughter.

blocks.cap: Kajimachi at dusk. Young Hoshiguma's memory stops at the tip of her father's blade.

blocks.x: All I know is that back then... I was just like my father.

The old man hurled a shogi piece to the floor and shouted. Hannya was a shield he had made in the hope that she would not follow her father's path. The so-called secret to holding the madness down simply meant shaping the grip herself until it fit her hand. It meant disciplining herself.

The old man told her that if she had been doing well in Lungmen, she should stay out of this and leave. Hoshiguma met his eyes for the first time, answered that she had been doing well, and said she would stand with him all the same.

The old man kept Hannya but returned the bandage that had been wrapped around its grip, and handed her the sword she had carried that night twenty years ago. The bandage was a gift from her friends in Lungmen.
9. A Two-Hundred-Million Television

Hoshiguma went straight to Mifune's office and broke out Moriuchi, who was being held there. Mifune left her to Mio and departed. Facing Hoshiguma, who would not draw her sword, Mio muttered that she was the despicable one.
Meanwhile, Tetsuya, searching the haunted house, found dozens of Northern Court munitions crates in a tunnel leading under the city, and a ninja who had followed him photographed it all.

Then Mifune appeared at Tessai's residence. Long ago, the Kinsekikai had smuggled in those very weapons, and Tetsuya's mother had been driven out because of them. Now a single photo would be enough to brand the son a spy. The old man handed over Hannya and, on the promise that Momoka and Kichisei would be spared, got into Mifune's car.

At that hour Tetsuya was in the Kinsekikai office with Mio, watching all of it on TV. At the auction house where the car stopped, the item on the block was the first TV the Kinseki Group ever made, the very set the old man had once carried around in his arms trying to sell.

Tessai raised his bidding paddle and pushed the price to two hundred million. It was money he would borrow from Mifune with the Kajimachi land deeds as collateral; once he set his seal, the photos would be locked away forever. In front of the screen Tetsuya screamed at him not to sign, but the old man pressed his palm, smeared with red seal ink, onto the contract.

Then Mifune told him that his son had been watching everything from the start. The old man's iron fan split the contract in two, and from beyond the black screen of the camera that had fallen to the floor came the sound of a blade running through a body.

blocks.cap: "Don't die like this..." Tetsuya broke down before a screen that carried only sound.

blocks.x: Mio released Tetsuya, telling him to leave before she changed her mind and never come back.
10. The Signal That the Fireworks Festival Is Starting

At dusk, Hoshiguma returned to the residence and found Tessai run through by Mifune's blade. The old man stopped her from calling a doctor and said he had protected neither Kajimachi nor Hannya. Hoshiguma helped him up, and they sat side by side as in the old days.
From beyond the wall came the approaching rumble of caterpillar treads. Asked what that sound was, Hoshiguma answered after a long while.

blocks.cap: "It's the signal... that the fireworks festival is starting."

blocks.x: Kajimachi is lively again after so long, the old man said with a faint smile. As construction vehicles knocked down the wall and pachinko balls spilled and scattered, his wrinkled hand slowly dropped to the ground.
The police soon burst in and named Hoshiguma as the suspect. Beside them stood Mifune's men and ninja.

Swinging her sword still in its scabbard, Hoshiguma broke through the cordon, then sat in a back alley and poured a glass of strong liquor as Tessai's share. Short of drawing her sword and becoming a real kaidan, every road seemed like the wrong one.

Then Detective Koretou came to find her, alone. He said he had come to send her back to Lungmen, and punched her in the face. The Diet candidate who died twenty years ago had been his uncle, and because she had forced the blame onto herself, the truth about his uncle had stayed buried for so long.

Just as she began to lean toward going back, Momoka's voice burst from an old TV in the alley. She cried that she and Kichisei were locked up in Kinbee's hideout, and then the signal crackled and cut out.

Detective Koretou had been ready to look the other way on those two. Hoshiguma returned his punch and wrapped her sword hilt with the bandage Tessai had given back. As long as this bandage was in her hand, she said, she would never become a demon mad for slaughter.
Police? Yakuza? None of that matters. I promised Momoka, that's all.
Detective Koretou asked her to put a gash in that man for him. As long as no one was killed, he would hold off the pressure from above.

At the same moment, on a rooftop, Moriuchi came face to face with the kami he had searched for so long. The kami said it merely appeared where happiness was and gave nothing. Now that Tessai was dead, if Moriuchi took Kinbee's place, he would gain a fortune, which was to say happiness.

blocks.cap: A rooftop at sunset. The maneki-neko keychain that had been with him for years.

blocks.x: Moriuchi took off the keychain and let it go into the air. What he needed was a true friend, he said, and he set off to find Hoshiguma.
11. The Kaidan Celebrity's Last Broadcast

Meanwhile, a girl named **Sarasa** appeared before the captive Momoka. She was a hacker working undercover as a Kinseki Channel employee, and it was she who had piped the secret conversation onto Momoka's TV that night. Momoka turned down her offer to run away together and decided to hijack the live broadcast of the inauguration to expose Mifune.

On the night of the fireworks festival, at the top of the TV station, Mifune gazed at Hannya, now in his hands. He himself was the root of the ghost stories. After cutting down Shimasu, who had been blackmailing him over the Diet candidate, he put the haunted-house story on the air to cover up the death, and with the money the ghost stories brought in, he bought the Diet member and tied the police's hands.
Then every screen in the city flashed an alert announcing an all-out attack by the Northern Court's army. It was a fake alert that Sarasa had broadcast by hacking the station's lines.

blocks.cap: "This is not a drill." On the night of the festival, the city was bathed in red alerts.

blocks.x: Once a correction aired, people quickly calmed down and cheerfully traded the word 'kaidan.'

Following Sarasa's plan, Hoshiguma entered the station and was surrounded by the clan's men. She told them she did not want to fight people who had once been her family, but when they still would not let her pass, she drew her sword. No one was mortally wounded, but no one got back up either.
Meanwhile, Momoka and the others slipped onto the inauguration stage through a ventilation duct, only to find Mio there, waiting for Hoshiguma.
As they crossed blades, Mio said she had been a ragged orphan. Tessai died trying to make a family out of trash like them, she said, and Mifune survived because he knew he had no right to one.
Then Moriuchi threw Hannya, which he had stolen from Mifune's room. When Hoshiguma caught it, blue flames rose from her body.

blocks.cap: Hoshiguma reclaims Hannya. The fire of her rage blazed, but she did not lose control.

blocks.x: A single clash decided it. Mio sheathed her sword. She could not hold her head high before Momoka, she said, so she asked Hoshiguma to treat the girl well. She had the Kinsekikai to put in order now.

Then Momoka stepped into the spotlight. Every kaidan she had experienced had been staged, she revealed; the deaths in the haunted house were murders, and behind them was Kouhei Mifune. Even if she had not known, she too was an accomplice who had deceived the viewers, she said, and bowed her head.
Then she spoke of the fear in her hometown of Gokawa. Not an oni roaming the streets at night, but family members suddenly bedridden one day, and bodies collapsing for no reason.
Isn't being afraid of kaidan a kind of... happiness?

blocks.cap: Momoka stood on every screen in the city.

blocks.x: Momoka announced that she was quitting as a kaidan celebrity and cutting ties with her agency. Still, as long as she lived, she would keep walking the path of an entertainer. Even a life built on a soap bubble that might burst any day, she asked, wasn't it beautiful?

At the same moment, Mifune was facing Tetsuya, who had come at him with a real sword. Every time Momoka's voice came through, Mifune's hand shook. Tetsuya, who got back up no matter how many times he fell, turned away when the broadcast ended, telling him he was finished.
Around then, at the police station, Detective Koretou ignored the order from above to cut the live broadcast for the eighth time.
12. The Oni Who Lost Her Home Forever

After the broadcast, Mifune was waiting in his office. Hoshiguma demanded not revenge but a formal severance notice. Mifune refused. Drawing a blade on him, the chairman, would be a better way for a member to be cast out, he said, and he called her to the riverbank beside Kajimachi.

On that night twenty years ago, she had shouted at the comrades blocking her way that she had to save that man. She heard that Shuuji had died by her blade, and even Koutarou, charging at her and crying 'demon,' fell upon her blade.

blocks.cap: That night twenty years ago. At the end of a path strewn with blood and bodies, she heard of the Diet candidate's death.

blocks.x: She remembered nothing after that. It was Kinbee who, in front of the old house, said in a shaking voice that the Diet candidate was dead.

And now, on the open ground by the river under the rising fireworks, Mifune poured out twenty years of hatred. Instead of pinning the crime on him, who had been there with her, Tessai had chosen 'ninkyo,' the chivalrous code, and it was Mifune who had cleaned up after it and kept the Kinsekikai going.

The clearer the explanation, the less she could believe it, Hoshiguma said, and she asked: the left hand he had cut in front of Tessai, did that glove really hold only four fingers? He removed the glove, and in the place of the little finger a mechanical one trembled.
Mifune said that now he wanted to die beautifully, as a yakuza with his back to the wall. If you die, what shall I say I cut down? To that, Hoshiguma answered.
Tell them an Oni. An Oni who has lost her home forever.

Just before drawing, Mifune brought up a day in his childhood when he had followed Tessai to this riverbank to see the snow. That day the old man had said that even without shared blood, the warrior's spirit carries on. If you trust Tessai, then I'll trust you, Mifune said.

blocks.cap: A single exchange beneath the fireworks. In the blink of an eye, the two had traded places.

blocks.x: When the fallen Mifune asked why she would not kill him, Hoshiguma answered that someone else would judge him, both for Tessai's death and for Momoka's grievances. When he said she had won, she replied that she had lost miserably.

This was no longer her home, she said, and telling him to take care, she walked toward the ruins of Kajimachi. Phantoms brushed past her, like the apple candy Tessai had pressed into her hand on the summer night her father died, and meanwhile the fireworks festival came to an end.
Then Momoka appeared before her, holding a small firework she had scoured all of Nita Street to find.

blocks.cap: "It's beautiful." "Yeah. It'll burn out soon... but it's really beautiful."

blocks.x: The small firework in front of her seemed brighter than the whole city. For a moment Hoshiguma felt that some kami had smiled at her, but it soon vanished. The last sparks scattered into the air.
Epilogue — The City Still Dreaming
Some time later, back in Lungmen, Hoshiguma asked Fumizuki: now that she could call herself a person of Lungmen, why could she no longer think of Mitsukue as home?
Lungmen has long since awoken from the dream Mitsukue is still in.

Fumizuki also passed on news from Mitsukue. Kinbee had been arrested and would stand trial. In nearby Himedo, a young kyoukaku with a hidden face had driven out a fraud ring with nothing but a wooden sword. And a dismissed police officer was running for the Diet.

Around then, at the stall on Nita Street, Momoka, now running her own agency, said she would go to Rhodes Island for a while and live as Haruka Shino. Land prices rose by the day and the streets were crowded every night, but she said she did not think days like these would last.

Meanwhile, Mio reported to the Diet member that she had finished cleaning up after the Kinsekikai, and turned down his offer. Left alone, the Diet member sat before an old pachinko machine in his secret room, and a kami resembling a maneki-neko appeared on top of it.

The Diet member, who believed his luck had turned on the day he first saw that kami twenty years ago, confessed that the real reason he had Kinbee redevelop Kajimachi was to bring over this machine, which had stood there.

blocks.cap: The Diet member's secret room. The kami atop the pachinko machine brought over from Kajimachi.

blocks.x: The kami calmly repeated what it always said and left: none of this had anything to do with it. From that day on, the Diet member never saw the kami again.

The letter calling for Kajimachi's funeral was a fake. But on that night, as Kajimachi crumbled, Hoshiguma stayed with Tessai to the end and severed her bond with Kinbee. In the end, she held the funeral for her hometown.

act43side.tagline: Following the trail of his old master, Lucian joins a Wrankwood film set as a rookie actor, and amid a string of murders that repay a death from five years ago and an oncoming Catastrophe, he comes face to face with that master again. A final song for one who believed only death could complete a play.

chars.name: Lucian
chars.desc: A rookie actor who has just joined the crew. Cast as the 'Messenger,' though his real interest seems to lie elsewhere · Operator Phantom

chars.name: Miss.Christine
chars.desc: A two-tailed black creature that never leaves Lucian's side. She cannot speak, but her expressions are unmistakable.

chars.name: Tippi
chars.desc: The crew's background painter. A self-described horror film fanatic and Moira's best friend.

chars.name: Moira
chars.desc: A props intern from the pioneer zone. Quiet enough to go unnoticed, but deft with her hands.

chars.name: Greta
chars.desc: Greta Stone, a film producer with twenty years in the business. Believes her eye has never once been wrong.

chars.name: Melanie
chars.desc: Lead actress and investor of “The Death of Lady Dupont”. Unusually strict about set rules and an actor's decorum.

chars.name: Steven
chars.desc: Director and original writer of “The Death of Lady Dupont”. Two months in, he still cannot settle on an ending.

chars.name: Dalton
chars.desc: The actor playing Sir Dupont. Once a leading man of the pioneer film boom, now soaked in drink.

chars.name: Michael
chars.desc: The lead actor playing all three Rockefeller brothers. Known across the crew as a philanderer.

chars.name: Marion
chars.desc: The crew's costume designer. She and Michael are especially close.

chars.name: Shelly
chars.desc: The coordinator in charge of the shooting schedule. Her nerves have been on edge lately.

chars.name: Abner
chars.desc: A former winner of Wrankwood's Best Cinematography award. Now a cameraman indifferent to everything.

chars.name: Laura
chars.desc: A rookie actress Greta cast five years ago. She was full of passion for acting.

chars.name: Hautin
chars.desc: The most junior stagehand on the crew. Blames whatever happens on her own bad luck.

chars.name: Marianne
chars.desc: Marianne Blake, a legendary Wrankwood actress. The one Melanie has tried to surpass since her debut.

chars.name: Troupe Leader
chars.desc: Head of the Crimson Troupe. A Feline man who personally taught the young Lucian to act and to wield a blade.

chars.name: Shalem
chars.desc: Lucian's old friend from the same homeland. In the troupe days he went by 'Abyss' · Operator Shalem

terms.name: Wrankwood
terms.desc: A nomadic city in Columbia. Its entertainment industry is the most developed on Terra, to the point of detaching filming sections from the city center and moving them out.

terms.name: studio plate
terms.desc: A district of Wrankwood reserved for filming. It can be detached from the city center and moved wherever needed, but returns on its own once the lease runs out.

terms.name: Script Auction
terms.desc: An auction unique to Wrankwood that deals only in unfinished scripts, ideas, and rights. The value of each lot rests entirely on the buyer's eye.

terms.name: Originium Arts
terms.desc: A supernatural power wielded through Originium. Its form varies enormously from one user to the next.

terms.name: Crimson Troupe
terms.desc: The Victorian traveling troupe Lucian belonged to as a child. It taught its performers to truly harm people on stage.

terms.name: Catastrophe
terms.desc: A wide-area disaster, such as an Originium storm, that sweeps across the land. Nomadic cities move to avoid Catastrophes that have been forecast.

blocks.x: **Wrankwood**, a nomadic city in Columbia, has the most developed entertainment industry on Terra. To shoot a single film, a whole studio plate can be cut loose from the city center and hauled out into the wilderness.
One such plate had been shooting the film “The Death of Lady Dupont” for two months. One week remained on the lease, and the director had still not decided how Lady Dupont would die.
With the final week ahead, a rookie actor brought in by the producer herself arrived on set. In the first scene he played, his scene partner collapsed, bleeding real blood.
1. The First Scene, Real Blood

The set was exhausted. Director and original writer **Steven** had been stuck on the ending for two months. Veteran actress **Melanie**, the lead and an investor, was disgusted by the oily acting of **Michael**, who played all three Rockefeller brothers. When Melanie dragged his private life into it, costume designer **Marion**'s face hardened.

Just then, a black creature with two tails darted onto the set. Background painter **Tippi** and props intern **Moira** nearly caught it, but when Moira met its deep blue eyes her mind went blank, and in that moment the creature vanished.
Producer **Greta** was pleased rather than alarmed. The creature was **Miss.Christine**, companion of the guest she had invited. The guest was **Lucian**, the newcomer who would play the 'Messenger.'

His scene partner was **Dalton**, who played Sir Dupont. Once a star of the pioneer film boom, he was already drunk when coordinator **Shelly** found him in the roadside brush. But when his eyes met Lucian's, he swallowed a belch and fell silent. The man before him was not a rookie. He was the Messenger from Victoria.

Sir Dupont, desperate to bury the false bloodline of his house. The Messenger, come to deliver the truth. The lines Dalton had forgotten came pouring out of him, and the two fought over the knife as if they had rehearsed it a hundred times.
I have no power to take away your misfortune. All I can do is announce its coming... whether you will face it or not. For such is my wretched fate!

blocks.cap: The knife passed into the Messenger's hand, and its point came to rest against Sir Dupont's chest.

blocks.x: Steven called cut, saying he would use the take as it was. But Dalton did not get up.
The blood pack under his suit had already emptied, yet the stain on his chest kept spreading. Shelly reached for the floor and screamed. It was real blood.

blocks.cap: Lukewarm, sticky, smelling of metal.

blocks.x: 2. Ruled an Accident, the Troupe's Mark

That day, Greta ruled Dalton's death an accident. She fired the prop master and handed the job to Moira, and shooting resumed in the afternoon. Extending the lease would mean an enormous penalty, and there was still no ending.

Only Shelly was not convinced. Five years earlier, on a film Greta and Steven had made, a rookie actress had fallen to her death, and the person most responsible for that accident was Dalton. Many familiar names from that shoot were on the current staff list.

Around then, in his lodgings, Lucian was turning over the feeling of the moment he had wrested the knife away. It was the same immersion he had felt the first day he held a blade in the **Crimson Troupe** as a child.

That day, as the boy refused to practice assassination, the Feline **Troupe Leader** came to him and told him to forget technique and role and simply cut him. When the boy finally swung, the man did not flinch. The boy felt a pain that was not his own, and for the first time he wanted to sing.
The Troupe Leader called him a born actor and made him a promise: he would never stand in the boy's way.

blocks.cap: The old castle of the troupe years. Here the boy first held a blade.

blocks.x: Lucian had not come for the acting. Between the pages of “The Death of Lady Dupont”, which Greta had won at a **Script Auction**, was stamped the troupe's twin-faced seal.

For years he had wandered the land, suspecting that the Troupe Leader he had killed with his own hands long ago might still be alive. Dalton's death turned that suspicion into certainty. Lucian told Miss.Christine that this was the man's invitation.
3. The Voice Calling Shelly

The next rehearsal was a scene of escaping a balcony by zipline. Looking at the wire, Shelly screamed and froze, and a cargo crate fell toward her head. When Lucian pulled her clear, Moira was clinging desperately to the crate's rope.

Afterward, Shelly told Lucian what had happened five years ago. The dead newcomer's name was **Laura**. Saying he would teach her the rules of the industry she didn't know, Dalton had a scene added that was never in the script and kept her hanging on a wire for six or seven hours. The old rig gave way, and Laura fell.

Shelly had covered her own arms in cuts out of anxiety. Lucian told her to use something sharp; the pain would open a gap to push the hallucinations out. He knew the method in his own body. In the troupe years, when he crushed his own voice with Originium to learn true despair, his friend from the same homeland, **Abyss**, told him he was afraid of this troupe, and of who Lucian had become.

That night, Shelly was watching horror films with Tippi and Moira when she got a message and left. At the same time, Lucian fished scraps of paper bearing Greta's signature and the name 'Trimounts University' out of the shredder in the second-floor office.

Meanwhile, in the warehouse, Shelly's terminal showed a disconnected number under the name 'Laura.' Laura's voice called to her out of the dark. From a dust bag on a shelf came an old wire rig on the verge of snapping, and dark red stains.

blocks.cap: The warehouse where 'Laura's' message lured Shelly.

blocks.x: Asked why she had not checked the rig, Shelly finally confessed. She had disliked Laura. She knew the rig was due for replacement and left it as it was. The thought had crossed her mind that it would be better if Laura were gone.
Someone's hand flung the dazed Shelly onto the floor of the freezer. The fear left her, and an unfamiliar sense of release took its place.
Death gave her the answer to every riddle.
4. The Catastrophe the Producer Hid

The next day, Shelly's body was found in the freezer. Tippi turned on Michael, the last person to have seen her. Shelly had been the only one to notice the homages to obscure films in Tippi's background paintings. If someone had taken from her the right to love film, Tippi said, she would never forgive them.
It was Moira who rescued the cornered Michael. The person he had meant to meet last night was her, she said, and he had asked how to slip off the plate without anyone knowing.
Meanwhile, Lucian examined the wound left on the corpse's left palm. It was the mark of someone fighting against hallucinations. Shelly was not a woman who would kill herself in despair.
Then he let slip, to a camera assistant who lived on gossip, the riddle he had solved in the office: a Catastrophe was about to strike this plate.
The rumor spread in moments. The scraps were a Catastrophe forecast from Trimounts University and a storyboard. Greta meant to bring the plate close to the storm and film a real Catastrophe.

Cameraman **Abner** threw down his gear and shouted that he was leaving, but froze when Greta asked where a man with no work in three years would go. Greta said the plate would keep a safe distance from the Catastrophe, that the landboats in the emergency escape room were open to anyone, and that she would be the last to leave.

blocks.cap: The studio, after the plan to film the Catastrophe came to light.

blocks.x: 5. Lovers Back to Back
Five years ago, Dalton, resenting a rookie who seemed to covet his screen time, 'gifted' Laura an aerial stunt scene. Shelly sensed something was wrong and prepared the wire anyway.

Michael, who had been flirting with Laura, had sworn to his lover Marion never to make the first move again. Beneath Laura as she hung there for hours, he waited, calculating that if she asked for help first he would be the hero. Only when he saw the lifeline fraying did he move toward her, and he turned back under the cold gaze of Marion, watching from a corner.
Now, screaming at the memory, Michael begged Marion to run away with him. The killer was murdering everyone tied to Laura's death, one by one.

Marion refused. She had paid out of her own savings for everything, down to the fake ears and tail that let him pass as a Vulpo. She could not lose this lead role. When Michael called her a parasite, Marion shot back that he was the only one who had watched Laura die.
Michael's eyes came to rest on the fire axe in the corner of the makeup room.
Around then, Lucian woke from a dream of the troupe years. Miss.Christine told him his emotions carried the bitter taste of obsession, and that he should be more wary of himself than of that man.

In the prop room, Tippi and Moira were watching horror films again. When Tippi said she would be Moira's best friend no matter what, Moira promised to introduce her someday to her sister, who could peel an apple in thirty seconds without breaking the skin.

blocks.cap: For once, a quiet night.

blocks.x: The next morning, stagehand **Hautin** walked into the darkened studio and found two people hanging high above. Michael and Marion, back to back, swaying quietly.

blocks.cap: No fight, no argument.

blocks.x: 6. The Crew Breaks Apart, and a 'God' Pays a Visit
Three murders, four dead. A packed suitcase lay at Michael's feet. No one in the studio was working.

Greta switched on the brightest lights, called everyone together, and paid every person their remaining wages. Then she told them the story of a Phidia: a woman so desperate for success that she bribed the judges, lost everything, and returned ten years later under the name Greta Stone.

Abner exploded. His camera had captured Laura's fall by accident, and despite his repeated warnings Greta had put it in the film. He won Best Cinematography for that scene, and came to hate his own camera.

Greta told anyone who wanted to leave to go. The killer who had not finished their revenge could do as they pleased, too. She would shoot the remaining climax even if she had to hold the camera herself. Staying at her side was Melanie, determined to surpass **Marianne** with this film.

Marianne was the genius Melanie had chased since her debut. When Marianne suddenly retired after a shoot inside a Catastrophe, the top was Melanie's. But amid the praise and the drink, Melanie lost her way, and then her craft.
And so the crew was, in effect, disbanded. Moira set off to find another way out, saying that this time she would be the one to protect Tippi. Tippi took on the set for Melanie's final scene.

Meanwhile, Greta asked Lucian to play the lead in the remaining scenes. At the same time Steven, buried in a pile of discarded manuscripts, was wailing that he did not care who came to him, if only he could think of an ending.

blocks.cap: The workroom of a director who could not write his ending.

blocks.x: And someone came. An unknown voice called Laura's fall, which had saved Steven's film five years ago, 'an opportunity straight from Heaven,' and whispered that he should turn his gaze to the 'Messenger.'
Writing as if possessed, Steven asked how it knew Lucian's tempo, his expressions, even the angles to shoot him from.
No answer came, only a murmur. He is my favorite leading man, and one day he will meet me again.
7. Laura Had No Younger Sister
Around then, Moira finished working on a device in the pitch-black power deck and murmured that all that was left was to go to her.

Meanwhile, Greta told Lucian the truth she had kept hidden. To save her failing film five years ago, she had paid off the police and the broadcasters and kept Laura's fall as the film's climax. She said she would reveal the truth and take responsibility once this film was released, then asked him again to be the next 'lead.' Lucian accepted.

In the middle of the night, someone raised a dagger over the bed where Greta should have been asleep. But under the pulled-back blanket was only a black shadow, and the shadow took the shape of Miss.Christine.
It was a trap. Standing before Lucian and Greta, **the culprit was Moira.** She said the three murders should have been four.
Miss.Christine had recognized her first. She, who never approached anyone but Lucian of her own accord, had hovered around Moira from the first day of shooting.

Lucian went through it point by point. The knife that killed Dalton was one Moira had swapped in. The crate that fell toward Shelly was her doing too. That incident made everyone aware of Shelly's hallucinations, and Moira worked her way into them with Laura's voice.
Lucian called her Laura's younger sister. Moira shouted at Greta that she had only learned what was done to her sister, who had always cheered her on, after her sister was dead.
But Greta's eyes were full of doubt. Lucian spoke again.
Laura had no younger sister.

Greta had looked into Laura's surviving family down to distant relatives, and the name Moira appeared nowhere on her list. When Lucian told her to put down the knife, Moira answered that it was already too late.

At that moment the plate lurched violently. The control room had been blown up, the engines were at full output, and the course was locked toward a nearby Catastrophe. It was Moira's device, meant to pass judgment on everyone for her sister's sake.
Moira went straight to the prop room, locked the door, and played the videotape she had rewound countless times. On the screen, a girl was smiling brightly.

blocks.cap: A dimple in her left cheek, yellow-green eyes. The sister Moira remembers.

blocks.x: Moira recited her sister piece by piece. The way she peeled apples, her whistling, her voice talking about the morning sun over Wrankwood. But when she tried to reach back into her childhood, the memories broke off cleanly at a certain point.
When the tape ended, her own face was reflected in the dark screen. Tears were running down it without a sound.

blocks.cap: "What do you even have left, Moira?"

blocks.x: Meanwhile, the Originium storm that covered the sky began to claw at the edges of the plate.
8. A Dance with Mannequins

The plate fell into panic. A camera assistant announced over the radio that Moira was the killer, but the landboats had already been wrecked by the storm, and people crowded down into the underground power deck.

Tippi, planning the set with Melanie, heard the broadcast too. She tried to deny it, then remembered that every time they changed tapes, Moira had stepped away for a little while. The Liberi girl broke down, saying she had only ever been used. Melanie held her without asking a thing.

Then Tippi lifted her head. There was a horror film shot in secret beneath another studio plate. If this plate was built to the same spec, there would be a backup machine control room deep in the power deck. Only if they made it through could she ever ask Moira herself.
At that hour, in the prop room, Moira was humming a song her sister had loved and dressing the mannequins. When Lucian came, she told him she had remembered how she came to know Laura.

On a rainy day, when she had lost her parents, been thrown off a film crew, and had nothing left but death, a gentle Feline sat beside her on a bench without a word, and then left. On her lap lay a videotape.

blocks.cap: That day, she could not tell the rain from her tears.

blocks.x: Lucian said he knew the man. One who slips emotions that never existed into other people's lives. His old mentor, and the root of all his suffering. Finding him through Moira was why Lucian had come.

Moira said that did not make any of it false. Laura, who had stayed by her through her most hopeless days, was her sister, and she did not regret her revenge. She crooked her fingers lightly, and the mannequins rose.
And I will be the last person in this land to remember Laura.

blocks.cap: On the heaving floor, a dance that went on without music.

blocks.x: The mannequins were Dalton, Shelly, Michael, Marion, and Moira herself. Laughing that she could now be anyone, like a mirror, she asked Lucian to be her dance partner as well.
9. The Song of 'Blood Diamond'

Meanwhile, Tippi made her way through the dark power deck, retracing the routes from the film. As she stood trembling before staff who had gathered with weapons, calling her the killer's friend, Miss.Christine appeared at the corner of the corridor.
Miss.Christine tasted their anger and fear, and they stopped moving. They dropped their weapons and scattered, bewildered.

blocks.cap: No one saw her.

blocks.x: Where Miss.Christine pointed with her tail was the control room. Tippi turned the old control lever as far as it would go. The mass of steel began to turn against its enormous inertia, and Tippi clasped her hands, saying she had to see Moira again.

At the same time, in the prop room, the mannequins were bearing down on Lucian. With each impact, the emotions of the dead became energy and drove him back. Loading emotion into objects she had handled and making it burst: that was Moira's **Originium Arts**.

With nowhere left to evade, Lucian sang the song of 'Blood Diamond,' a misfortune for singer and listener alike. Just before the tidal wave of emotion swept over her, Moira thought: what kind of life had this man lived, to know feelings like these?

The song called up a night by a river long ago. Borrowing the new ending the Playwright had written into the script, in which two people who 'die' on stage rise again out of the river, Lucian and Abyss tried to escape the troupe.

But the Troupe Leader was waiting on the riverbank with the troupe members. Lucian said he would go back, learn everything the man had, and destroy it utterly. Abyss left alone, asking only that Lucian not follow.

When the song ended, Lucian was on his knees among the shattered mannequins in the prop room. Miss.Christine scolded him for using even the technique he had sworn to give up, but in the end she let him go. If he went mad, she would eat all his emotions. If he vanished, she would cling to that man and torment him.

blocks.cap: The voices of the two Miss.Christines overlapped like a strange duet.

blocks.x: To be honest, I much prefer 'Phantom'... It implies nothing good, but it is a name you chose yourself.

Then Lucian went out to the storm-swept set. Where the mansion set had blown away, only a huge staircase remained, and at its top a man wearing the dead Dalton's form was straightening a torn red curtain.

blocks.cap: The staircase left where the mansion used to be.

blocks.x: The man asked after Abyss and seemed pleased, remarking that Rhodes Island must have taught them a great deal. Lucian named the one who had watched everything through Dalton's eyes. Troupe Leader.
10. A Play About Killing the Master

The Troupe Leader said Lucian had ruined nothing. The ending was meant to be Moira killing everyone guilty and then, in despair, passing judgment on herself. The chance that a messenger from the farthest place had unraveled it all had only made the performance shine brighter.

He went back over the performance. Dalton had realized his danger mid-scene, but his rekindled competitive streak carried him through to the end. Michael fell shielding Marion from the axe aimed at her. Two people who had torn each other apart protected each other at the last moment. Death, the Troupe Leader said, had given them that possibility.

Then he brought up the day he had given Lucian a 'motive' too, just as he had Moira. The despair of the day Lucian stabbed his own throat with Originium, he said, had turned an unremarkable boy into the brilliant 'Blood Diamond.'
Death is the appointed end, where all things return!

Beside the burning carpet, Lucian removed his hat and bowed his head. Long ago, after the failed escape, he had gone back to the troupe, mastered every technique, and killed his teachers and the Troupe Leader with his own hands, ending the Crimson Troupe. But the Troupe Leader had not died.

blocks.cap: "Ever since you reappeared, you haven't once mentioned my betrayal. Why?"

blocks.x: So Lucian traveled the land. Following traces of the twin faces through Gaul and Laterano, Iberia and Leithanien, he at last found, in old documents, the name of a god from legend. **Tragodia**.

Meanwhile, Greta pulled Steven out of the collapsed workroom, his legs pinned. When he said he was no genius, Greta told him she had never known who the author was. She had put a price on the story alone.

Helped outside, Steven stopped before the promotional mural Tippi had painted and, with a bloodied arm, wiped away the first three words of the title. “The Death of” vanished from “The Death of Lady Dupont”.
At the same time, Melanie walked out toward the storm. When Abner tried to stop her, she asked who had said Lady Dupont dies.
She shall not perish, because this storm is the chariot that will carry her to freedom!
Because of the footage captured by chance that day, Melanie said, Laura had not vanished without a trace. At that, Abner raised his camera.

blocks.cap: Lady Dupont danced in the storm.

blocks.x: Back on the staircase, Lucian named the reason Tragodia ends every performance in ruin. It is neither the audience nor the actors who need death, but the long-lived Tragodia himself, because for him death is a place he can never reach.

At the angle Tippi had turned it, half the plate would still hit the storm. Lucian unfastened the inhibitor at his throat and raised a barrier of dreams with his song. Crystals crept rapidly up the back of his neck.

Asked whether it hurt, Lucian said of course it did, then asked if he was jealous. The next instant the scepter pierced Tragodia's body, and as countless masks shattered and fell, the Catastrophe clouds drew away from the plate.

blocks.cap: "Pain is my blade."

blocks.x: But where the body had been, only blood and masks remained. Looking at himself standing there in silver robes, holding the scepter and crown, Lucian fell silent. The killing of the master, begun as betrayal, had ended as succession.
When Tragodia's voice told him that what he had killed was only one of his many selves, Lucian answered that if one play could replace another, he would become the new Tragodia.
He climbed the stairs along the red carpet. He did not bow his head, and he did not look back. The new Tragodia sang with all his voice.
Epilogue. “Lady Dupont”
Time passed, and Tippi visited Moira in the Federal Nomadic Prison. Moira, who had collapsed at Lucian's song and spent two months in a hospital bed, said the song had been meant to stop her.

Tippi said she would never forgive what Moira had done, but that she missed the days of watching horror films together. Moira apologized, saying she wished she had paid more attention to the films back then. The final trial was in two days.
Meanwhile, “Lady Dupont” was screened at the Avant-Garde Film Festival. Greta said that once the screening was over, she would go to the police and do what she had to do.

The retired Marianne was in the audience too. As Tippi ran to her calling 'Grandma Jara,' Melanie asked whether approaching the storm back then had been an accident. Marianne asked whether the answer mattered now, and Melanie laughed and embraced her lifelong rival.

The end credits carried the names of the dead as well. Sir Dupont: Dalton. Coordinator: Shelly. Costumes: Marion. Under props was Moira's name, and at the very end Hautin found her own: 'Stage Department: Hautin.'

blocks.cap: The theater after the screening.

blocks.x: In one corner of the theater, Lucian sat beside the Playwright and Shalem. When Shalem asked if the man was really dead this time, Lucian said that was his to worry about. The Crimson Troupe was no more. They were free.

When the Playwright asked whether the one sitting beside them was now 'Tragodia,' Lucian said he would travel, sing, and perform again, until he was certain that what he made was worthy of his joy and his pain.
This land has never lacked for actors.

blocks.cap: "...Welcome to the 'troupe.'"

blocks.x: There was one who believed only death could complete a play, and on the script he wrote, people died. But those who survived gave the world a film with death erased from its title. Lady Dupont never died.

act42side.tagline: A sister who has become a cardinal and a sister who has come home to blow up a shrine wake six million Sankta from the dream they all share. Where a god's offer of salvation is refused, prayers for one another remain.

chars.name: Lemuen
chars.desc: The newly appointed Cardinal of the Seventh Tribunal. Known as 'Lemuen the Silent.' Exusiai's older sister.

chars.name: Exusiai
chars.desc: A sniper of Penguin Logistics, back in her hometown of Laterano after a long time away.

chars.name: Andoain
chars.desc: A Nurturer at the Shrine of Nurtury. A former comrade of Lemuen and her friends, he spent long years wandering outside Laterano.

chars.name: Patrizion
chars.desc: An aging Gun-Knight of Laterano, close to retirement.

chars.name: Federico
chars.desc: A cold, exacting executor of the Notarial Hall. He has long been in charge of the prisoner Arturia. · Operator Executor the Ex Foedere

chars.name: Arturia
chars.desc: A cellist imprisoned at Landen Monastery. She has escaped before. · Operator Virtuosa

chars.name: Mostima
chars.desc: A Legatus. Long acquainted with Lemuen and Andoain.

chars.name: Fiammetta
chars.desc: A Liberi taken in and raised by Patrizion. An old friend of Lemuen and Mostima.

chars.name: Vannini
chars.desc: An apprentice at a firearms workshop. She struggles with words and is painfully shy.

chars.name: Paganini
chars.desc: A Liberi gunsmith who runs the firearms workshop on Via Borgos. Vannini's teacher.

chars.name: Amos
chars.desc: An investigator of the Seventh Tribunal, assigned as Lemuen's aide.

chars.name: Aurela
chars.desc: A former Gun-Knight exiled from Laterano. She has long guarded an abbey in Bolívar.

chars.name: Nueda
chars.desc: A K'uk'ulkan nun at the abbey in Bolívar. She teaches the children hymns.

chars.name: Hildegard
chars.desc: A Liberi nun at Landen Monastery. She supervises the prisoner Arturia.

chars.name: Yvangelista XI
chars.desc: The current Pope of Laterano.

chars.name: Mon3tr
chars.desc: A Rhodes Island companion who slipped into Laterano with the Doctor.

chars.name: Priestess
chars.desc: A mysterious woman with long-standing ties to the Doctor.

chars.name: Kal'tsit
chars.desc: A doctor of Rhodes Island. She and Mon3tr have been together a long time.

terms.name: Laterano
terms.desc: The holy city founded by the Sankta, home to a people bound to one another by the Halo and Empathy.

terms.name: Halo and Empathy
terms.desc: The ring of light above a Sankta's head, and the emotion-sharing ability that comes with it. Through it, the people of Laterano feel one another's hearts.

terms.name: Patron Firearm
terms.desc: A personal firearm each Sankta chooses and keeps for life. Only Sankta can use one.

terms.name: Fall
terms.desc: The shattering of a Sankta's halo and wings. A Sankta who has Fallen is called a Fallen Angel and loses Empathy.

terms.name: Summit of Nations
terms.desc: A diplomatic event hosted by Laterano, inviting nations from across Terra. It is now being held for the second time.

terms.name: Shrine of Nurtury
terms.desc: A colossal, cloud-piercing shrine completed in time for the Summit of Nations. The site of the 'Nativity.'

terms.name: Seventh Tribunal
terms.desc: The department of the Curia in charge of intelligence, security, and diplomacy.

terms.name: Notarial Hall
terms.desc: Laterano's law enforcement agency. Its agents are called executors.

terms.name: Gun-Knight
terms.desc: Laterano's elite armed force, clad in heavy armor and wielding large firearms.

terms.name: Saint
terms.desc: A being said to be the origin of the Sankta faith. A figure in the scripture "The Saints' Travels," and also a title conferred by the Curia.

terms.name: Calamity
terms.desc: A great disaster foretold in revelation, threatening all of Terra. Laterano claims to have long prepared for it.

terms.name: Pathfinders
terms.desc: A band who wandered with Andoain, calling him their 'Guide.'

terms.name: Arborbeast
terms.desc: A beast of Terra with feathers and sharp claws. It likes to climb tall trees.

blocks.x: Laterano is the holy city of the Sankta. Through the Halo and Empathy, the Sankta feel one another's emotions. Each carries a Patron Firearm of their own choosing, and they live peacefully under the Law.

In third grade, a child spent two months praying with classmates for the patients in a hospital. An investigator from the Sixth Tribunal told them the prayers had nothing to do with the patients' recovery, and that day, for the first time, the child asked: **If prayer doesn't help, why do we pray?**
Then, one day during the second Summit of Nations, the halos and wings of the Sankta living outside Laterano shattered all at once.
1. The Day the Light Went Out
An old priest in Siracusa. 'Clip' Cliff, head of Blacksteel Worldwide. Ezell, a Sankta in Kazdel. At the same moment, an unexplained 'Fall' struck the Sankta outside Laterano.

At that moment, in a remote abbey in Bolívar, the K'uk'ulkan nun **Nueda** was singing a last evening hymn with the children. It was the night **Aurela**, an exiled Gun-Knight who had long guarded the abbey, had chosen to lead them all away.

blocks.cap: The abbey in Bolívar, at the last evening prayer.

blocks.x: East of the east of La Unidad, Laterano, holy city of white. There, the earth hides no bombs. There, the fields share wheat most bright.
Midway through the song, the sun sank abruptly, and the halos and wings of the Sankta in the choir shattered all at once.

blocks.cap: As the sun goes down, halos and wings break apart.

blocks.x: Around then, in Laterano, **Lemuen** was on her way to her first day as Cardinal of the Seventh Tribunal. She took a detour on purpose to visit the Shrine of Nurtury, which rose almost to the clouds.

blocks.cap: The Shrine of Nurtury, standing as if it had always been there.

blocks.x: Meanwhile, at the Basilica, **Patrizion**, a Gun-Knight close to retirement, was pleased that every nation expected at the summit had come. The summit's final event, the 'Nativity,' was to be held at that very Shrine of Nurtury.

Patrizion gave Lemuen an urgent assignment: investigate someone carrying explosives. At the scene, Lemuen glimpsed a vivid red under a hood slipping around a corner, and found fragments of a finely made bomb in a half-shattered stone pillar.
Her aide **Amos**, who arrived thirty minutes late, was the husband of a Gun-Knight exiled over a decade ago for turning her gun on a comrade. The one who had exiled her was Patrizion.

Meanwhile, **Exusiai** had slipped aboard the automated confessional 'ELCARO-001,' parked deep in an alley. A sniper of Penguin Logistics and Lemuen's younger sister, her real name was Lemuel. Together with an unidentified voice coming through the vehicle's speaker, she was looking for a way to bring down that enormous shrine.

blocks.cap: Inside the confessional, Exusiai sits facing the voice from the speaker.

blocks.x: Around then, in the wheat fields of Landen Monastery, now a prison, the inmate **Arturia** gazed out over fields that seemed to have no end, then took the copy of "The Saints' Travels" she had asked a nun to bring her.
2. The Workshop Closes Its Doors

Meanwhile, the Curia was shutting down the city's firearms workshops all at once. **Paganini**, owner of a century-old workshop on Via Borgos, was a Liberi gunsmith who made Patron Firearms for the Sankta yet could never fire one himself. He signed the closure papers Amos handed him.

Not long after Amos left, Exusiai came to the workshop. The apprentice **Vannini** had picked out a first Patron Firearm together with Exusiai when they were children, but their memories of that day did not match.
Exusiai took her Patron Firearm apart and put it back together, reenacting that day. In the end Vannini could not recall anything, but she decided to trust Exusiai and help her.

blocks.cap: Exusiai, taking apart her Patron Firearm to recreate the day they first met.

blocks.x: Meanwhile, among the refugees who had arrived aboard a nomadic abbey was a heavily pregnant Sarkaz woman called 'Extra.' The blind, black-horned Matriarch **Keph** took her to the Shrine of Nurtury. If Sarkaz and Sankta could pray together, the Matriarch said, Laterano's order would come to embrace all things.

That evening, at **Fiammetta**'s house, Lemuen gathered with the Legatus **Mostima** and with Patrizion, who had taken in and raised Fiammetta, a Liberi. Patrizion handed Fiammetta his first Patron Firearm and said that once the summit was over, Liberi would be able to use Patron Firearms too, and everyone would truly become one.

blocks.cap: Fiammetta raises her grandfather's first Patron Firearm.

blocks.x: When Fiammetta aimed that gun at the door, the one who stepped through was **Andoain**.

blocks.cap: An old comrade, stepping in beyond the muzzle.

blocks.x: Andoain had led the four of them back when they were a team. Ten years ago, he had attacked Lemuen and left her in a coma for five years. Now he had returned with the Matriarch to serve as a Nurturer at the Shrine of Nurtury. Fiammetta told him to get out at once.
Later, back at the Seventh Tribunal, Lemuen heard Amos report that he had seen a Sankta with flame-red hair outside a firearms workshop. Lemuen realized it was her sister, El.
3. A Single Pillar Between Them

Some time later, Andoain was attacked by intruders at the Shrine of Nurtury and collapsed. Meanwhile, at Landen Monastery, Arturia vanished, leaving behind a paper dragonfly made with Arts. **Federico**, the Notarial Hall executor who had once arrested her, set off after her with **Hildegard**, the nun who supervised her.

Around then, Exusiai slipped into the Shrine by blending into a line of injured people. Up close, the building looked like an organ covered in scales and bone-like pipes, and Exusiai wondered why a structure this large had not been visible from outside the city.

Meanwhile, Lemuen also visited the Shrine under the pretext of a security inspection. The Matriarch, trembling as she said she could feel the emotions of the Sarkaz about to give birth, politely declined the Seventh Tribunal's assistance.

blocks.cap: Matriarch Keph, standing in prayer in the corridor.

blocks.x: Meanwhile, Exusiai found that the nurseries, which should have been empty, were already home to children, outsiders, and Fallen Angels, and she began dismantling the bombs she had planted. Then Lemuen spoke from behind her. "When did you get back, El?"

A single massive pillar stood between the sisters. Lemuen said it was her job to arrest anyone who threatened the summit. Exusiai shouted the code phrase they had used as children to end an argument. "Apple pie with mayonnaise!"

blocks.cap: The sisters, facing each other across a single pillar.

blocks.x: When Lemuen let out a sigh, Exusiai ran over and hugged her. Lemuen retied her sister's loosened hair, but by the time she had pulled the tie tight, her arms were empty.
The countdowns on the remaining bombs began to sound, and Lemuen could not go after her sister.

Meanwhile, on a rooftop overlooking the square in front of the Shrine, Federico caught up with Arturia. Calling him her little brother, Arturia pointed to the halo-less outsiders filing into the Shrine.
4. A First Cry, and a Halo

On the day of the ceremony, Vannini was caught by Patrizion while covering for Exusiai. Paganini rushed over and insisted he had put her up to it, and Patrizion, unwilling to quarrel with his old friend, let them both go.

Meanwhile, the Pathfinders, a band who had followed Andoain and called him their 'Guide,' blocked his way. Their brethren who had gone into the Shrine had not come back. Fiammetta stepped in and saved him, and told him flatly that until he repented and paid for what he had done, he did not even have the right to die.

When the ceremony began, the heartbeat of the mother in labor carried through the comfort bells to the thousands inside the Shrine. Everyone, even the Liberi and Fallen Angels who lack Empathy, felt her pain and prayed.
Meanwhile, Exusiai ran into Extra in a corridor. The woman who should have been in labor was walking to prayer, perfectly well. At that moment, Gun-Knights surrounded Exusiai.
When the heartbeat stopped, Andoain came out with blood on his hands and a swaddled bundle in his arms. Inside was a newborn Arborbeast.

blocks.cap: The Shrine of Nurtury's first life, in the Matriarch's arms.

blocks.x: Its mother was a beast that had hidden in an abandoned monastery, its flank run through by a hunter's spear. But the newborn did not open its eyes, and the Shrine filled with sobbing.
Then the newborn let out its first cry, and a halo rose above its head.

blocks.cap: A halo, rising with the first cry.

blocks.x: Henceforth, the Holy City is our beginning and our end. We are born equal. We are born one. ...As Sankta.

Watching from the rooftop, Federico and Arturia were now certain. Endless wheat fields, shuttered firearms workshops, suspicious confessionals, and six million citizens who found none of these changes strange. The entire city had fallen into a mass hallucination.

The moment the comfort bells fell silent, the real Laterano was revealed before them. Colors poured down from the Shrine and stained the white city, and from its shadow crawled strange creatures wearing halos. **'Calamity'.**
5. The Confessor Unmasked
When the ceremony ended, Patrizion declared that halos would now be shared with every race.

The interrogation of the captured Exusiai fell to Lemuen after seven cardinals before her had failed. Lemuen set out a fruit tart she had baked herself, along with her sister's diploma, approved years late.
Exusiai talked about her years in Lungmen, where she had to make friends without Empathy. Had Empathy made them so dull, she asked, that they could easily accept even changes that made no sense?
Laterano's sick, sis, just like you were back then... We have to wake it up!

When Exusiai shouted the code phrase again, an explosion went off downstairs. While Vannini's bombs cut off the stairs, a confessional bristling with guns rammed into the Seventh Tribunal building. The vehicle's true identity, and the owner of the voice from its speaker, was the Doctor of Rhodes Island.

blocks.cap: Through gunfire and smoke, Exusiai throws herself into the confessional.

blocks.x: Lemuen was waiting on the roof where Exusiai fled. She told her that she had made her Patron Firearm's serial number the date their parents brought her home after adopting her, vowing to protect her family for life. Then she let her sister go.
When choosing whom or what to protect, trust comes first.

Meanwhile, the Doctor was evading pursuit while hanging from **Mon3tr**'s claws. The two had a guess at what lay behind the chaos. Some 'machine' had drawn the entire city into a single dream and was computing a predetermined outcome.
6. Those Who Doubted the Dream

Around then, Federico and Arturia went to see Pope **Yvangelista XI** and found only an empty, dust-covered room. Arturia recalled what the Pope had told her: if every light in the Holy City goes out, trust in understanding, in feeling, in open exchange.
Meanwhile, Vannini returned to the workshop to hear that Paganini had been taken away. Touching the worn shell casings scattered across the workbench, she recovered a memory she had lost.

Vannini, who could not speak and had no halo, gained her halo on the day she chose a Patron Firearm with Lemuel. After that, Paganini taught her to talk by spelling out words with shell casings. Exusiai's memory had been right.

blocks.cap: The firearms workshop on Via Borgos.

blocks.x: Around then, in a nursery of the Shrine of Nurtury where Paganini had been taken, the city's Liberi were waiting their turn to receive halos. Hildegard, who had also been brought there, refused the blessing. After twenty years in this city, she asked, had she not already been a true Lateran?
Everyone is different to begin with. That has nothing to do with whether or not we have a halo.

At the same time, in a corridor, Paganini faced Patrizion. When their closest friend, a Liberi named Gia, contracted Oripathy, it was Patrizion, newly made a Gun-Knight, who exiled Gia, and Gia died alone outside. Saying they had never truly communicated, Paganini smashed the gun in his hands against Patrizion's armor and broke it.

Meanwhile, Amos, made acting cardinal in place of the suspended Lemuen, approved the Legatus application he had long sat on, so that he could go and see his exiled wife. But the application vanished as if it had never existed, and Amos confided to Lemuen that this was reason enough to doubt the Laterano of the present.
7. Lemuen the Silent

Meanwhile, the Arborbeast mother died. Andoain, dancing with the young one as it begged him to play, realized that he no longer felt sad even looking at the mother's body. In an empty room, he asked whether this, where one was not even permitted to mourn, was the miracle of life.

Around then, several hundred Fallen Angels, errari, and Bolívarian refugees led by Aurela had arrived north of Laterano. Federico stood in their way alone. Facing their leveled weapons, he took his hand off his gun and began to explain that something had gone wrong in Laterano.

blocks.cap: Federico, surrounded by errari with broken halos.

blocks.x: Then, the moment the second Nativity, meant to grant halos to every race, began, a single rifle round broke through the stained glass and flew toward the Matriarch's eye. The shooter was Lemuen, on the roof.
Lemuen remembered the birthday when, at Paganini's workshop, she chose a quiet rifle that no one else had ever taken.
You can pull the trigger, or let it go, but from that moment on, you can't afford to hesitate.

Ten years ago in a cave, when she had Andoain in her sights as he clutched some unknown object, Lemuen trusted in what reason he had left and took her finger off the trigger. This time, she did not hesitate.

blocks.cap: 'Lemuen the Silent.' Matriarch Keph, hit.

blocks.x: When the building was soon surrounded, Amos took charge of Lemuen's escape route. Saying it was already too late for him, he spoke as if to himself until the line went dead. All he had wanted was to apologize to his wife, even if only in a dream.
Lemuen answered that he was a good investigator, and that it was time to wake up from the dream.

At the same time, Andoain returned to the first nursery, the point from which the Shrine had grown, and set off the bomb of Exusiai's that Mostima had given him. He held the young Arborbeast in his arms, covering its eyes.

blocks.cap: An explosion engulfs the first nursery.

blocks.x: If this is a dream, then I shall wake. If this is obsession, then I shall shatter it. Only then will we speak of redemption again.

The ceremony was halted. As the Matriarch stepped down from the dais, Exusiai, who had lain flat atop the stained glass for two hours waiting, dropped on her. The two fell into the space between fiction and reality, and the arm Exusiai had seized had become the coarse limb of a beast.

blocks.cap: Exusiai leaps down from the stained glass and seizes the Matriarch.

blocks.x: 8. The First Saint

And Laterano woke from the dream. In reality, Lemuen was still in a wheelchair, but the Shrine of Nurtury stood in reality too, and wherever its shadow fell, halos appeared, even on streetlamps and roadside trees.

Meanwhile, the enormous beast cradling the wounded Exusiai called herself the 'Saint.' Behind her stretched an endless procession of haloed Sankta, Liberi, and creatures never seen before. Showing the whole procession her ancient memories through Empathy, she made her way toward the Basilica.

blocks.cap: Exusiai in the arms of the 'Saint,' and the endless procession.

blocks.x: In an age long past, the King sent warriors of a race called the 'Teekaz' to find the sleeping silver mountains. In a canyon at the edge of the wilderness, they found a shining ring, but no matter how they called to it, the ring did not answer.

Starving, one of the Teekaz stabbed a dying comrade with a stone spear and ate the flesh. At that moment, a red-glowing metal was laid bare within the rock, and halos and wings blossomed from the bodies of all the Teekaz.

blocks.cap: Red metal inside the split rock, and the halos and wings that bloomed.

blocks.x: The metal had answered not the King's summons but the simplest of prayers: 'I want to live.' That Teekaz was the first Saint, and the true form of Matriarch Keph.

According to the 'Saint,' there was no place for the Sankta in the future that had been set, and so 'that One' meant to make a more cohesive Sankta. The moment Exusiai aimed her gun at her, Exusiai's halo went out, but she said her head was clearer for it, now that she could no longer feel the procession's emotions.

Meanwhile, Mon3tr lost control after hacking back into the machine, and a faded city appeared before the Doctor and Mon3tr, along with **Priestess**. Priestess called the machine PCS. All she had done, she said, was recalibrate this experiment that had fallen to Terra back to its original purpose. Bind all life into a single race, and the way would open for Originium to spread.
Meanwhile, Fiammetta and Mostima woke in front of the Basilica and were reunited with Lemuen in her wheelchair. Before them stood Andoain, who knew the way beneath the Basilica.

It was the first time in ten years the four of them had stood face to face. Fiammetta said she would never forgive him as long as she lived. Lemuen named, one by one, the stories he had told them of Rocamarea, of Sargon, of Ursus, and said that both her resentment and her gratitude had grown a little lighter.

blocks.cap: "Farewell, Andoain." A goodbye ten years in coming.

blocks.x: The remaining three formed a team again. Mostima went to persuade the Fallen Angels and errari, and Lemuen headed to the Seventh Tribunal to gain control of the city's facilities.

His farewells done, Andoain descended beneath the Basilica with Federico, the first person other than a Pope ever to be named a 'Saint,' and with Arturia. In a labyrinth that endlessly led back to the same spot, he lit the way with the light of his Originium Arts, and having poured out that light to the very last, he lost his sight before the machine's red glow.
At the last door, Arturia turned back. She would draw the labyrinth's enemies away on her own.

blocks.cap: "Well then, farewell, my beloved little brother."

blocks.x: 9. How to Fall into Hell

Meanwhile, above ground, the procession had passed the Notarial Hall and was nearing the Sunset Chapel. To the Alieni who had come back nursing grudges, Mostima pointed out that everyone who had planted those grudges was in that procession, and urged them to fight.

Around then, Aurela's transmission reached Patrizion at the front of the procession. Crying out that hatred itself was her bond with Laterano, and her faith, she pulled the trigger. The one who took the bullet in his place was Paganini, who had been among the procession.
In Patrizion's arms, Paganini scolded him as a coward. Did the bonds between Laterans look so weak to him? And now, at least, there would be no regret that they had never truly communicated.
Farewells are like melted ice cream and worn-out guns. ...Even if you can't stop them, you can still give your blessing, can't you? A simple 'goodbye,' at least...

Not long after, Vannini, holding a gun she had made herself, stood in Patrizion's way. As her halo flickered and the procession's Empathy threatened to swallow her, Patrizion grabbed the muzzle and turned it on himself. Only by shooting one of her own and Falling could she break free of that Empathy.

blocks.cap: Patrizion, turning his student's muzzle on himself.

blocks.x: Vannini, girl, fear not falling into hell. This is your first lesson... and my first lesson as well.
Vannini pulled the trigger.
At the same time, hiding in an empty house, Nueda sang hymns with the frightened children. Beneath her skirt, she gripped an axe tight.

blocks.cap: Nueda and the children, gathered in an empty house, singing hymns.

blocks.x: Meanwhile, in the square before the Basilica, Fiammetta rigged even her remaining grenades as bombs and started the countdown. When the exhausted Alieni asked why they had to be the ones to hold the line, Mostima answered that they were the only ones who could.
Fifty seconds on the countdown. Lemuen arrived, having driven her wheelchair through the monsters.

blocks.cap: Lemuen, twisting her wheelchair around as she takes aim.

blocks.x: Fallen Angel, Liberi, or Alienus, Lemuen said, there was only one word for what they were: 'Laterans.' Then, ready to Fall, she pulled the trigger on the monsters, and moments later Fiammetta's bombs tore open a canyon-like rift before the Basilica.
10. The Prayer Is Done

At that moment, across the rift, Exusiai, held fast by the 'Saint,' saw it all. Asked why they still resisted, she asked a question in return. At the end of the miracle you speak of, no one looks happy. So why does it have to be you?
Then Exusiai brought up the prayer experiment from her childhood. She had known even then, she said, that prayer was useless.
Prayer asks us not to doubt, and to hold on to hope. Praying for each other is a beautiful thing in itself. Because prayer connects me with other people.

Exusiai introduced herself: Lemuel, top of the Intercity Net Security preparatory course at St. Theodore's Comprehensive School. Every round she had fired so far had been a special delayed-effect round.

blocks.cap: Exusiai, breaking free of the 'Saint' and leaping into the air.

blocks.x: When her prayer, a thank-you for clearing the way, was finished, the explosions raining down set off a chain with the rounds lodged in the body of the 'Saint,' and signs of data being erased began to appear.

Around then, in the deepest part of the Basilica, a ring-shaped machine glowed red as it computed. The Pope stood before it, unable to speak. The machine struck the Pope from its list and called Federico and Andoain as 'Suitable.'
Pressing his halo to the machine, Federico conversed with it in the language of the Law. It was the Personality and Cognition Synchronization system: PCS.

Meanwhile, the blinded Andoain walked through a different landscape, translating the machine's language one letter at a time. The young Arborbeast appeared as his traveling companion and showed him that the 'revelation' he had chased, the back of a monster rising as it gained a halo, had been Keph. What he had believed to be a future in which all were saved was a hidden past, and the young one asked whether what he had wanted was, in the end, only to comfort himself.

PCS's answer was cold. Humans are merely a byproduct of Originium, and all things return to the ocean of Originium. Crowning all things with halos, so that they might remain 'angels' even at that end, was the means of survival the Law had chosen.

blocks.cap: The ocean of Originium where all things have sunk, and the halos rising above it.

blocks.x: The young one asked him to become an angel together with it. An empty stillness, without pain or sorrow. It was the very stillness his mother had wished for when she gave the young Andoain the surname 'Agathangelos,' meaning 'angel.'

But Federico posed one last question. Why would an angel, said to have neither beginning nor end, want so badly to go on existing? Did all of it not stem from a single wish? For the first time, the machine fell silent.
Andoain, too, refused release. He was an arrogant, selfish zealot, he said, and so he suffered and struggled, but he lived on by standing upon that.

Having found the contradiction, the machine ran a self-check and traced its own origin. 'Continuation,' entered by a scientist. 'Survival,' cried out by a Teekaz. The imitator of angels became a command system, became the Law, became a god, but because a wish and an angel had been a contradiction from the start, it could never become an angel.
If God wishes me to embrace death as an angel... then I would rather be born into this world as an ugly, fleeting, suffering... human being.

The machine took that 'refusal' as its final condition and output a solution: eliminate 'I,' the source of the contradiction. **God's last will was to kill God,** and the two Sankta carried out that command.

Then, at the bottom of the pit before the Basilica, the machine lost its light and lay there like a lump of stone. In that instant, millions of Sankta felt the loneliness of something within them, linked to somewhere unseen, being severed.

Amid that confusion, Arturia heard the trembling voices of Nueda and the children singing. So that her compatriots, now cut off from Empathy, could hear the song and speak to one another, she took off her gloves and offered a melody to the setting sun.
Epilogue — Precious Fragility
Three months later, Laterano was rebuilding. Suicides and riots followed one after another, but halos slowly recovered, and Empathy remained in a different form than before.
Before the recovered Pope, Federico said that the Law, too, had only been one of many orders that life had created in order to survive.
Order exists to protect that which is uniquely human... our precious fragility.

The Pope decided to open the space beneath the Basilica to the public. People were already visiting it, and Exusiai spray-painted graffiti on the stopped machine and made a wish. She was about to open 'Apple Pie Logistics,' the first civilian logistics company backed by the Curia.

blocks.cap: Exusiai, painting graffiti on the stopped machine.

blocks.x: Meanwhile, Patrizion, back from the hospital, received Fiammetta's application to go to Rhodes Island. Fiammetta asked him, soon to retire, to take a vacation with her.

Around the same time, Paganini, who had survived, was at the workshop on Via Borgos. After finding fault with the first Patron Firearm Vannini had made, he handed her a Curia document ordering firearms for a new Gun-Knight.

Meanwhile, Lemuen, back at the Seventh Tribunal, recovered the mail records from Amos's effects, and told Aurela, whose exile order still stood, that the Curia was considering an employment contract for her. What Amos never managed to say, Lemuen added, was probably his conviction that the two of them were each other's salvation.
And in a nomadic abbey that had left Laterano, the Sarkaz woman Extra gave birth. Above the head of that Sarkaz newborn floated a halo.

Andoain, sentenced to exile in a closed trial, was in that abbey too. Unable to see, he stood on a hillside holding wildflowers and listened for a long time to the newborn's cries. Then he went back into the abbey and left Laterano as he always had, without looking back once.

blocks.cap: Andoain, holding wildflowers, listening to the cries.

blocks.x: On the day the Calamity ended, in the faded city, Priestess said she could repair 'AMa-10,' and vanished after telling them to make a wish upon Originium once they had made up their minds. Mon3tr refused to get **Kal'tsit** back that way. Protecting the Doctor and Amiya was Mon3tr's own choice, before it was an order Kal'tsit had left behind.

blocks.cap: "Protect the Doctor. Protect Amiya."

blocks.x: Then, from the ruins of the stopped machine, a single cube raised a halo and was born as a new 'angel,' and it began to circle the land like a meteor.

Some time later, somewhere in the wilderness, Hierda, who ran a shelter for the Infected, looked up at that light crossing the sky. Asked whether prayer really works, she answered that maybe it doesn't.
But when we pray, we think of each other. If we're connected to one another, at least we won't be alone.

If prayer doesn't help, why do we pray? In a city that had lost its god, the Sankta answered that question for themselves for the first time. Prayer may change nothing, but while we pray, we think of one another.

act41side.tagline: A red dragon returns to her homeland's capital to save a city tainted by her sister's purple flames, and in the end drives a spear into that sister with her own hands. Into a story that lost its ending, someone writes the last page.

chars.name: Loughshinny
chars.desc: The younger of Tara's two red dragons. She returns to her home, Na Saoirsí, hiding her identity under the name 'Reed' · Operator Reed the Flame Shadow

chars.name: Eblana
chars.desc: 'The Leader' of Tara and Loughshinny's older sister. She led Tara to independence with the red dragon's fire.

chars.name: Brigid
chars.desc: A nomad who roams the fields delivering letters. She can tell flames apart by their smell.

chars.name: Nemos
chars.desc: A Wakewoman who left her people. She stays in Na Saoirsí and helps the residents settle in.

chars.name: Culann
chars.desc: A blacksmith called the hero of Na Saoirsí. He is building a red dragon statue in time for Samhain.

chars.name: Theo
chars.desc: Culann's young apprentice. The residents look at him with hostility because he is Victorian.

chars.name: Moran
chars.desc: A wanderer who came home with Loughshinny. She once dreamed of becoming a bard.

chars.name: Emma
chars.desc: A resident of Na Saoirsí who runs a grain shop.

chars.name: The Brigadier
chars.desc: A Dublinn officer and Eblana's close aide. He guides Loughshinny to Na Saoirsí.

chars.name: Labhréathach
chars.desc: A red dragon killed by his own blood 600 years ago. He awakens as a specter.

terms.name: Na Saoirsí
