The pursuers catch up quickly. Javier tries to force the group to turn away before the canyon, but Juana instead raises sail toward it, brushing straight past the salt ship blocking her way. For the first time in decades, La Conquista leads the fleet.

Meanwhile, in a cabin below, Isidro is taking the compass apart again. One hand grips a probe; with the longsword in his other hand braced against the wall, he holds himself steady on the rocking ship — with the swordplay of the sea, said to stay free even amid wind and waves.

Just as the new Corazonix is about to be completed, Anastasio's hand cannon blasts through the cabin. The Corazonix begins to boil within the runaway Arts field, and with no tools or parts left, Isidro thrusts his bare hand into it.

blocks.cap: Isidro reaching his bare hand into the runaway field. "...MY compass!"

blocks.x: **In that moment, the cold substance became part of his hot flesh and blood.** His right arm ruined, he takes up his sword in his left hand and steps out onto the deck.
1,000 meters. 500 meters. 100 meters. La Conquista plunges in among the red-stained skeletons, and the salt ship hot on its heels is smashed like a toy by an erupting pillar of steam.

blocks.cap: The Skeletal Reef, where pillars of steam shoot skyward.

blocks.x: But another ship bursts through the wreckage in pursuit, and beneath the Inquisition banner fluttering above it stands Anastasio.
11. Witness, Conquer, Define

Her former crew's ship has hooked La Conquista with grappling lines; Juana hurls the wheel to cut the ropes and leaps down onto their deck. The sailors, blinded by the bounty, soon throw off their armor and form a circle around her — the way to challenge a captain, which they had learned from Juana as children.

As Juana brings down the challengers one by one, Javier finally steps forward. 'I'm your captain.' Having asked that the sailors be spared if he died, he falls only after being beaten until his limbs are wrenched from their joints — and then he speaks of the day he burned the first bread he ever baked.

Everyone else turned away from that bread, but Juana alone picked it up from outside his window and ate it, looking satisfied — and he had thought he would do anything to see that smile again. Juana's answer is brief. 'Congratulations, Javi. In this duel between the new captain and the old, the victory is yours.'

At the same time, in a cabin, Pascuala — on the run — refuses to abandon the fallen Teach. Teach was the one who covered her with a blanket and shared her water. After pouring out her bitterness at the clerics who branded her a thief, Pascuala chews up the herbs in her pocket and feeds them to Teach.

blocks.cap: Pascuala held in Teach's arms. This warmth, at least, is hers.

blocks.x: And on deck, Anastasio presses Isidro: what is your desire? Isidro answers that he wants Juana to reach the sea, Pascuala never again to wake hungry in the middle of the night, and his companions to make it home safely. Because of his master, he had always avoided mixing with others — but the 'self' he protected that way was always empty. And no one should have to live like the people of Aarón, behind shuttered windows.

To Anastasio, who carves away his own flesh to wash off the sin of cannibalism, Isidro asks in return: isn't your most fundamental desire simply to live? 'You are the one person you most need to kill.' Then, with the hand cannon trained on him, he throws himself down between the bones where the steam erupts.
In the final moment of his fall, he looks at the sky. Like a deep blue sea crested with white spray — the very sea he had wanted to see with his own eyes.
Just as Anastasio is about to turn away, a single cold beam of light cuts through the thick steam.

blocks.cap: As the Corazonix covering his whole body scatters, Isidro's golden eyes are revealed.

blocks.x: I admit it. I want to go out to sea. I want to see the sea with my own eyes, and conquer it myself. And I will define for myself what 'my Iberia' means.

The sword pierces Anastasio's throat. Realizing his own contradiction — that he can atone only by bleeding, yet he is struggling to stop the blood — he lets his hand fall, leaps from the ship, and vanishes among the bones.
Epilogue. Farewell, Land

With his arm, now a compass, Isidro reads the paths of the steam and guides both ships — Javier's included — out of the canyon. There, as Juana digs out the rum she had hidden away, Javier leaves the final choice to the sailors: whoever wants to go to sea should follow Juana now.

The sailors split into two groups. Pascuala crosses over to Javier's ship, declaring she's going to get rich; Weedy stays on for a while to help repair the ship; and Elysium, heading back to town with Javier's group, waves to his 'amigo' at the bow.

blocks.cap: Juana atop the mast, the sunset beneath her feet. Every eye on both parting ships turns to her.

blocks.x: Two weeks later, Javier sells the remaining salt ships and blueprints to a merchant and divides the money among the sailors. He tried to buy back the ship's wheel, but it cost too much. Rus sets off, saying he envied Teach for choosing the sea even in her injured state, and Javier, too, walks on toward the next crossroads, saying he might open a restaurant.

Pascuala, meanwhile, is doing a big round of shopping at the market stalls. She quietly takes her hand off a buckle she's had her eye on, and joins in on a conversation among merchants heading to Columbia to strike it rich.
And aboard La Conquista, Juana asks: now that there is truly nothing left, will he still come with them? Isidro's answer is this: 'Will you be my first mate?'
When the old power core acts up, the vitamins and tools Elysium had been slipping him all along save the ship. His amigo had known his heart before he did.

The new captain stretches out his arm at the bow. Not looking with his eyes, he waits for the flowing light to tell him where to go — and the Corazonix points straight toward the far side of the sky. 'Anchors aweigh, hoist the sails... We sail out to sea!'

blocks.cap: La Conquista spreads its sails and leaves the Salt Flat. On deck rings the same sea shanty the old man used to sing.

blocks.x: 'Into the distance.' On the deck where toasts are going around, Nene — whom they had sent back to the Salt Flat — returns alive and licks Juana's cheek all over.

And out of the steam, a single trail of blood stretches deep into the Salt Flat. A tentacle pushes up through the salt crust and crawls toward the sunlight, and the remains of a man and the remains of a Seaborn devour each other as if starving. He only wanted to live. And it, too, only wanted to live.

The boy who once searched a lake bed for a gold coin no longer looks with his eyes; he lets the flow tell him where to go. Just as that coin engraved with salt and water meant — to look to the sea for life.

act38side.tagline: Four days before Carnevale, the first birthday of Nuova Volsinii, a city without famiglie, a single truck hits the Acting Mayor and the city begins to shake. On the masked night, every hidden vendetta and ambition gathers in the square.

chars.name: Leontuzzo
chars.desc: Acting Mayor of Nuova Volsinii. An idealist who left his famiglia behind and dreams of a 'city without famiglie.'

chars.name: Lavinia
chars.desc: Supreme Justice of Nuova Volsinii. Leontuzzo's partner, and a judge who enforces the New Urban Management Act to the letter. · Operator Penance

chars.name: Texas
chars.desc: A driver for Penguin Logistics. An old friend of Leontuzzo and Lavinia. · Operator Texas the Omertosa

chars.name: Lappland
chars.desc: The White Wolf, stripped of her surname by the Saluzzo Family. She would rather kick the board over than set it up. · Operator Lappland the Decadenza

chars.name: Zaaro
chars.desc: One of the Signori dei Lupi. Travels with Lappland after being knocked out of the game.

chars.name: Eirene
chars.desc: Leader of the Truckers' Union. A driver who lost everything in Sicilia and fled to Nuova Volsinii.

chars.name: Sommer
chars.desc: A former supermarket owner who took Eirene in, now a truck driver. His daughter Guri has Oripathy.

chars.name: Lyudmila
chars.desc: A truck driver from Ursus. A Reproba hunting her master's killer. · Operator Crownslayer

chars.name: Red
chars.desc: A wolf hunter who hunts wolves at 'Grandma's' bidding. She has left Rhodes Island.

chars.name: Caesar
chars.desc: One of the Signori dei Lupi. Said to be the closest to becoming alpha in this round of the game.

chars.name: Vargo
chars.desc: One of the Signori dei Lupi. Kept his Fang for this round hidden to the very end.

chars.name: Lunacub
chars.desc: A girl who learned hunting and archery from Agnese, one of the Signori dei Lupi. · Operator Lunacub

chars.name: Ingrid
chars.desc: A Vulpo killer who once left the Venezia Family. Returned to Siracusa over what happened to her daughter Lisa. · Operator Vulpisfoglia

chars.name: Lisa
chars.desc: Ingrid's daughter. Has Oripathy. · Operator Suzuran

chars.name: Antonio
chars.desc: The power behind Venezia Trucking. A Perro who became the Don's son-in-law.

chars.name: Fabrizio
chars.desc: The aging Don of the Venezia Family. An old man who took in 'hybrids' and bound them into one family.

chars.name: Umberto
chars.desc: The old tailor of the De Montano Tailor Shop. The only family his grandson Luchino has.

chars.name: Luchino
chars.desc: Umberto's grandson. A tailor's apprentice who looks up to famiglia big shots. · Operator Figurino

chars.name: Capone
chars.desc: A former Sicilian working for Venezia Trucking. Desperate to build up his citizen points in Nuova Volsinii.

chars.name: Gambino
chars.desc: Capone's partner. Has not been able to let go of the name 'Sicilian.'

chars.name: Demetri
chars.desc: Leontuzzo's old friend, and the one responsible for what remains of the Bellone Family.

chars.name: Alberto
chars.desc: Don of the Saluzzo Family. Lappland's father.

terms.name: Nuova Volsinii
terms.desc: Siracusa's 23rd nomadic city, built with Columbian technology. A testing ground for the idea of a 'city without famiglie.'

terms.name: New Urban Management Act
terms.desc: The law that holds Nuova Volsinii's order together. It bans famiglia violence, smuggling, and vendettas, and runs the city on identity registration and citizen points.

terms.name: Carnevale
terms.desc: An old Siracusan festival where anyone in a mask could do anything without being called to account. Nuova Volsinii revived it with a new meaning.

terms.name: Truckers' Union
terms.desc: Common name for the 'Nuova Volsinii Freight Workers and Truckers Mutual Aid Association.' The only transport organization licensed by City Hall.

terms.name: Signori dei Lupi
terms.desc: Immortal beings in the shape of wolves of the wilds. Each chooses a human Fang, and they play a game in which the Fangs fight until only one is left.

terms.name: Fang
terms.desc: A human chosen by one of the Signori dei Lupi to stand in for them in the game.

blocks.x: **Nuova Volsinii**, Siracusa's 23rd nomadic city, is a young city built with Columbian technology. It runs on identity registration and citizen points under the New Urban Management Act, and it forbids famiglia violence, smuggling, and vendettas.

For the city's first anniversary, City Hall revived Carnevale, a festival unused for sixty or seventy years. Once, anyone in a mask could do anything without being called to account, and the famiglie killed each other freely. Now the festival was given a new meaning: a celebration of new lives.

Acting Mayor **Leontuzzo** planned to formally declare himself mayor on the night of the parade. In the promotional film made for his inauguration, a trainee officer faces an armed famiglia and shouts these words.

blocks.who: Trainee officer in the promotional film
blocks.x: Nuova Volsinii has no place for famiglie!
1. Four Days Before the Festival

Supreme Justice **Lavinia** saw the announcement as a reckless declaration of war. The famiglie had only gone quiet; they had never given up on this city. And the Bellone son who had abandoned his famiglia was the best target they could ask for.

The night filming wrapped, Leontuzzo drove out to accept a dinner invitation from his old friend **Demetri**. Demetri now answered for what was left of the Bellone Family. They had not seen each other in a year, and Leontuzzo knew it would not be a pleasant reunion.
At an intersection just short of the restaurant, a large container truck slammed into his car and fled. The last thing he saw before losing consciousness was a blur of yellow: a taxi.

The yellow taxi belonged to **Lappland**, the White Wolf stripped of her surname by the Saluzzo Family. As it drove through the city on the eve of the festival, **Zaaro**, one of the Signori dei Lupi, pressed her to confirm that this round of the game would end soon. She answered that the reborn Carnevale would stay in the memory of every wolf forever.

blocks.cap: A taxi carrying a wolf from the wilds roams the city like a ghost.

blocks.x: Leontuzzo was taken to hospital and operated on, but he did not wake. The security cameras at the scene were broken, and on the corner stood the restaurant where Demetri had been waiting at a window seat.

Meanwhile, **Antonio**, the power behind Venezia Trucking, received word that the truck had been carrying their 'tires.' The Don's son-in-law, a Perro, did not hurry. He had his people kept in line, and his men held a witness, seized at the scene, inside the mansion.
2. The Friend Behind the Wheel

**Eirene**, leader of the Truckers' Union, had no patience for the famiglie's old ways. When a mafioso sneered that she ought to be asking 'which famiglia are you with,' she pointed at the sign above their heads.

blocks.cap: "You're in Nuova Volsinii."

blocks.x: The day after the crash, at Lavinia's request, Eirene went looking for the truck, starting with the Truckers' Union's own vehicles. That was how she found her oldest friend, **Sommer**, hiding at the camp. Sommer confessed that he had been driving the truck that night.
He said the wheel had suddenly stopped responding. Because the cargo bed held freight for the Venezia Family, he left the injured man in the road and hid the truck.

Sommer's daughter Guri had Oripathy. Sommer needed money for her treatment, and he was not the only one. Over six months, the Venezias had picked out drivers whose weaknesses they could hold over them, and those drivers had been hauling their cargo behind the Truckers' Union's back.

Eirene was an orphan in Sicilia, taken in at Sommer's small supermarket. When a small famiglia set fire to the shop and Guri contracted Oripathy, the two of them lost everything and fled to this city.
Eirene was handed a list of the drivers involved. The lighter Sommer always carried was one she had picked up near the site of that fire and given to him.
Meanwhile, **Texas**, an old friend who had come from Lungmen at Leontuzzo and Lavinia's invitation, arrived at the hospital room and offered to keep watch while Lavinia handled matters at the court.
Texas carried one more envelope. It was purple and empty, marked with a white wolf and a bunch of grapes.
3. The Burning Wolf

Eirene took the notebook with the list to the court to see Lavinia, and ended up sitting in on a citizen's petition. The man's brother had been beaten to death by a local famiglia on a business trip to Montelupe, but Nuova Volsinii's law had no force in other cities.
Nuova Volsinii's laws are strict and effective. But they're only strict in Nuova Volsinii, and only effective in Nuova Volsinii...
The man gave up his citizenship, saying he would take his revenge the Siracusan way. Eirene left the court almost at a run, the notebook still in her hands.

The driver of the taxi she climbed into in a daze was talkative. A mask worn because someone else forces it on you only suffocates you, the driver said, and everyone already knows the answer. Eirene changed her destination.

Where she went was Saluzzo Vino. Eirene offered to hand over the truck and its cargo if the Truckers' Union could be erased from the case. In return, the Don, **Alberto**, asked that the Truckers' Union do Saluzzo some 'favors' from then on.

She chose Saluzzo because it was Saluzzo that had crushed the famiglia behind that fire. Alberto told her that the moment she chose the most Siracusan way, she should have known that nothing goes as planned at a famiglia's table.
The next day, Eirene took Alberto to the port. Sommer had disguised the truck as a wolf and hidden it among the Carnevale parade floats. Before their eyes, the wolf went up in flames.

blocks.cap: A parade float modeled on the wolf of legend is swallowed by flames.

blocks.x: The police at the scene spotted collision damage on the burning cargo bed. The fire was far too conspicuous to be an attempt to destroy evidence. It looked like a declaration of war.
Wolves were watching the flames from afar. The Signori dei Lupi had each chosen a human Fang, and were playing a game in which the Fangs fought until only one was left.

The Fang of **Caesar**, one of the Signori dei Lupi, was the wolf hunter **Red**, who followed Caesar and called her 'Grandma.' Red kept hunting without knowing who Grandma really was. Only the Fang of **Vargo**, another of the Signori dei Lupi, had yet to show itself.
4. The Fox Comes Home

Around then, **Umberto**, the old tailor of the De Montano Tailor Shop, was finishing two suits ordered by a young lady of the Saluzzo Family. His grandson **Luchino**, who looked up to famiglia big shots, had even made buttons engraved with the Saluzzo crest without his grandfather knowing.
A Vulpo woman with a blade at her hip came to the shop. It was **Ingrid**, the killer who had betrayed the Venezia Family and vanished six years earlier.

blocks.cap: A Vulpo, back in Siracusa after six years.

blocks.x: Ingrid had made a deal with Vargo in Higashi. If she protected Umberto, Vargo's Fang, she would learn who had hurt her daughter **Lisa** long ago.
Meanwhile, Zaaro, already out of the game, went to Caesar and let slip that the last Fang, one who had scrubbed the scent of wolf from himself for decades, was Umberto.

On the night of the crash, Luchino had been on his way to deliver the suits when he saw the collision. **Capone** and **Gambino**, Venezia men waiting for the truck, dragged him away as the only witness, suit boxes and all.

That same night, in an alley nearby, Red was chasing another Fang, **Lunacub**. Ingrid, who meant to clear away any Fangs who might come for Umberto, stepped in, and the three scattered before the police arrived.
The next day, when his grandson had not come home all day, Umberto called Ingrid. Luchino, brought home from a farm at the age of three, was the only blood his dead son had left behind.
Meanwhile, at Saluzzo Vino, Lavinia sat down across from her prime suspect, Demetri. Demetri answered that Leon was his brother, and that he did not use such low methods.
That day Ingrid, drinking wine at a corner table, spoke to Lavinia. To the killer who said she had come back because of her daughter, Lavinia said this.
What Siracusa should revere is the law itself, not any particular person.
5. The Tailor's Past

The dashcam of a car parked near the scene that night showed a Vulpo with a blade. The next day, Lavinia took Ingrid into custody at the office of Rhodes Island, where Lisa worked, and also brought in Lunacub, who had been hiding in a vent there.
But Antonio soon arrived and guaranteed Ingrid's bail in the name of Venezia Trucking. Every demand met the regulations, so Lavinia could not refuse, and in the commotion Lunacub escaped.

Antonio called Ingrid his 'sister.' Six years ago, in the bloody fighting at Terni, she had pulled him out of a pile of corpses. He offered to tell her the truth of how Lisa was hurt if she came back to the famiglia. Ingrid refused.
Right after that, Capone and Gambino, under threat from Lappland, leaked where Luchino was, and Umberto went to the Venezia mansion with Ingrid.
There they found the old Don, **Fabrizio**, who had just arrived in Nuova Volsinii. He brought the captive Luchino to his grandfather himself.

Fabrizio was Umberto's old benefactor. As Umberto took his measurements with his grandson assisting, Luchino heard that his grandfather had once been the 'tagliatore,' a killer feared by every famiglia in Montelupe.

blocks.cap: The hands measuring his old benefactor were steadier than ever.

blocks.x: Umberto's son Luca had been found dead one morning with an actress, in a car leaving the city. Blood on one's hands from youth cannot be wiped away with any cloth, Umberto said, and he begged that his grandson at least be released from this life.
Fabrizio granted the request. On the way home, Luchino asked his grandfather to teach him how to sew on a button one more time.
Meanwhile, Ingrid had turned her blade on Antonio, who had no intention of ever releasing Luchino. Then Fabrizio appeared and stopped her, saying the Venezias do not draw blades on their own.

Ingrid had been a Vulpo orphan brawling in the park, a child Fabrizio took in as family by handing her the crest. When she left the famiglia after Lisa was hurt, he told her to keep the crest at least.
Now Ingrid laid the crest on the table and left the mansion, saying she would find and kill the person she had failed to find six years ago.

blocks.cap: "We are family." She sets down the crest that was both blessing and shackle.

blocks.x: 6. The Unlucky One

Some months earlier, **Lyudmila** had made her way back to Siracusa, a journey of more than two years after Reunion fell. She was going to see her master again: the one who had taken her in as a child, when famiglia reprisals wiped out her uncle's household, and taught her the blade and fire.

But her master lay bleeding, and in the shadows stood Red in her red hood. Lyudmila burned her master's body in the wilds and chased Red until she collapsed from exhaustion. Sommer, stopped by a broken-down truck, found her.
Eirene told her to leave once she woke up, but Sommer asked whether she could drive. Over the months that followed, Lyudmila grew close enough to the camp's drivers to share sodas with them.

blocks.cap: The camp's 'unlucky one' takes off her mask and accepts a salt soda.

blocks.x: And on the night of the crash, Lyudmila sat in the passenger seat as Sommer went to secretly haul Venezia cargo. Humming 'A Chance Encounter,' a song said to have been recorded for Carnevale, Sommer told her something Eirene always said.
Even the unluckiest people get looked after by life someday. It's just running a bit late.
As they entered the intersection, Red's blade and Lunacub's arrows, from the fight nearby, burst the truck's tires, and the truck plowed straight into Leontuzzo's car.

Lyudmila tumbled out of the truck and chased the vanishing red shadow, but Red pinned her down once again. Red left, saying she had no reason to kill someone who was not a Fang. Only then did Lyudmila remember she had left Sommer in the truck.

The next day, Lyudmila's citizenship certificate arrived. Eirene had gone back and forth between City Hall and the court countless times to vouch for her, and the drivers had co-signed her application.

With the papers tucked inside her coat, she searched for Sommer all day, and at the port she found the wolf-shaped parade float. Inside the tires in its cargo bed were guns, Arts staves, and Originium bombs.
The police and Venezia's men were closing in at the same time. With the drivers' new lives about to be exposed, Lyudmila remembered the first thing her master had taught her.
**Fire can hide anything.** It was she who set the wolf at the port alight.
7. A Deal in Court

On the night of the crash, Lappland and Zaaro had been looking down on that intersection from a rooftop. That night put the Acting Mayor, the Fangs, and a returning killer on one stage. When the collision came, Lappland called the police, posing as a taxi driver.

Two days before Carnevale, Lappland called Texas out of the hospital. The two met again in the rain and rode a taxi to stand before the burning wolf, where Lappland told her that Leontuzzo's crash had been pure chance.

blocks.cap: "The weather got me thinking about our old home. The nights and rain in Volsinii."

blocks.x: To the old friend whose intentions she could not read, Texas said she would keep an eye on her in Lavinia's place.

The next day, Eirene, who had been near the fire, stood trial for arson. Alberto took the witness stand and said she had been with him the whole time, and Antonio testified that the truck had been carrying his company's tires, which had cleared customs.
Eirene was acquitted, but she barely said a word in court. From the gallery, Texas saw that the courtroom had become a stage for two famiglie.
At the same time, Sommer took a business card someone had left in his trailer door and went to the Terza Zona at the port. Told he could help Eirene, he agreed to wait inside an empty container.
Lyudmila, following him, saw a Saluzzo man and a Venezia man sharing a smoke between the containers. In their hands was Sommer's gold lighter. Sommer never came back.

When the trial ended, Alberto's and Antonio's cars were waiting for Eirene in front of the court. Lyudmila pulled a truck in between them, picked her up, and handed her the lighter. Eirene understood why the two men had testified for her.
Her silence in court had already become a tacit agreement with the famiglie. Gripping the lighter, Eirene apologized to Sommer and swore she would never trust them again.
8. Two Orders

Lavinia, too, had seen the courts of old Volsinii in that trial whose paperwork alone was flawless. She decided to fight back with the law. She had Alberto temporarily detained for evading identity screening, and sent inspectors to the Venezia factories.

blocks.cap: Saluzzo Vino, raided by the police.

blocks.x: Antonio responded by banishing a longtime member from the city to answer for the lost tires, and asked the old Don for authority to make an emergency dispatch of the famiglia's landship. His plan was to abandon the order above the table he had kept for a year, and take the city on the night of Carnevale with the order underneath.

He brought up the time he had been a prisoner in Bolívar, when a drunk noble carelessly circled names on a list and sent half his comrades to their deaths. Signora Sicilia, who had handed over a whole city on the strength of four young people's speeches, was no different from that noble, he said, and he would take that power from her.
When Fabrizio rebuked him for disrupting the order, Antonio answered that Papa had grown old. On the night of Carnevale, he kept the old Don confined to the mansion.

That same day, Eirene pieced together Venezia's smuggling bit by bit from Sommer's notebook and driving logs. Realizing that the Truckers' Union was in fact the largest organization in the city, she gathered the drivers.

The only ones who will protect us are ourselves, Eirene said, even if that means violence. Lyudmila said she knew someone in Ursus who had held that belief and lost herself, and that she would not let Eirene cross the line.
9. The Long Carnevale
On the day of Carnevale, Venezia's men killed the port dispatcher and took his place. That night, the only thing allowed to approach the city was to be the famiglia's landship.
But Lappland, watching them from atop a crane, stopped Gambino and told him to bring the gift boxes, ribbons, and balloons she had left at the Venezia mansion.
When night fell, the parade began. Behind a dozen or so beast floats, hundreds of thousands of masked citizens filled the streets.

blocks.cap: Wolf, sheep, penguin, cat... the beasts of legend march through one city.

blocks.x: By then, Leontuzzo had woken in his hospital room. When he said he would go to the square to give his speech, Demetri said the men he had brought would escort him and that he had no say in it. Leontuzzo held out his hand to him.
Meanwhile, in the courthouse square, masked Venezia men took down the police guards and converged on the court. Just as Lavinia heard the news, trucks poured into the square.

The Truckers' Union's trucks lined up nose to tail and built a wall in front of the court. In the promotional film, a famiglia surrounded the court with trucks. Eirene had turned that scene on its head.

Eirene held out a list compiled from the drivers' testimony and asked for a ruling under emergency judicial procedures. The list was packed with names, not only from Venezia but from Saluzzo, the Medicis, and the Leotis as well. The moment it was signed, they would become felons whom anyone could execute without consequence.

When Lavinia asked what she truly wanted, Eirene answered that Sommer was dead and she had not even been able to find his body. The killer was not one person, she said, but a shadow that had followed them all the way to this city.
Then a huge landship pushed its way into the square. The steel giant shoved the trucks aside and came to a halt, draped from top to bottom in ribbons and balloons.

The one who took off her mask on deck was Lappland. Wearing the formal suit Umberto had embroidered with roses and fresh blood, she kicked the weapon crates over the edge one by one, and guns and Arts staves rained down on the courthouse square.

blocks.cap: In formal dress embroidered with roses and fresh blood, the White Wolf takes the stage.

blocks.x: Mafiosi and drivers alike scrambled to grab the weapons. When Texas crossed the court's rooftop and leapt down onto the deck, Lappland proposed a bet: when the parade arrived in fifteen minutes, which side would pull the trigger first?
10. The Last Suit, the Last Blade

At the same time, Red finally found De Montano. Umberto asked if he might finish his work while they talked, and facing an old man who carried no scent of wolf at all, Red did not reach for her blade right away.
Even after becoming Vargo's Fang, Umberto had put off the hunt. First he asked for time to raise his son, and after his son died, time to raise his grandson. Meanwhile, he grew old and sick.

Around then, it was Vargo who told this story to Luchino. Luchino had tailed Gambino and slipped aboard the landship, and when his attempt to blow up the weapons failed, Vargo broke the Signori dei Lupi's decision not to interfere and saved the boy.
Whatever you want to become, Vargo told him, do your buttons up properly first. And go to your grandfather, right now.

Meanwhile, Umberto hung the last suit on the wall and lay down on the sofa. He looked back on what he had been: a bloodstained killer, a father who had lost his child, a Fang who never entered the game.
But at least I was a good tailor, and a lucky old man.
With his last words leaving the finishing touches to Luchino, the old man breathed his last. Red never needed to raise her dagger.

blocks.cap: Having finished his last suit, the old man closed his eyes.

blocks.x: All that was left to Red was the old man's question: once she had killed every Fang, where would she go, and what would she do?

Meanwhile, Antonio, on his way to the port, was betrayed by Capone and came face to face with Ingrid in an alley. The attack that hurt Lisa six years ago had never been an assassination attempt. Antonio had staged it, aiming at Ingrid's one weakness, to drive her out of the famiglia.
Antonio opened a gap with flash Arts, but his knife only pierced the omamori at Ingrid's belt. Ingrid stabbed him, deliberately missing the heart, told him to bleed out slowly, and left.

blocks.cap: The mother's blade missed the heart on purpose.

blocks.x: The one standing before you is Ingrid. Just a mother.
By then, Lavinia had refused to the end to sign the ruling. Her answer was that the more powerless the law is in a given moment, the less she can let it become someone's tool.

Yet Eirene told the drivers that the ruling had been made. When she told the armed drivers to aim ahead, Lyudmila, who had been planning to get everyone out under a smokescreen, suddenly felt she did not know her.

blocks.cap: "Point it in front of you, Pedro."

blocks.x: The parade was nearly at the square. The two armed crowds stood divided like the banks of a river, and all that remained was a single gunshot.
11. The Gunshot

The gunshot rang out not in the square but in an alley. Antonio had been bleeding his way toward the square, and the one who pressed a muzzle to his forehead was the very man he had banished. Antonio died where he stood.

While everyone in the square froze, Eirene stepped out in front of the line and set down her crossbow. Both sides had simply hurried to clear away the weapons the White Wolf had scattered, she said, and proposed that they serve as each other's witnesses.
A few minutes later, the famiglie and the drivers had hidden the weapons in the truck beds and stood side by side to welcome the parade.
At the same time, Fabrizio stopped his car at an intersection and picked up that man. It was he who had ordered Antonio's quiet execution. His son-in-law's affair was settled by Venezia's rules.

Meanwhile, Red set a trap and brought Lunacub down. Then Grandma's voice confessed that all its promises had been lies to make her hunt. Red was a Fang too, it said, and since not every Fang was dead yet, Grandma had not been saved.
Up on deck, Lappland applauded and conceded the bet to Texas, yet said that this was still the swamp called Siracusa, and that Siracusans turn even new land into a swamp.

Lappland called Texas a true idealist, and Texas did not deny it. Following the old Carnevale rule that the loser is unmasked, Lappland handed over her own mask, and the citizens in the square cheered, taking the two of them for special guests of the finale.
Siracusa makes all of us wear masks, after all.

blocks.cap: After a long hesitation, Texas raises a hand.

blocks.x: Texas said she had wanted to see a city truly alive in the middle of the swamp, and that she would no longer run from it but stand with her friends. Lappland promised to take the wolves off into the wilds, and walked deep into the landship.
Then Leontuzzo arrived at the square under Demetri's escort. In his speech, he admitted that the city still had many problems, and said he would walk that thorny path together with everyone.

blocks.cap: "Folks, I'm Leontuzzo."

blocks.x: Watching him from behind, Demetri said the Bellones would come into this city. In their own way, but by Leon's rules.
Epilogue. Amending the Act

As Carnevale drew to a close, Lyudmila caught Red wandering the alleys with nowhere to go and put the tip of her blade to her heart. Muttering that Grandma and the stories were all lies, Red pushed herself toward the blade instead.
What stopped the blade was a baby tooth Red kept on her. Kal'tsit had told Red to hold on to it herself until she found her answer.

blocks.cap: Before the wolf hunter kneeling in the rain, the Reproba steps back.

blocks.x: Lyudmila found Lunacub, whom Red had stabbed while missing the vital points, and kept her alive. Then, telling Red not to die before she had confronted Kal'tsit herself, she decided to take Red to Rhodes Island.

Meanwhile, Lappland visited Alberto in prison and tossed him a gift box. Inside was a suit by Umberto, even more splendid than hers. Saluzzo Vino began an internal investigation in the hands of its first cooperating partner, Demetri.
The morning after Carnevale, Fabrizio presented City Hall with records showing Antonio's people had been cut loose, and asked that Ingrid be allowed to leave the city safely.

Lavinia did not stop Ingrid from leaving, but she issued a warrant for her under the New Urban Management Act. Ingrid, bound for Rhodes Island to see Lisa, asked whether she might look forward to meeting the judge again.

At City Hall, Leontuzzo refused Eirene's resignation. Hundreds of drivers had sent a joint petition asking that her mistake not be held against her, and City Hall was about to bring the Truckers' Union into the city's administrative system.
Finding the right direction isn't hard. What's hard is walking that road to the end.

Before leaving, Lyudmila asked Eirene what she had been thinking when she ordered the drivers to take aim. Having once failed to stop a leader she admired from changing, Lyudmila said she would now keep watch over Eirene.
I'm watching you, Eirene. I'm the sword that hangs above your head.

Meanwhile, Lappland confessed to Zaaro that the promise she made Texas had been a lie. She said power was the true wolf pack, and the Signori dei Lupi accepted her as their alpha, knowing that her Oripathy meant she would not live long.

blocks.cap: "The wilderness keeps its promises. Just wait."

blocks.x: And Texas, in the name of Penguin Logistics, became an outside consultant for Nuova Volsinii's logistics. Leontuzzo set off for Montelupe to see Signora Sicilia, carrying a new plan to extend the reach of the New Urban Management Act.

The Sankta priest traveling with him had been sent by Signora Sicilia, but he had done nothing in this city. As his reason, he named Umberto, the old friend he met on the night of Carnevale. When the priest asked his wish, Umberto had answered that the young have futures of their own.
'Nuova Volsinii has no place for famiglie.' The line from the promotional film is not yet entirely true. Even so, with its mask off, this city has set out on the thorny path toward those words.

act37side.tagline: A street brawler who helped take back Londinium becomes Speaker of Parliament, then walks on alone, setting aside both the crown and her place beside her friends. Still, the Glasgow Gang will always be here.

chars.name: Vina
chars.desc: Leader of the Glasgow Gang in the back alleys of Norport, nicknamed 'Siege.' After the war she becomes Speaker of the Londinium Parliament · Operator Vina Victoria

chars.name: Morgan
chars.desc: The Glasgow Gang's strategist and chatterbox. She is the one writing this memoir.

chars.name: Indra
chars.desc: The Glasgow Gang's muscle. Real name Hannah Jackson.

chars.name: Dagda
chars.desc: The Glasgow Gang's sculptor and housekeeper. Rumored to have once guarded the old royal palace.

chars.name: Baird
chars.desc: The Glasgow Gang's peacemaker. When everyone else leaves, she alone stays behind in Norport.

chars.name: Delphine
chars.desc: Daughter of the House of Windermere and a Rhodes Island operator. Stays at Vina's side as her aide after she becomes Speaker.

chars.name: Allerdale
chars.desc: The last descendant of the fallen House of Cumberland. Shares a long history with Vina.

chars.name: Gawain
chars.desc: The teacher who taught Vina how to survive. Takes the form of a golden lion.

chars.name: Horn
chars.desc: A soldier who fought alongside the Exemplars. Reorganizes Londinium's Defense Forces after the war.

chars.name: Diane Weber
chars.desc: A veteran, formerly a lieutenant in the ducal allied forces. Becomes a guide for Eliseo, newly arrived from Columbia.

chars.name: Eliseo
chars.desc: A medical-supplies negotiator sent by Columbia's Pure Heart Medical · Operator Bobbing

chars.name: Shearer
chars.desc: A retired lieutenant who served as a medic in the Exemplars.

chars.name: Feist
chars.desc: An engineer who came up from Norport's factory workers. Led the Self-Salvation Corps with his grandmother Catherine · Operator Stainless

chars.name: Catherine
chars.desc: An elder among the factory workers. Led the Self-Salvation Corps with her grandson Feist.

chars.name: Eleanor
chars.desc: The Earl of March, spoken of as heir to the Duke of Normandy. Known as 'the Young Duke.'

chars.name: Duke of Caster
chars.desc: One of Victoria's grand dukes. Deeply involved in deciding where postwar Londinium goes.

chars.name: Duke of Gododdin
chars.desc: One of Victoria's grand dukes. A realist who misses the balls of the old monarchy.

terms.name: Exemplars
terms.desc: The special unit Vina led. People of every rank and background banded together in it to fight the battle to retake Londinium.

terms.name: Glasgow Gang
terms.desc: Vina's old gang, based in Londinium's Norport district.

terms.name: Millscar
terms.desc: A mysterious criminal organization that took over Londinium's underworld after the war, and also the codename of its leader.

terms.name: Sineselde
terms.desc: A banquet hall once owned by the royal family. After the war it became the chamber of the new Londinium Parliament.

terms.name: Pure Heart Medical
terms.desc: A Columbian pharmaceutical company. It sent Eliseo to Londinium as a negotiator.

terms.name: Sighs of Kings
terms.desc: A sword handed down in the Victorian royal family. Broken in battle, it was reforged by the hands of workers.

terms.name: Knights of the Tower
terms.desc: The knights who once guarded the old Victorian royal palace.

terms.name: Steam Knight
terms.desc: Armored warriors who guarded the Victorian royal family. Charles Lynch is the last to carry the title.

terms.name: Unicorn
terms.desc: A mysterious being from Victorian legend. Said to have granted people's wishes from behind the scenes of history for centuries.

terms.name: Alistair II
terms.desc: The last king of Victoria, deposed and executed by the dukes twenty-six years ago. Vina's father.

blocks.x: After the war, **Morgan**, the Glasgow Gang's strategist, began writing a book. She spent a long time searching for something to compare history to, and in the end she remembered what her old friend Dagda used to say.

History is like a sailing ship adrift, and every age sees its share of experienced helmsmen who think to change its course... But in the end, none will truly ever know where the sunset and the river will take them.
A story of a street thug who becomes a hero, and of a royal heir who left the palace and comes home. It begins one summer, the summer they left Londinium, in a factory in Norport.

blocks.cap: Morgan's notebook. Vina, Indra, Dagda, Baird, and Morgan.

blocks.x: 1. That Summer, Fire in Norport

At the heart of the Glasgow Gang, based out of a back-alley boxing gym in Norport, were five people: the leader, **Vina**; **Indra**, who led with her fists; quiet **Dagda**; **Baird**, who always kept the peace; and Morgan.
On the day Morgan lost a bet naming nomadic cities and had to drink the penalty, Indra raised her glass and said that one day Glasgow would be the hero of all Londinium.

blocks.cap: On the overpass linking the factories. That summer, before they had lost anything.

blocks.x: Around then, workers at a Norport factory who stood up to the new foreman were dying one after another under strange circumstances. Searching the factory, Vina and the others found Originium weapons of unknown origin. Realizing that the Duke of Cavendish's people were secretly stockpiling arms in Londinium, Vina set the factory on fire to expose it.

Then, in the street with the flames at her back, Earl Morrill, a guest of House Cavendish, stopped her. "Alexandrina. Your Royal Highness." He offered to spare her friends if she came with him. Vina beat him until he was barely breathing.

Before the bewildered gang, Dagda revealed the truth. Vina was the daughter of the late King **Alistair II**: Alexandrina Vina Victoria. Baird said she would stay behind alone and look after home, and told Vina she must come back one day to repay what she owed Norport.
I swear. I swear I'll come back.

Not long after, **Allerdale** of House Cumberland came to the gym. In a blurry photo in a police file, she had recognized the heir to the throne she had seen in person years before. Vina was already gone. As Allerdale turned to leave, a strange voice echoed in her head: "You will meet Vina again, someday."
2. Two Months After the War

Years passed. The war to take Londinium back from the Sarkaz was over, and Vina, as leader of the **Exemplars**, the unit called the miracle of that war, had become Speaker of the Londinium Parliament.

Two months after the Sarkaz army withdrew, the city was overflowing with the Infected, and there was nowhere near enough medicine. An underground organization, **'Millscar'**, moved into that gap, selling medicine that barely worked and pushing brutal contracts on people with nowhere else to turn.

On the day Madam Major, the official in charge of aid for the Infected, was found dead, Morgan beat up some reporters digging for a conspiracy. Vina told her, "There are some things Siege could do that this so-called Speaker can't."

When **Delphine**, daughter of the House of Windermere, reported that Millscar's medicine was pushing people into deeper suffering, Vina answered briefly: "Allerdale knows." The ruler of Londinium's underworld and the last light of House Cumberland: **the two names had already become one.**

Then, before the new Parliament, now seated in the **Sineselde**, a former royal banquet hall, a Sarkaz named Longshot was dragged in for badly injuring a merchant. The man Vina had let go two months earlier put a question to the whole chamber.
Are Sarkaz born and bred in Londinium, who have never left the city, still considered Victorians?
The chamber went quiet, and Morgan waited for Vina's answer. Just as she had two months earlier, on the city wall, watching the Sarkaz forces leave.

blocks.cap: The Sarkaz forces leaving Londinium. From the wall, Vina watched them go in silence.

blocks.x: That day, Morgan asked how the Sarkaz who had killed Baird could walk away so proudly. Vina said nothing.
3. A Sword in the Stone Floor

Right after the war, in a dusty hall of the Palace of Westhaleg, **Eleanor**, the Earl of March known as the Young Duke, together with the **Duke of Gododdin** and the **Duke of Caster**, offered Vina the Speaker's seat. The condition was that they would be the ones to judge whether she was fit for it.
Vina drew her sword. It was the **Sighs of Kings**, shattered in the mud of the battlefield and reforged by workers who used Vina's hammer as its main material.

blocks.cap: "And when I made it back, what did I find?"

blocks.x: What Vina had found was not a mighty empire. It was an Infected child learning to box to defend their home, and a drunkard handing over hidden liquor for a soldier on the operating table.
Sewers too, may bloom. And so, here, at least, in my home... I will NOT be lectured by the likes of you!

Vina drove the sword into the stone floor. The dukes knew it was a provocation and laughed it off anyway. What they wanted was not the late king's blood, but the face of the 'miracle' that was the Exemplars.

Afterward, a golden lion appeared in the empty throne room. **Gawain**, Vina's teacher, told the Doctor of Rhodes Island that he had taught Vina how to survive, but could not teach her how to be someone else's hope, and asked the Doctor to take her by the hand.

Back in the present Parliament. Longshot's daughter had been helping Sarkaz escape, and it was Millscar who got them out of the city. Longshot shouted that the people sitting there were more despicable than any Sarkaz, and he was hanged.

Around the same time, **Eliseo**, a negotiator from Columbia's **Pure Heart Medical**, arrived in Londinium. Asking the way to Madam Major, he learned from a veteran named Diane that Major had died that morning.
4. The Name That Chose to Live
Meanwhile, underground, as Millscar was sending Sarkaz families out of the city, an old Sarkaz woman asked her real name. Not a codename she could throw away at any time. "...Allerdale."

It was a name that should have been laid to rest in the Mausoleum of Kings. In the hollow the Steam Knight left behind, Allerdale had wished to die, forgotten by everyone she had betrayed. But in the end she followed a single ray of light and chose to live.

Near the end of the war, thirty-four minutes before the Exemplars broke through the blockade. Acting on a tip from Rhodes Island, Allerdale found blood-red Sarkaz altars hidden underground, along with the body of an officer serving under the Earl of March. As she went on destroying the altars, she came face to face with Clovisia, whom she had believed dead.
It was Clovisia who had spread the rumor that the dukes meant to abandon Londinium. "You've chosen to live. Then follow the path, and see where it leads."

And the moment the Exemplars entered the city, factories all across Londinium roared and released their steam. The people still in the city had lit every furnace, and Allerdale's people were among them.

Among the allied forces blocking the way, one lieutenant lowered her crossbow first. That soldier, **Diane Weber**, defied the duke's orders, saying that before she was a soldier, she was a Londinier born here.

blocks.cap: The afternoon the factories roared as one. Vina looked back and said, "We're home."

blocks.x: As the hot wind hid Vina's tears, Morgan grew afraid. Afraid that coming home meant parting. Afraid of losing Vina.

Two days later, a box with no sender arrived for Vina. Inside were royal garments of old, recovered from the ruins of Cumberland Manor, photographs of evidence concerning a certain duke, and a note: "Tailored to your size. Hope it fits."

blocks.cap: The crest of the House of Victoria, revealed in the light of dawn.

blocks.x: **Allerdale is alive.** And when Vina put on those garments, citizens crowded around her, crying, "Her Royal Highness Alexandrina has returned!" Surrounded by them, Vina drifted away from Morgan.
5. The Chamber at Six O'Clock

Back in the present Parliament. When Lieutenant **Horn** reported that complaints about Millscar had passed two hundred, Vina convened a provisional court and gave Millscar the chance to defend herself. The deadline was two hours away, when that day's session ended.

Vina, who would not leave the chamber, snapped at Delphine for telling her to rest, then apologized at once. "I'm not doing a good enough job." Delphine answered that what moves a nomadic city is the tracks underneath it, and that she did not have to pull everything along by herself.

Meanwhile, underground, Mrs. Lawrence, the wife of Exemplar soldier Mickey Robinson, had been dragged in. Her husband had died of an Oripathy attack without proper treatment, leaving only the debt she had signed in his place.
Two minutes before the deadline, a bloodied Mrs. Lawrence was carried into the chamber. Millscar's people had done it. "This is her answer."

blocks.cap: Six o'clock. Where she should have stood, there were only two black feathers.

blocks.x: Vina issued a warrant for Millscar, dead or alive, and promised to reorganize the police within a month and lift the curfew. The law, she said, would treat everyone equally.

That night, as Millscar walked the streets, a car carrying House Cumberland's garments pulled up beside her and offered her a chance to come back. "Tell her that Cumberland has died. One who has already died is not afraid to die again."
From a radio in a roadside shop came the news that hundreds of letters thanking the Speaker had piled up within a few hours. Now more people would believe that the Speaker could keep them safe.
I hope you like my final gift to you, Alexandrina... After this, we're even.
6. The Exemplars in the Underground Bar
Around then, former Exemplars gathered in an underground bar, drinking from morning to night. Lieutenant **Shearer**, once their medic, sent a letter from there, but the busy Speaker never read it.

blocks.cap: The underground bar where soldiers with no home to return to gather.

blocks.x: When Vina finally came to the bar, the soldiers asked whether the Exemplars were being disbanded. As Shearer was saying that what they waited for was not a better life but the next order, the next battlefield, the glass slipped from his hand.

His hand had started shaking beneath the city walls. Ten days into the siege, while the dukes still would not move, the Duke of Wellington's warship, the Gastrell, poured violet Draco fire onto Londinium's walls from the middle of the allied camp.

In the chaos, Shearer stayed behind to carry the wounded, even giving away his own protective gear. The nurse Sarah used her Arts to stop a witchcraft bomb, but both of them collapsed in thick Originium dust.

Shearer returned to his unit clutching painkillers. At the access port in the wall, the soldiers sang songs of Victoria and wished for more flower shops, to become good police officers, for their mothers to be waiting when they got home. And many of them fell right at the threshold of home, and never came out again.
Back in the bar, Vina answered. "I can tell you that I'm not happy." Parliament feared the Exemplars would become Vina's private army, and she could not go over Parliament's head to answer them.

That day Morgan stayed behind, listening to her comrades, and for the first time since the war drank until she passed out. Then, to Hannah, who came to take her home, she asked the question she had never managed to ask Vina.
When can we go home, back to our gym?
7. What Fists Cannot Solve

A few days later, Matthew, the owner of a factory that had shut down, blocked Vina's way in the street. When one factory closes, hundreds of families die, he said, yet the precious suppressants go to dying wounded soldiers; he offered to work out the 'economic rationality' for the Speaker. In that moment, Vina's fist hit him in the nose.
In the eyes of the people around them there was neither hostility nor anger. Those eyes made Vina see her own powerlessness, and a long-forgotten lollipop case fell from her pocket.
Not all problems can be solved by your fists... 'Siege.'
That evening the radio reported that the Speaker had rejected a man attempting to bribe her in the most direct manner possible.

Later, in her office, Vina told **Feist**, an engineer who came up from the factory floor, about the promise she had made with his grandmother **Catherine**. The weapons the workers had secretly built during the war would stay in their hands, because Parliament, and Vina herself, needed someone watching over them.
One day, when the Glasgow Gang came over with snacks, Indra asked without thinking when they would be going back to the gym. No one answered, and Vina's eyes stayed on her stack of papers.

Meanwhile Shearer, who had been overusing painkillers, collapsed in the street on his way to the Speaker's office. In the evening glow he saw the burning walls again, and, as on that day, a hand reaching out to him.

blocks.cap: "I have been waiting for you, Lieutenant."

blocks.x: Delphine knew about the letter he had sent Vina, and that he had been deliberately avoiding her. She ordered him to go home to Lynncardine, and said she would go back with him.
The war is over, Lieutenant. Every soldier should go home.
8. The Dinnertime Declaration, and a Missing Crown
Meanwhile, Dagda was carving a memorial to stand in front of the **Knights of the Tower** Museum. Among the names of her old comrades, she had carved her own: **Isabelle Montague**.
But Dagda said that Londinium no longer had Isabelle, Knight of the Tower. There was only Dagda of the Glasgow Gang. Around the city, rumors were spreading that Vina Victoria would take the throne.

On an evening just before the new year, in a radio address that came to be called the 'Dinnertime Declaration,' Vina announced that the Exemplars' unit designation would be preserved forever. Having achieved its ideal of going home, the unit had reached its end.

The broadcast cut off at the words "in this coming future without a king..." At that moment Eleanor appeared in Parliament and whispered to Vina that some things must not be said in front of commoners. Then, during the meeting with the dukes that followed, news arrived that the crown had been stolen from the throne room.

And in the Speaker's office, the person sitting with her head bowed before the recovered crown was Diane, the veteran who had been guiding Eliseo. Diane said that what Londinium needed now was not a Speaker watched over by Parliament, but a king of Victoria.
Vina said the provisional court would judge her according to the law. Diane saluted without objection. "I won't live to see that day myself."

Afterward, Vina carried the crown to the throne room and sat down, not on the throne but on the steps before it. The golden lion came over and let her lean against his great body. Just like when she was a child.

blocks.cap: The throne room of the Palace of Westhaleg. Vina sat not on the throne, but on the steps before it.

blocks.x: Vina confided in her teacher. So many people already depended on her that she could not show weakness, not to Morgan, not to Delphine.

After the lion left, Morgan handed over a report. Diane Weber was the lieutenant who had been first to lower her crossbow that day. She had suffered an acute infection in the final battle and did not have long to live.
Because she knew how Speaker Vina Victoria would answer, Morgan never managed to ask her to pardon Diane. And she made up her mind. It was time to go home, back to the gym.
9. The Sword Passed from Hand to Hand
Morgan and Vina remember the moment that war ended as the same scene: when everyone took up Vina's sword and swung it at the Nachzehrer King.
At dawn on the day of the final battle, Vina handed the Sighs of Kings to a soldier about to charge in barehanded. When the soldier said she could not possibly accept it, Vina told her:
No. This is the sword of Victoria. ...Pass it to the hands of everyone who can wield it. Let the sword fulfill its mission.

blocks.cap: The soldier who took the sword saw, that day, a monarch walking alongside her people.

blocks.x: That soldier, Diane Weber, cut down three enemies while singing, then passed the sword on. A worker died taking an elite down with him. An Infected citizen could not cut down a single enemy, but guarded the sword to the end. At last the sword vanished into the battlefield, lodged in the Nachzehrer King's body.
Meanwhile the last Steam Knight, **Charles Lynch**, charged into the fog, and Catherine burst up from underground driving the enormous Crawler, built from her grandson's design.

When the fighting ended, Vina went into the Palace of Westhaleg alone. When she finally walked out, there was no crown on her head as people had hoped; in her hand was the Sarkaz flag she had torn down. She called out to spare those who surrendered and not to repay hatred with hatred, then raised her hammer high.
We have liberated Londinium, liberated Victoria!
Amid the cheering, Charles Lynch, who had stood guard before the palace the whole time, saw Victoria's flag shining with the sun, and fell.

blocks.cap: In the first light of dawn, the last Steam Knight falls.

blocks.x: Allerdale stepped into that steam and recovered the core of the hero she had once looked up to, hearing his last words: 'For Victoria.' Then, certain that Vina was watching her from the distant steps, she disappeared beyond the white steam. "Londinium does not need any more heroes, Vina."
10. The End of the Fairy Tale

When Diane's sentence became known, the city was in an uproar. When Eliseo asked her to reconsider, Delphine answered that the only ones who ever spoke of letting merits offset crimes were the kings of Victoria.

The day before the execution, Vina visited Diane in her cell and delivered Parliament's decision in person. Diane wept, saying that only now was she afraid to die, and asked to hear one last fairy tale before she was completely drunk: what had happened inside the palace that day.

That day, on the throne in the throne room sat a king in a golden mask: her father, Alistair II, who had gone to the gallows twenty-six years earlier. He commanded her to put on the crown and proclaim the king's return, and to punish every coward who had defied the royal house.

blocks.cap: "My Alexandrina! You're finally home."

blocks.x: Vina answered that bloodline was not the source of power. "I just want you to rest in peace, Father." Then she gripped her hammer and climbed the steps.

Then, from the shadows behind the throne, stepped the **Unicorn**, who in Victorian legend grants wishes. It was Clovisia, a tailor's daughter and a leader of the Self-Salvation Corps. The Unicorn offered to lend Vina her power if she chose the role she wanted, king or Speaker.
Why should I have to choose the Unicorn?

The fools out there, Vina said, who look out only for themselves yet will throw their lives away for a single mouthful, were her Victoria. The Unicorn left, saying that Vina was a fool too, just like her father.

When the story ended, Diane was asleep. Vina told her that Victoria no longer needed a monarch, and wished her good dreams. That night Diane dreamed of a king's coronation, and of workers waving their hats as they walked out the factory gates at the end of the day.

The next day, the Glasgow Gang went back to Norport. Delphine said it would be all right to ask them to stay, but Vina let them go, and they did not go to see Diane's end. Word was that because her infection was so severe, Diane had been executed alone.

At that hour, Vina sat across from the dukes. She made them open the long-delayed medical supply routes, informed them that Londinium would resume diplomacy in the name of 'Victoria,' and turned down Eleanor's deal with a few photographs found underground. When Caster asked whether it had been right to entrust her with the Speakership, Vina answered that this was her own choice, not something they had entrusted to her.

When Vina came out of the meeting, a crowd begging her to spare Diane surrounded her, but she answered that Parliament's decision would not change. Then, one by one, they gathered before the steps: Catherine and the workers, Shearer leading the people from the Sanatorium, soldiers marching and singing, and the children Morgan had sent.

Vina sank down onto the steps, and a child asked her whether they were going to have a king. Vina answered that having no king was not a bad thing, and that the child would understand when they grew up.

blocks.cap: When the Speaker sat down on the steps, the people sat down beside her.

blocks.x: That day, in a citywide broadcast, Parliament announced that the crown would be kept and guarded in the throne room. If a candidate for king ever appeared, the matter would go to a national referendum.
Epilogue. To Glasgow

Norport had changed a great deal. Their old haunts were gone, and Baird's name was nowhere in the cemetery. Cador, an old gang member who had been looking after the gym, returned Baird's butterfly knife before leaving to find new turf.
They never found Baird, but on the wall where the knife had turned up, her handwriting remained: "I hope so too." They hung the knife on the wall and drank slowly, waiting for one more person.

Meanwhile, underground, Millscar was handing the body of a condemned prisoner over to Eliseo, something impossible without someone looking the other way. As long as this person stayed alive in the city, she said, she would one day become a blade turned against Vina. Take her as far away as possible.
To die like a hero, or to live on and watch yourself become a villain. When Eliseo raised the question, Allerdale asked back whether that applied only to her.

And on a grassland outside the city, Diane opened her eyes. To those who watched the execution, she had certainly died, but several of her vital organs had already crystallized into Originium. Eliseo said the Speaker had known this in advance, and let the rest go unsaid.
"So it was Vina who let me go? That's rather foolish of her." Diane could never return to Londinium. Eliseo made her a promise: when the day came, he would bring her home, back to Londinium.
The next morning, Morgan woke up on the gym's sofa to a familiar scolding. Didn't I tell you not to drink like that? It was Vina.

blocks.cap: "Vina, you came back!"

blocks.x: She had left Parliament's business with Horn and slipped away. That day Vina never once said she had to go back, and at sunset they raced to the overpass like they used to.

blocks.cap: On the overpass once more. This time, Delphine was with them.

blocks.x: Indra set aside a glass for Baird. To Baird, to Glasgow, and the last glass Vina raised, to Victoria.

Vina said there was still work she could do. She wanted the people of Londinium to laugh the way they did, without tears or hunger; Vina or Alexandrina, it was all the same to her. When she said that Baird, had she been there, would surely have wanted her to do this, a voice they missed answered.
You're right, Vina. I really do hope so...

The next morning, Vina changed into the clothes Morgan hated and left alone for Central Londinium. No one saw her off, but in truth everyone was awake, and Morgan wrote down everything about that day, hoping Vina would read it someday.
I'm sorry. There's no way for us to help you, or to stay by your side... But I want you to know this. We will always be here. The Glasgow Gang will always be here. To you, Vina Victoria.
History is a sailing ship adrift, and no one knows where it will go. But everyone in the Glasgow Gang knows where Vina, who boarded that ship alone, will one day come home to.

act36side.tagline: A gourmet party on its way to rescue a sister eaten by the Red Dragon tumbles onto the unfamiliar land of Terra, and eats its way from Originium Slugs all the way to the High Priest's bathwater while hunting for Rhodes Island. And then: the same memories that the same dishes bring back.

chars.name: Laios
chars.desc: The party's leader, obsessed with monster cuisine. A sword-wielding fighter. (Delicious in Dungeon)

chars.name: Marcille
chars.desc: An elf mage. Falin's best friend, and she can't stand monster cooking. (Delicious in Dungeon)

chars.name: Senshi
chars.desc: A dwarf cook who roams the Dungeon. He always treats his ingredients with the utmost care. (Delicious in Dungeon)

chars.name: Chilchuck
chars.desc: A half-foot locksmith. The party's voice of reason, and its designated sufferer. (Delicious in Dungeon)

chars.name: Falin
chars.desc: Laios's younger sister and Marcille's best friend. She was eaten by the Red Dragon, and bringing her back is the party's goal. (Delicious in Dungeon)

chars.name: Ceobe
chars.desc: A Rhodes Island operator. Always hungry.

chars.name: Big Bob
chars.desc: A heavily armored giant who runs an Originium Slug farm in the wasteland. The party's first benefactor.

chars.name: High Priest
chars.desc: A sage wrapped in mystery, revered by the Archosauria. He builds mechs.

chars.name: Oakcup
chars.desc: An apprentice shaman from Sami. Unbothered by pretty much everything.

chars.name: Arges
chars.desc: A cyclops who foresees nothing but disaster.

chars.name: Ryan
chars.desc: A Rhodes Island field operator, nicknamed 'Little Hammer.'

chars.name: Mudrock
chars.desc: A Rhodes Island operator. Big Bob's friend.

chars.name: Eunectes
chars.desc: A Rhodes Island operator. She helps out with the High Priest's mech tests.

chars.name: Amiya
chars.desc: The leader of Rhodes Island. A caster who can read emotions.

terms.name: the Dungeon
terms.desc: The dungeon where Laios's party adventured. Said to have been shaped by the 'Lunatic Magician' with vast magical power, and it's crawling with monsters.

terms.name: Bob's Gourmet Guide
terms.desc: A notebook Big Bob gave the party. It records whether all sorts of Terran creatures are edible.

blocks.x: Deep in the Dungeon, just as the Red Dragon was about to eat them, **Laios**'s younger sister **Falin** used her magic to send the party out of the Dungeon, and was swallowed by the dragon herself. To save her before she got digested, the party went straight back into the Dungeon with next to nothing, deciding to live off the monsters they'd cook along the way.

Then one day, Laios woke up in a strange land of open sky, sunshine, and forest. The spirits won't answer the elf mage **Marcille**, the dwarf cook **Senshi** starts by feeling the soil, and the half-foot locksmith **Chilchuck** comes back with good news ('there's not a single monster around') and bad news ('this isn't anywhere we know') at the same time.
And the gourmet party's journey to find their way home begins, as always, with 'let's try eating it first.'
1. Bugs Under the Stones, an Armored Orc in the Hut

Near a hut outside the forest that Chilchuck had scouted, a black stone at Marcille's feet started to wriggle. Every stone lying around was actually a bug wearing a rocky shell: an Originium Slug. Marcille drove the bugs off with an explosion spell and tried to hide in the hut, only for a heavily armored orc wielding a giant blade to come out from inside, and the party ran for their lives.

blocks.cap: Chilchuck, carried in Senshi's arms: "I know how to run too! Put me down already!"

blocks.x: But that orc was only knocking out the bugs, not people. When Laios ventured an awkward 'Um... hi?', he introduced himself as **Big Bob**. Turns out this place was an Originium Slug farm, and the party were trespassers who had woken up someone else's livestock and made a total mess of things.

Told that Originium Slugs are edible, Laios and Senshi both shouted 'Really?' at the same time. Starve them for five days to empty their stomachs, blanch them, peel the shells, then rub them with salt and rinse five times: all that effort produced a spicy stir-fry. Senshi answered back with a dish of his own, the shells stuffed with meat and garlic butter and roasted.

blocks.cap: Spicy Originium Slug stir-fry, shell-roasted slugs, and Originium Slug beer.

blocks.x: One bite and Laios yelled 'Delicious!!', and even the squeamish Marcille caved in the end. But Marcille, who'd been in a hurry the whole time, had something else on her mind. Everyone seemed so laid-back that it looked like nobody had any intention of getting back to Falin, and that made her anxious.

After hearing their story, Big Bob declared 'I don't understand a word of it!' but still handed over a notebook listing what's edible and what isn't, **Bob's Gourmet Guide**. He pointed them to Rhodes Island as a place that might help, and asked them to say hi to his friend **Mudrock**. Once the party had left, every last bit of the leftovers had vanished, and somewhere a voice could be heard: 'These Originium Slug things are yummy when you boil 'em~'
2. A Stew to Summon the High Priest (Main Ingredient: the High Priest)

In the jungle they entered next, Marcille blasted away something golem-like that charged at them, and out came the gator-headed Archosauria. What she'd just wrecked was a mech built by their **High Priest**, but apparently that's fine, since 'it always blows up anyway.' He's the only one who knows the way, but he only shows up where things get rowdy, so Senshi decides to throw a big feast.

Meanwhile, Marcille, wandering the forest alone, found berries that looked exactly like the raspberries Falin once gave her. A little later, she starts raining spells down on the village, screaming 'There you are, Red Dragon! Give Falin back!!!'

She'd been poisoned, and everyone looked like the Red Dragon to her. When Laios proved he was the real Laios with the very shriek he once used to intimidate a basilisk, 'KWEEEEEEH!', Chilchuck was stunned: 'You're kidding me, that actually worked?!'

The only one who knew the antidote was, of all people, the High Priest, so Senshi went hunting for stew ingredients and caught a plump bird. Bob's Gourmet Guide said: 'Fowlbeast. Edible. Delicious.' The bird itself, though, muttered to itself, 'Is this fellow really a Durin? How amusing,' before putting on a very loud show of playing dead.

Meanwhile, Laios talked about Falin with Marcille during a brief moment of clarity. Marcille blamed herself, saying Falin got eaten because she was too weak, and Laios answered: 'That's not on you alone. Falin is my sister. I'll never abandon her.'

Once the stew was done, everyone sang and danced to summon the High Priest, and then the bird they'd prepped came back to life in the pot and began leisurely enjoying a bath. That bird was the High Priest all along.

blocks.cap: "I haven't had such a pleasant bath in a long time."

blocks.x: While Chilchuck gagged, 'So this stew is basically his bathwater!', the High Priest vouched that a medicinal broth this nasty would bring even a crazed wolf back to its senses. Sure enough, Marcille came to, and the first things she saw were a talking monster in a pot and Laios reaching into that pot with a spoon. 'I'M SICK OF EATING MONSTERS~~!!'

The High Priest vanished, leaving behind only the words 'you're heading in the right direction.' When Marcille admitted she ate the berries because they looked like Falin's raspberries, Laios said, 'Well, at least now you've got a travel story to tell Falin.'
3. Golden Carrots, and the Magic Staff That Became a Pot

After that, Marcille was in high spirits the whole way across the wasteland. The owner of a countryside factory on the brink of going under had given her an unsold D32 steel magic item, a 'flashlight.' Its test results: two rounds of dead silence, and one self-destruct.

Heading back to the factory, the party heard the workers griping: for the factory's final farewell party before it closes, they couldn't afford the traditional delicacy 'golden carrots,' sprinkled with gold dust made from the secretions of Goldglitter Originium Slugs. Senshi stepped up, 'I'll cook you a meal so your farewell lacks for nothing,' and Laios even struck a deal: if they brought back the goods, the owner would sell them a car on the cheap.

But at the Originium Slug nest they tracked down, the flashlight went haywire yet again, and the party tumbled down into a mine shaft, surrounded by a swarm of Acid Originium Slugs spitting corrosive mucus. Cornered, Marcille fired a flash spell through the flashlight, and the slugs keeled over in one shot. It was the first spell she'd properly cast in this world, but the flashlight belched black smoke and broke down.

And yet the mucus hit by the flash had turned sweet, tangy, and golden. To transform any more of it, they absolutely needed the magic-amplifying D32 steel, and Laios and Senshi silently turned to look at Marcille.
Her shriek of 'Making a pot out of it? That's completely absurd!' changed nothing, and the flashlight became a pot. 'Goodbye, my flashlight... I really enjoyed our time together...'

blocks.cap: A golden carrot full course, born from a D32 steel pot.

blocks.x: Then, as the owner was clearing out the factory, Marcille told him, 'What you made is not some junk nobody cares about!' He remembered the dream from opening day, when they ate golden carrots together and vowed to make this the best factory in Rim Billiton. He didn't sell them the car, but offered instead to drive them anywhere in Rim Billiton for free.
4. The North, the Hermit, and One-Eyed Skewers

Around that time, the party had been wandering Sami's Myrkwood for days. Marcille rambled on about the 'thousand-headed monster' of Minoan myth, and Laios about rumors of 'a monster that copies the abilities of whatever it eats.'

Then, right in front of an apprentice shaman they met, **Oakcup**, two strips of bark carved with revelations fell to the ground. The revelations: 'North' and 'Hermit.' The reading: 'Seek help from the cyclops who lives hidden in the northern mountains.' Only Chilchuck objected that someone might have dropped the bark on purpose, but when Laios said he didn't want to miss a chance to get home, he went along with it in the end.

And in a forest where the terrain rearranges itself, the party comes face to face with a hornbeast that has an endless void where its face should be, and in the middle of it, a perfect circle that swallows every bit of light. The moment someone charged in yelling 'Eat my axe!', the cliff gave way, and Chilchuck fell.

Chilchuck, meanwhile, came to in a cave with the cyclops **Arges** at his side. She tells him she sees an unusual number of deaths around him, and that through all those deaths, he has survived and is here now.

The other three, in the meantime, met the owner of the axe: **Ceobe**, a hungry girl who says she lives on Rhodes Island. A deal was struck: they'd find Chilchuck together, help with her hunt, and then she'd guide them to Rhodes Island. And Ceobe's prey turned out to be that very 'one-eyed monster.'

Back in the cave, Arges had foreseen a disaster: his companions tainted by a demon's corruption and swallowed by the void. When Chilchuck asked, 'Can a disaster be avoided?', she replied, 'I'm testing that myself.'

Around then, in the forest, the three took down the one-eyed monster with Ceobe, and Senshi started roasting its meat, remarking that 'there are customs of eating the sacrifice to receive a divine revelation.'

blocks.cap: Sami-style hornbeast skewers and a whole roast. Marcille's verdict: "Huh, this is actually really good!"

blocks.x: Following Ceobe to the campfire, Chilchuck was about to give his companions an earful, but the words caught in his throat. All three of their faces were already covered by the void. Muttering in broken voices about going north, to the door, back home, the three closed in as if teleporting, then vanished deep into the forest.

blocks.cap: Three companions, their faces covered by the void.

blocks.x: Was the disaster really unavoidable after all? But what welled up in the terrified Chilchuck's chest was anger. This whole mess is entirely their own damn fault!!!!
Still, those three were his companions, so Chilchuck chased after them, yelling 'Hey, you guys! I said wait up!' And Ceobe tagged along too: 'I'm coming with you~!'
5. The Mountains Are but Mountains, the Ink Spirits Are but Friends

And at some point, the party had settled into P'o-shan Village up in the mountains. Fighting off the inky beasts called **ink spirits** that attack whenever the bell rings, Senshi farming, Chilchuck in drinking contests, Marcille having tea with a villager named **Dawn**: that was their daily life. When Dawn asked, 'Do you remember how long it's been since we came to P'o-shan Village?', Marcille couldn't answer.

Meanwhile, Laios had seen an ink spirit he'd defeated a few days earlier come back perfectly fine, followed it, and never returned. He'd tamed the ink spirits with fruit, eating, sleeping, and playing with them, until he could actually understand their language. 'Gkh gkh huu gkh wuu gkh gkh! (Of course we're good friends!)'

Marcille, for her part, shook Senshi and Chilchuck awake, both of whom had pretty much become villagers. 'Do you remember that our goal is rescuing Falin? That your least favorite monster is the mimic?'

When she finally found Laios, he was on all fours chatting with the ink spirits, and Marcille turned away with a stiffly polite 'Sorry to have bothered you.' Laios hurriedly stopped her and showed her what he'd found: the liquor the ink spirits threw up after gorging themselves, the jam in their bellies, and the juice flowing from their turtle-like backs.
When Senshi turned it all into jam, wine, and juice, Marcille declared she didn't want to talk to people who eat monster vomit, and Senshi shot back, 'Honey is bee vomit too, you know.'

blocks.cap: Senshi's improved ink spirit jam, wine, and juice. Let's not ask about the raw ingredients.

blocks.x: And here was Laios's 'important discovery': the ink spirits have no habitat and no young, and just keep dying and coming back, while the villagers have no defenses at all despite being attacked for ages. Someone had crafted a world close to the real thing but never finished its ecosystem. It was a place where everything is 'fake.'
