Reed refused. In that instant the tent turned to ash without a sound, and a streak of fire split the night and vanished.

Then Dublinn soldiers emerged from the woods, led by the captain of the Duke of Wellington's Redsteel Guard. In the chaos, Harmonie caught hold of Reed. The Leader had already turned a blind eye to her escape, Harmonie said. Was there anywhere other than Dublinn where a Draco could stay?

Reed raised her spear again. Though she told Bagpipe not to look, Bagpipe saw the fire burning at its tip and remembered **the Dublinn Caster in County Hillock, gazing indifferently at the burning streets**.

She was Dublinn's 'Leader.' She had burned countless lands as the embodiment of Dublinn's flames, and in her own voice she had repeated the empty promise of bringing about an age of the Tarans. The smokescreen opened a chance to escape, but she did not know where she would go after that.
Meanwhile in the woods, Fionn, who had quietly cut his ropes and slipped free, threw himself at a guard. Selmon got the others on their feet, and Moran, who could barely see, brought the guard down.
Fleeing deep into the woods, they stopped as if by agreement. Someone whistled, and, taking up the weapons they had picked up, they went back toward the smoking camp.

blocks.cap: Into the smoke and heat. They moved toward the only light before them.

blocks.x: 'Reed.' Again and again the name came through the fog and smoke, and only then did Reed know where she had to go.
9. The One Who Did Not Return

As Reed tried to run to the drifters, The Brigadier's sword barred her way. Had she wiped out every witness from the start, as the Spectre Force's discipline required, nothing would have gone wrong, The Brigadier said, and called her the last element of instability left in Dublinn.

At that moment Selmon was facing down a Victorian soldier, calling Reed 'our Leader.' After Moran seared the soldier's arm with a torch, a Dublinn soldier came up to the two of them and said only this: "Go, Tarans. Get somewhere safe."

Reed, for her part, told The Brigadier that she had never meant to become The Leader's enemy; she had only tried to undo her mistakes. On the wind came the cries of people falling, people who just hours ago had been singing the folk songs of home.
She simply cannot hear these cries. Have you ever asked yourself who the Tarans you are supposed to save really are?
Then the Draco's fire lit up the woods. To Ch'en, the fire felt somehow as if it were not Reed's. Harmonie told Bagpipe, who stood transfixed by the flames, that she was free to go now.
At the same hour, Selmon was leading Moran by the hand along a muddy forest path. That fire was Reed's doing, Selmon said. She had known from the start that Reed had that kind of power.

blocks.cap: A forest path at dawn, the smoke still hanging in the air.

blocks.x: As day began to break, the hand leading Moran went slack. Moran sank to the ground, unable to tell whether the sticky wetness on her hand was blood or mud.
10. An Answer Without a Shake of the Head
That dawn, faced with checkpoint troops Fischer had arranged in advance, The Brigadier chose to withdraw. As Reed caught her breath in the marshes after slipping the encirclement, Bagpipe spoke.

blocks.cap: The marshes at dawn. Bagpipe asked the question she had been putting off.

blocks.x: So you were that Caster in County Hillock. ...Outcast died savin' you. ...Are you Dublinn's 'Leader'?

Whenever such questions came, Reed had always held down the urge to shake her head. Now she thought of the feel of the haystack, of the campfire, of the smoke in the woods that had not yet cleared. This time, she did not want to shake her head.
I am Dublinn's 'Leader.'

In County Hillock she had believed that only death could free her from that identity, so she had not tried to escape the Originium bomb. After Rhodes Island rescued her, she set out on this road to atone. Once she would have called the lives sacrificed fuel for Dublinn's flames. Now she could not.
She had been afraid of bleeding and afraid of dying, Reed confessed. She had wanted to hide like a shadow. But even where she did not look, the blood kept flowing.
Then she asked a question. Could Dublinn's dream truly never be realized? It was the same question Selmon had put to her.
Bagpipe could not answer. Now that she knew the dukes' probing maneuvers had been behind County Hillock, she could not even tell whom she was disappointed in.
Bagpipe told Ch'en it was time to go. As she left, Fionn handed her an old radio, and Bagpipe told him she would see him again, and to take care of himself.
After Bagpipe left, Fionn counted who remained. Eight.

Around sunrise, Moran came limping back, clutching a broken sword and Selmon's bloodstained hood. Asked what had become of Selmon, she quietly shook her head. Those who, like Selmon, did not return lay in those woods, and no one had seen their final moments.

Reed raised her hand, and a single flower bloomed in the Draco's fire. The feel of holding fire still made her tremble, but she kept her eyes open and spoke. "For all those... who rise from this mire."
The small flower fell into the mud and quietly withered.
11. The Teacher's Last Night

Afterward, Reed planned to put those who remained on a caravan bound for the domain of the Duke of Wellington, who did not tolerate violence against Tarans. Anyone who wanted to fight alongside Dublinn, she said, could follow her.

Before leaving, Fionn confessed what he had meant to write in his will. That night, it was he who had struck a soldier with a hoe, unable to stand by while a fourteen-year-old girl was beaten. When his name did not appear on the arrest warrant, he was afraid of falling under suspicion, so he robbed the pharmacy on purpose.
Moran said she would follow Reed and fight. As the caravan drew near, Fionn asked Reed whether someone like him, as he was now, truly had the right to go.

Around that time, the Duke of Wellington's high-speed battleship Gastrell was heading for County Oak Grove after a seven-year voyage. Standing on deck, Eblana called that city home, and thought that all that remained was her younger sister, who still hesitated.

On a snowy night long ago, the Earl of Warwick closed the last meeting of the 'Clan of Tarans' and went out into the blizzard with the poet Williams. Later, Loughshinny, gripping her sister's spear, opened the door of the teacher, who had lain in his room ever since coming back from the storm.

blocks.cap: The teacher's last night. Outside the window, snow was swirling.

blocks.x: Knowing the servants had already sided with Eblana, the earl said that in that case he had no reason not to drink this wine. Eblana said that when he died, the Tarans who had only just reclaimed their name would lose their protector and be trampled, and that she would then raise them up from the ashes.
A look of relief came over the earl's bloodless face. A greedy Draco, a Draco of boundless ambition. What he had spent half his life researching had not been wrong, he murmured.
A new age for Tara... I can see it before me... But... Loughshinny... and... you...
Standing in the doorway, Loughshinny saw her own face reflected in the window glass. That frightened face was no different from a face of pity.
12. The Fire That Lights the Way

After sending off the caravan, Reed and those who chose to follow her slipped into the ruins of King Gaeil's royal castle, destroyed by a Catastrophe. Wanderers who had lost their way and died there drifted about, puppeted by Arts, and through the gaps in the rusted machinery a purple fire was burning. Her sister had been there.

Reed feared she would have to fight her sister. The Loughshinny within her appeared and blocked her path. Your sister called on thousands of Tarans to follow her, she said, but you could not even reach out a hand to Mandragora, lying collapsed in the street long ago.

Reed remembered. Just as her sister had told the teacher, Victorian officers set fire to the Taran streets, and Eblana raised those who had burned to death with the fire of death, sending them to take revenge on those who had burned their homes. Loughshinny cried out for them to rest in peace and put out her sister's flames, and for the first time, her sister gave her a smile of praise.

Back in the darkness of the ruins, her sister's voice asked whether she was ready to take her place now. Reed turned her eyes to Moran, who was humming as she washed the wounds of the injured Caireann.
She was not her sister's shadow, Reed answered, but the shadow of the 'Leader' in people's ideals. And she asked in return: why must I fight you and win?

Reed held out her hand to Caireann. The suppressed fire burned through her body, yet not a spark rose from her hand, and the people felt a gentle current of life, like the moment of first opening one's eyes in the morning. Asked whether she was a real doctor, Reed said no. She had only found her own flame.

Around then, on the deck of the Gastrell, Eblana gave a speech. Dublinn would join forces with the Duke of Wellington's army and head for the port of Londinium. They were not fighting to seize Victoria's crown, but to take back the destiny that had been stolen from them.

blocks.cap: Eblana on the deck of the Gastrell.

blocks.x: At the same hour, in a reed field, Moran asked Reed what a Taran was, and who it was they had to save. Reed answered that 'Taran' was a name to be won centuries from now, at the end of long hardship.
I think everyone in a place where the Lights-Out Bell rings needs a fire to make their way through the dark.

Death cannot be defeated, Reed said, but life can be given dignity. A fire to warm yourself on a cold night, a drink to share when you sing, a peaceful home where you can meet again those you parted from.

blocks.cap: Reed answering Moran's question in the reed field.

blocks.x: Reed knew it was a distant dream. Dublinn's fire would sweep over this land and countless lives would become its fuel, but the weight of a life does not change. Having said this, she walked on.
Asked what she would do if it came to moving with Dublinn, Reed answered that when that day came, she too would go to meet her.
Epilogue. A House in the Warship's Path

Aboard the warship bound for Londinium, The Brigadier accused Harmonie of obstructing the search and of leaking the place Loughshinny had already left. Harmonie deflected: The Leader had never ordered Loughshinny killed.

blocks.cap: The deck of the Gastrell. The small brick building in its path was judged to be no threat.

blocks.x: Then, told that the fire at the royal castle had gone out, Eblana smiled. Now that her sister had awakened to the Draco's power, she would soon come back to her side.

Meanwhile Bagpipe told Ch'en that perhaps no one should be so quick to say that another person's dream could never come true. From the radio Fionn had given her came news that the war around Londinium was intensifying.

And Fischer, who had accepted the Duke of Caster's offer of promotion, ran into the peddler Fionn, who had just built a house by the main road. Just then, a vast shadow rose over the horizon and the ground shook.
It was the battle group led by the Gastrell. This was the Duke of Caster's domain, and the duke had quietly allowed the war to pass through his lands on its way into Victoria.

Fischer told Fionn that he seemed to have picked the wrong spot for his house, and told him to run. When Fionn, only then recognizing him, asked him something, Fischer gave no answer and got into his car. Behind him came the sound of the brick house collapsing and the anguished cries of people, and soon even that was drowned out by the roar of the warship.

As in the play the earl had recited, the red dragon's flame raised the dead warriors. Another Draco quieted that fire and sought one that warms the living. But in a land where the Lights-Out Bell tolls, it was still only a small light.

act21side.tagline: Bound by a deal struck seven years ago with a Wolf Lord, Texas returns to Siracusa, and in the middle of a war between the famiglie she decides, for the first time, not to run. There was no such thing as a Siracusan.

chars.desc: Penguin Logistics' taciturn dual-blade fighter. The last of the blood of the fallen Famiglia Texas · Operator Texas

chars.name: Exusiai
chars.desc: Texas's longtime partner. A Sankta whose meddling causes trouble, and whose meddling then cleans it up · Operator Exusiai

chars.name: Croissant
chars.desc: A warm-hearted, nagging bodyguard. A steady companion who frets over everyone in her thick dialect · Operator Croissant

chars.name: Sora
chars.desc: A Lungmen idol who followed Texas all the way to Siracusa. Determined enough to take a job as a musical actress to get inside · Operator Sora

chars.name: Lappland
chars.desc: The daughter cast out of Famiglia Saluzzo. A wolf with a near-obsessive fixation on Texas, edged with madness · Operator Lappland

chars.name: Lavinia
chars.desc: A young judge of Volsinii. Sheltered by Famiglia Bellone, yet an idealist who cannot give up on fairness · Operator Penance

chars.name: Leontuzzo
chars.desc: The young heir of Famiglia Bellone. A young master ahead of his time, who believes in negotiation and profit over violence

chars.name: Bernardo
chars.desc: Art director of the Compagnia dell'alba. An old gentleman who always chooses his actors himself

chars.name: Zaaro
chars.desc: A Wolf Lord from the wastelands. He struck a deal with Texas seven years ago.

chars.name: Emperor
chars.desc: The boss of Penguin Logistics. Calls himself Lungmen's superstar.

chars.name: Alberto
chars.desc: Don of Famiglia Saluzzo and Lappland's father. He rarely places a bet.

chars.name: Demetri
chars.desc: Consigliere of Famiglia Bellone. He grew up alongside Leontuzzo like a brother.

chars.name: Wallach
chars.desc: A Columbian-born lieutenant who runs Famiglia Rossati in Volsinii.

chars.name: Giovanna
chars.desc: The Don of Famiglia Rossati, returned from Columbia.

chars.name: Rubio
chars.desc: Volsinii's Secretary of Food Safety. Not born into a famiglia, he is treated like a doorman.

chars.name: Danbrown
chars.desc: A worker at a back-alley carwash in Volsinii. He sleeps badly, night after night.

chars.name: Ben
chars.desc: A critic who comes and goes from the theater carrying pizza. He pairs expensive wine with cheap pizza.

chars.name: Agenir
chars.desc: An old Sankta monk staying in Volsinii.

chars.name: Lunacub
chars.desc: The Fang chosen by the Wolf Lord Agnese. A girl who wields a longbow · Operator Lunacub

chars.name: Projekt Red
chars.desc: A wolf hunter in a red hood. She follows 'Grandmother's' word · Operator Projekt Red

terms.name: Famiglia
terms.desc: The mafia houses rooted in each of Siracusa's cities (plural: famiglie). They outwardly submit to Signora Sicilia, but behind her back each runs by its own rules.

terms.name: Volsinii
terms.desc: The Siracusan city where, with a new nomadic city about to be built, the twelve famiglie fight hardest over the spoils.

terms.name: Grey Hall
terms.desc: The council where the heads of the twelve famiglie meet. The symbol of the rules Signora Sicilia set down to keep the famiglie from all-out war.

terms.name: Signora Sicilia
terms.desc: The absolute ruler who has governed Siracusa for sixty years. She has kept the famiglie's feuds in check with one bare minimum: no extermination, ever.

terms.name: Wolf Lord
terms.desc: Immortal beings who live in the wastelands. Each chooses one human, called a 'Fang,' and plays a game in which the Fangs fight on their behalf.

terms.name: Compagnia dell'alba
terms.desc: A renowned musical theater company based at Volsinii's Teatro di Milano.

terms.name: Secondary Core Area
terms.desc: The central district of Volsinii's new urban area. It is being refitted to become the core of the new nomadic city.

blocks.x: Texas dreamed. In a Columbian back alley, young men of a Columbian famiglia picked a fight with a carwash worker from Siracusa. Without a word, the worker took a well-honed knife from a drawer and followed them out. Just like a Siracusan.

She woke in her room in Lungmen. The poster Exusiai had put up, the blanket Croissant had pushed on her, the CD Sora had left playing. Only after checking each of them did Texas steady her breath. But on the roof outside her window, a wolf was looking down at her.

blocks.cap: Lungmen under the moon. Something that should never have appeared here had come.

blocks.x: It was **Zaaro**, a Wolf Lord from the wastelands. When Texas left Columbia seven years ago, she had survived on the condition that one day she would help him once. Now Zaaro had come to collect. She was to return to Siracusa and lend her strength to his 'Fang.'

**Emperor**, the boss of Penguin Logistics, stood in the way, but Texas said a promise had to be kept. Emperor let her go by giving her a vacation, and Texas vanished with the wolf into the western dark without a word of goodbye.
1. 《La Morte di Texas》, a Tragedy in Three Acts

Some time later, three people from Penguin Logistics arrived in the Siracusan city of Volsinii: **Exusiai**, a Sankta who cannot keep out of other people's business; **Croissant**, who pours out her worries in thick dialect; and Lungmen's idol, **Sora**. They had come on the strength of a single rumor, that Texas had become the guest of a famiglia called Bellone.

Told that famiglia people loved musicals too, Sora decided to join a theater company as a trainee actress. At the restaurant where they waited for someone from the company, the three saved a clerk from the Ministry of Public Works who was being chased by hitmen. The hitmen backed off when **Lavinia**, a young judge of Volsinii, appeared.
Then **Bernardo**, art director of the Compagnia dell'alba, arrived and handed Sora the script of a new play. It was titled 《La Morte di Texas》: The Death of Texas.

This was the story Bernardo told. Salvadore Texas, a Siracusan who led the famiglie of frontier-era Columbia, died at the hands of his son Giuseppe. When Giuseppe declared that he would break away from Siracusa's order, an enraged Signora Sicilia ordered a purge, and the Texas name vanished in a single night.

No one knew what had become of Salvadore's beloved granddaughter, and so the unfinished third act ended differently depending on the writer. When Sora said she had come looking for that girl, Bernardo told her the name of the woman staying with the Bellones as their guest. Cellinia Texas.
Around then, Texas was being asked by **Leontuzzo**, the young heir of Famiglia Bellone, to put on formalwear tailored in the old Famiglia Texas style and come with him to a banquet as his guard.

To keep her promise to Zaaro, what she had to do was obvious. Kill a few people who did not matter to create chaos, then kill a few who did. It sickened her that she still knew this arithmetic by heart.

Meanwhile, **Lappland**, the Don's daughter expelled seven years ago, stormed a meeting of Famiglia Saluzzo and bloodied the desk of her father, **Alberto**. The information she brought was a single word. Texas.
2. A City on the Tablecloth

Leontuzzo explained Volsinii's situation to Texas. When Famiglia Texas fell, the terrified Columbian famiglie offered up their nomadic city technology and returned to Siracusa, and so for the first time in over a century Siracusa would have a new nomadic city. In the fight among the twelve famiglie over who would own it, the Bellones held the upper hand.

blocks.cap: A view of Volsinii. The fall of Famiglia Texas brought this city its new nomadic city.

blocks.x: Leontuzzo, who called violence the least efficient method there is, told Texas to escort Carracci, the Minister of Public Works, safely to the banquet. Carracci was his bargaining chip.
Meanwhile, Lavinia found the bodies of that morning's five hitmen in a back alley. Someone had silenced them. When she returned to the courthouse, her car had been splashed with paint again.
Lappland, walking in the rain without an umbrella, told her to watch her step. That judge gave off a smell both familiar and hateful, Lappland told her companion.
That evening, as Texas guarded Carracci's back, that same Lappland appeared before her and held out a mille-feuille.
3. The Way Home

Lappland said it had been seven years and five months. Back when the young Texas had been left in the care of Famiglia Saluzzo, the two had fought each other countless times. When Lappland told her to stay in Siracusa, Texas cut her off. There were people waiting for her in Lungmen.
Then came the explosion. A car bomb swallowed Carracci, and the banquet hall came under attack as well.
Facing the hitmen waiting in the alley, Texas felt an emptiness she had not expected. When the fight was over, there was no one beside her to ask whether she was hurt.

blocks.cap: She had not been gone from Lungmen long, but Texas already missed it.

blocks.x: Out of my way. Don't stop me from going home.
The harder she tried to go back, Lappland said, the deeper she would sink.

At the same hour, **Danbrown**, a worker at the carwash Lavinia frequented, called her a symbol of fairness and confessed that he could not sleep these days. Rushing out at the news about Carracci, Lavinia suggested he try going to the theater.

Meanwhile, Leontuzzo was ambushed by two hitmen and badly wounded, and Texas rushed in and drove them off. But Lavinia, arriving right after, arrested Texas as the first witness to Carracci's death and a suspect. Texas did not resist.
4. I Will Be the Culprit

When he came to, Leontuzzo judged that the culprit knew the Bellones, and him, far too well. He told **Demetri**, the consigliere he had grown up with like a brother, that he would stay hidden until the real enemy showed itself.

In the prison, Lavinia told Texas she knew she was not the culprit. Keeping Texas close was the way to protect her, and Leontuzzo as well. And Lavinia meant to find whoever had killed Carracci, a man who had tried to change the lives of the citizens.
But I will make them understand. What they disposed of was not a puppet. It was a living person.

blocks.cap: Volsinii's prison. The judge protected the suspect by locking her up.

blocks.x: Meanwhile, at the theater, a woman named Caterina spoke to Sora. In reality, she said, Vivienne, Salvadore's lover in the play, never ended up with him, and her son later became the Don of Famiglia Rossati.

After Sora left, the man who addressed Caterina as Don was **Wallach**, who ran the Rossatis' affairs in Volsinii. The playwright of 《La Morte di Texas》 was **Giovanna**, Don of Famiglia Rossati. Told that Cellinia had returned, she murmured only a few words. So she was alive.

The next day, Lavinia got word that the leader of the morning's hitmen had been found tied up and abandoned. He was Judge Bortolotti, who three years earlier had spoken at a legal forum about 'the minimum line that can protect everyone.'
In that moment, arrows rained down. Texas, who had slipped out of prison, saved Lavinia, but Bortolotti died with his heart pierced through. In his breast pocket was his revoked judge's license.

In Siracusa, Lavinia said, the law held not because it was fair but because of one person. When Leontuzzo told her to walk away, she answered that she had given up her life the moment she became a judge.

It was Texas who broke the silence. If what Lavinia needed was a culprit, she would be the culprit. She would be the bait: a loud trial to calm the city and draw out whoever was behind it all. For the same reason, she said, that she did not want her friends at Rhodes Island to die easily.
5. A Truck in the Courtroom

Hearing of the trial, Sora went to see Bernardo. Asked what she would do if Texas's past was not what she imagined, Sora answered that after nearly six years together, she had not come to blame her. She had come because she was worried.
If Miss Texas has a past heavy enough to crush her, we'll carry it with her.

After Sora left, Bernardo took out a law code bound in thorny vines and sat in silence for a long while. Then he called Demetri. Tell her I agree. That 'her' was Lappland, who had come to Demetri offering to stop the trial.

On the morning of the trial, Leontuzzo sat down across from Demetri. The one behind Carracci's murder, the attack on Leontuzzo, and the attempt on Lavinia was Demetri. He confessed that he had meant to set the famiglie at one another's throats and drag Signora Sicilia out from behind Grey Hall.
And it was what **Bernardo Bellone** wanted, the Don who had made the Bellones the strongest famiglia of all. The theater company's art director was Leontuzzo's father.

At the same hour in the courtroom, Texas testified that she had planted the bomb herself, with no motive and no one giving orders. Just as the verdict was about to be read, the sound of an engine came closer.

blocks.cap: As if mocking Signora Sicilia, a truck smashed through the courthouse wall.

blocks.x: Lappland climbed down from the truck and introduced herself. Lappland Saluzzo, the real killer of Carracci. It was her way of showing Texas that Siracusa was a swamp no one could escape.
6. The Thorn-Bound Code
Around then, Bernardo brought his son before Zaaro. Bernardo was the Wolf Lord's most prized 'Fang.'

The undying Wolf Lords, unsatisfied with fighting among their own kind, had made a game in which each chose a human, raised them, and set them to hunt one another. Bernardo said what he had learned from Zaaro was how to take power, and that every decision so far had been his own.
Meanwhile, Texas, now cleared, left the prison at the Rossatis' summons and slipped a note into Lavinia's pocket. Beside a phone number were a few words. Penguin Logistics, rain or shine.
Wallach received her and said that the Rossatis were shaken by the mere fact that Texas was alive. He flatly refused to let her see Giovanna.

Meanwhile, Danbrown went to the theater for the first time, understood nothing on stage, and was thrown out. The one who offered him a drink was **Ben**, the critic who had been coaching Sora's acting. Pointing to the label on an expensive bottle, Ben spoke of the pretensions of civilization.

And Lavinia, hearing that Bernardo had gone to the Saluzzo estate, called the number on the note. For more than ten years she had held on because of a single promise from him: on the day the Bellones won, he would carve out one piece of land where the law did not bend to power.

That night at the Saluzzo estate, Bernardo and Alberto joined hands to assassinate Giovanna. Texas brought down every Saluzzo who stood in her way without killing a single one. It was the first fight since her return to Siracusa that did not feel empty.
In an upstairs room, Bernardo sat holding a law code bound in thorny vines, identical to Lavinia's own. Blood ran from his hands where the thorns had pierced them.

blocks.cap: Bernardo stroked the code as if he did not notice the blood.

blocks.x: The words she had rehearsed hundreds of times shrank to a single one. Why?
The game is over, Lavinia.
So as not to show her tears, Lavinia left the room without looking back. Only drops of blood fell to the floor.
7. Act II, Curtain Up
Bernardo gave Texas one last job. Kill Giovanna, who would be coming to see Act II of 《La Morte di Texas》, and the debt would be considered paid.

That morning, Croissant picked up a photograph in Caterina's workroom. It showed a cheerful blonde girl standing beside an expressionless dark-haired girl, and on the back was written 'Giovanna and Cellinia, taken 1080.'

The same day, Alberto came to Danbrown's carwash and, speaking of his 'guard tuskbeast' that had gone missing five years earlier, said it was time it changed its tastes. And Lavinia, seeing Danbrown enter the theater, bought a ticket.

The curtain rose, and when Texas, on stage as a stand-in bassist, plucked a string, assassinations broke out all over the audience. Lappland brought down the seating with dynamite to open a way to the upper floor.

blocks.cap: A blade hidden inside an instrument. Texas mouthed the words to Sora: 'Wait for me.'

blocks.x: Meanwhile, in a corridor, Wallach brought down Demetri, and Leontuzzo stepped in to offer him a wager. At the back of the audience, Danbrown cut down a Rossati man, and the spattered blood landed on the face of Lavinia, who had followed him.
Having beaten Wallach, Texas stepped into the box and felt a blade at her throat. When Texas said she had come to kill her, Giovanna put down the blade and smiled. Long time no see, Cellinia.
8. Seven Years Ago, a Burning Mansion
When Giovanna asked her to stand with her, Texas answered that she had not survived the purge by luck.

At the same hour, on the empty stage, Lappland told Sora about seven years ago. She had been in the purge squad when the Texas mansion went up in flames before her, and Cellinia, who had set the fire, walked slowly out of it. What her eyes held was exhaustion.

And at the back of the audience, Danbrown confessed to Lavinia that he too had been part of that purge squad. When he had slipped into Columbia disguised as a carwash worker, Cellinia had recognized him and let him pass. He was the carwash worker from Texas's dream.
When Danbrown told her to run, Lavinia answered that she would not.

Meanwhile, in the box, Texas spoke of that day. The counterfeit gun her father had bought from Blacksteel exploded the moment he fired it, and the knife he drew with his injured hand missed at first. She heard all of it from outside the door, and in that moment she grew sick of everything.
In Lungmen, at least, she said, she had been happy.
I don't want to be Siracusan, or Columbian. I'm just Cellinia Texas.

When Giovanna said that if she walked out that door she would be the enemy of the Rossatis, Texas answered that they were too bound to the past. Leaving Giovanna's Arts shaking the room behind her, she leapt out the window.
9. There Are No Siracusans

At that moment at the back of the audience, Danbrown aimed his weapon at Lavinia, calling it his job. The one who stopped him was **Rubio**, the Secretary of Food Safety. Treated like a doorman because he was not born into a famiglia, he had asked Bernardo for Carracci's vacant post, and even after being told that the Bellones had killed Carracci, he did not back down. Now the new Minister of Public Works, he said he would take Lavinia on as his assistant.
Meanwhile, as Rossati pursuers closed in around Texas, Croissant's shield came down beside her. Exusiai and Sora were with her.

blocks.cap: Her friends leapt down beside the surrounded Texas.

blocks.x: That night, the four of Penguin Logistics gathered at their safehouse and raised a toast. The next day, Bernardo ended Sora's contract and withdrew his protection of Texas, and urged Wallach, who was present, to abandon Giovanna and overturn the old order with him.

Around then, Giovanna was gazing at a necklace Signora Sicilia had given her, and then she called Sora at the Penguin Logistics safehouse. She had wanted to write Cellinia as the least Siracusan of Siracusans, she said, but because she could not define what a Siracusan was, she had never finished Act III. Now she thought she understood.
There are no Siracusans.

Giovanna said she had left a gift. Around her, Wallach's men lay in ambush; they had planned to take Penguin Logistics hostage. When Wallach said seventy percent of the famiglia followed him, Giovanna asked for a drink.

Meanwhile, when Sora said something about the call felt wrong, Texas hesitated. Unlike Lappland, who said this was her only chance to leave, Sora said they should enjoy themselves to the full, then take Giovanna too and go back to Lungmen, the five of them.

Meanwhile, in an alley, Giovanna said there were things that even those who hold power must never do, and Wallach answered that he would rule it all, the new and the old. The moment the words 'From here on, you're Don Rossati' were spoken, the sound of a blade running through a body was lost in the rain.
When Texas arrived, blood was spreading across the alley.
10. A Gunshot on the Radio

The blade had missed Giovanna's heart by a few centimeters, and she lived, but she did not wake. On the table beside a stunned Texas lay the gift she had left behind: the necklace, Signora Sicilia's token.

The same day, Rubio told Lavinia about something that happened thirty years earlier. Young people who tried to stand up to the famiglie vanished overnight, and yet no one spoke of the bloodstained city hall. Whatever ideals she held, he told her, she must first survive, and find at least one successor.

On the day of his inaugural speech, Lavinia stayed by Rubio's daughter as he had asked. In the diary his daughter showed her, Rubio had been Carracci's longtime colleague. He had been quietly raising young people to carry on Carracci's will, and had marked Lavinia as a successor. Carracci, forgive me for using your death.

blocks.cap: Rubio's room. The diary lay there as if he did not mind who read it.

blocks.x: On the radio, Rubio revealed that the Bellones and the Saluzzos were throwing the city into chaos to seize the new nomadic city and defy Signora Sicilia. Alberto ordered Danbrown to deal with him.
When Danbrown entered the hall, Rubio asked him why the famiglie chase money and power instead of violence. Civilization, he said, exists in the first place to rise above violence.
Putting the gun he had bought from Blacksteel to his temple, Rubio said he hoped that one day Danbrown could live as nothing but a carwash worker, without a weapon.
That we are human beings. That our lives are real. That we are not livestock in a pen.

Listening to the broadcast, Lavinia went to Rubio's daughter and gently covered her ears. That morning, a single clear gunshot carried over the radio across all of Volsinii. Rubio died in the middle of his inaugural speech.
11. Siracusa Without Famiglie
For the first time in her life, Texas felt rage fill her to the crown of her head. The people who had tried to change this country had come to harm one after another. This time, she could not run.

Before the famiglia men surrounding the safehouse, Texas thanked Lappland for trying so hard to send her back to Lungmen. There were people in this country who should not die like that, she said, and she asked how much longer Lappland meant to stay bound.
At the same hour, Lavinia left her room, going over the names written in Rubio's diary. She had not been fighting alone.

blocks.cap: As if the gunshot had driven off even the dark clouds, sunlight poured over Volsinii.

blocks.x: Then Texas appeared before her. "Penguin Logistics. Need something delivered?"
Meanwhile, as Leontuzzo sat across from Alberto, Danbrown turned his weapon on his own Don.
You aren't more civilized. You're just more hypocritical.
The next moment, Danbrown collapsed, clutching his throat. Alberto took out a pocket watch and gave Leontuzzo ten seconds to choose: submit to the Saluzzos, or die here.
As the count ran down, Leontuzzo understood. Everything he had done was violence, only well dressed.

Then word came that someone had started the separation sequence for the Secondary Core Area of the new district. While Demetri and Wallach held off Alberto, Leontuzzo went, not to his famiglia, but to his father.
Meanwhile, Ben sat down beside Danbrown's body, left behind in the restaurant.

blocks.cap: "Neither this country nor this city will remember you. But I will."

blocks.x: Some time later in the cathedral, Leontuzzo named his father's true aim: to set the famiglie loose on one another until they tore each other apart, and so make a Siracusa without famiglie. Bernardo said that the summer he was twenty, working half a year in a country shoe shop, he had learned that Siracusa ran just fine without famiglie.

blocks.cap: Father and son in the cathedral.

blocks.x: Leontuzzo said it was not enough. Even if the famiglie fell, people would rebuild what they knew on top of the ruins, so everyone had to take part in the process. Bernardo laughed and said his son had grown.

After Leontuzzo left, **Agenir**, the old Sankta who had come to deal with Bernardo, said that with his son, it might not be impossible. And when Zaaro reached the cathedral, Bernardo had already swallowed poison. This game, he said, was Zaaro's loss.

blocks.cap: Before the Wolf Lord's fury, Bernardo closed his eyes, looking back on that summer.

blocks.x: And through the gate of Volsinii walked a gentle old woman. It was Signora Sicilia.
12. The Wolf Lord

With the help of the courthouse guards and the officials Rubio had left behind, Lavinia seized the control tower of the Secondary Core Area. About thirty guards stayed to the end, and Texas and Exusiai were with them.
At the same hour, Lappland stood before her father at the Saluzzo estate. What she had to do, she said, was neither rebel nor kill him, but say goodbye to this swamp. Goodbye forever, padre.

blocks.cap: In the end, Alberto did not raise a hand against her. My daughter. My pride. My traitor.

blocks.x: Meanwhile, on the way to the control tower, Texas brought down Wallach. And Leontuzzo, who had come to find Lavinia, walked toward her in front of Demetri, who had followed him, and said he was no longer the Don of the Bellones.
In that instant, black mist became a pack of wolves and fell upon them. Betrayed by Bernardo, Zaaro had broken the promise not to meddle in human affairs and come to end Bernardo's bloodline.
Only then did Leontuzzo learn of his father's suicide, and Lavinia understood what 'the game is over' had meant that day. A Siracusa without famiglie: that had been Bernardo's true dream.

When Texas, Lappland, and **Lunacub**, Agnese's Fang, who said she had made a promise to Bernardo, stood against Zaaro, Emperor appeared. From his shadow rose the Wolf Lords who had lost this game. They would not tolerate Zaaro breaking the rules.

blocks.cap: At last, Zaaro bowed his proud head.

blocks.x: When Zaaro vanished into the wind, Signora Sicilia appeared. Leontuzzo and Lavinia asked for a chance to tell her what they thought, even if it meant their deaths, and she smiled and told them to follow her.
13. Friend and Enemy

Before going to Grey Hall, Texas and Lappland stood at opposite ends of a park square. Lappland said she had lost completely in front of the burning mansion seven years ago, and that today she would kill her. Texas gave her the same words back.

blocks.cap: There was no flashy technique. Every move was aimed at the other's life.

blocks.x: When Lappland said she was Texas's past, Texas answered that from the start, her only dream had been to live simply with good friends. If anyone tried to break that, she would protect it. Nothing more.
Around then, Giovanna woke and spoke as if to herself. She had been arrogant, she said, to believe the good days would last forever. Now let her put an end to Act III. No one could ever define you.
In the park, the fight turned in Lappland's favor. But the moment she saw the regret on Texas's face as she closed her eyes, Lappland realized she had been wrong once again.
Texas. So you were just Texas after all.
Texas answered, of course, and took the hand Lappland held out. Asked whether they were friends or enemies, she said both, and the two of them went to Grey Hall together.
Meanwhile, Lavinia sat for a long time in the cathedral beside the body of the man who had been like a father and a brother to her. Then she gripped his limp hand once and turned away.
And at Grey Hall, Leontuzzo told Signora Sicilia he wanted to borrow a city. When she asked whether he wasn't all alone, the doors opened.

Signora Sicilia asked Texas, who looked so much like her grandfather, what she wanted. Texas asked her to look after the Rossatis, then sat down beside Leontuzzo, saying she would extend her vacation a little longer. Lappland stood beside them too, and Lavinia said that no one could be right forever, and that from now on she would be the one to change the Signora's will.

blocks.cap: Each had a different reason for wanting change. That one desire brought the four of them together.

blocks.x: Asked whether he could guarantee it would become a better country, Leontuzzo said he could not.
If someone comes to me one day, looking to overturn my ways. I'll sit down and hear them out, too.

Signora Sicilia smiled. Afterward, Lappland left for somewhere, and in the room where Giovanna had lain, only the script of Act III remained, dedicated to Cellinia and her friends at Penguin Logistics.
Epilogue — Civilization, and Savagery

Crownslayer, Lyudmila, came to see her teacher in Siracusa after a long time away, and found her teacher collapsed and bleeding, and the wolf hunter **Projekt Red**. Projekt Red said those were the rules of the game.

blocks.cap: Blood spread through her teacher's house.

blocks.x: Meanwhile, at Volsinii's theater, Act III of 《La Morte di Texas》 opened. Cellinia, the perfect Siracusan, was set free as a fantasy the Siracusans themselves had made, and word went around that Caterina's next work would be titled 《I Siracusani》.

On the day of Bernardo's funeral, Leontuzzo dug his father's grave alone in a cemetery where no one else had come. He told his father in the coffin that Signora Sicilia had accepted his demand that there be no famiglie in the new nomadic city. As he pushed the heavy coffin alone, Demetri came beside him and, without a word, pushed it with him.

blocks.cap: Demetri tossed the pocket watch his Don had given him into the grave.

blocks.x: For the brothers who remained, Demetri said, he would rebuild the famiglia. One day he would stand in Leontuzzo's way. Until then, Leontuzzo was not to go dying on him. And in the empty Bellone mansion, Leontuzzo told Lavinia that in the new city he would build an order that belonged to everyone.

Meanwhile, in the wastelands, after three months of fighting Lappland, Zaaro realized that her death would mean nothing at all, and for the first time bowed his head to a human. Beside the wolf who caught her body as she fell, Lappland murmured that she and Texas had only taken different roads to bring Siracusa down, and that she looked forward to the day they met again.

The carwash worker in the dream took up a knife like a Siracusan and, in the end, could not live as only a carwash worker. There are no Siracusans, Giovanna had said. And Cellinia Texas, neither Siracusan nor Columbian, simply Texas, stayed in this country for a while.

act19side.tagline: A Pioneer leader who takes researchers hostage to get his people back, and a scientist who wanted to give everyone the same chance, come face to face at the door of one laboratory. It is harder to wake from a sweet dream than from a nightmare.

chars.name: Dorothy
chars.desc: Director of Rhine Lab's Originium Art Section. She oversees Test Site 359 and is unusually kind to the Pioneers.

chars.name: Sonny
chars.desc: 'Leader' of the Pioneer Team. He once meant to become a lawyer, and lost everything to Oripathy.

chars.name: Elena
chars.desc: Dorothy's assistant and a researcher in Rhine Lab's Energy Section. An ambitious woman who follows her superior, Ferdinand, like an idol · Operator Astgenne

chars.name: Silence
chars.desc: Joyce's attending physician and a medic working with Rhodes Island. A woman of principle who believes only what she has seen with her own eyes.

chars.name: Ptilopsis
chars.desc: An Infected doctor under contract with Rhine Lab. In her head is a special chip linked to her nervous system, 'Device #9' · Operator Ptilopsis

chars.name: Greyy
chars.desc: An electrical engineering intern at Rhodes Island. Once Infected and on his own, he knows how to take a step forward even in the dark · Operator Greyy the Lightningbearer

chars.name: Mary
chars.desc: An officer with the Trimounts City Police Department. Sonny's childhood friend.

chars.name: Saria
chars.desc: A founding member of Rhine Lab and former Director of its Defense Section. She has left the company, but cleaning up after it still falls to her.

chars.name: Mechanist
chars.desc: A Rhodes Island Elite Operator and mechanic. A large corporation once took his invention from him.

chars.name: Muelsyse
chars.desc: Director of Rhine Lab's Ecological Section. She disappears while trying to warn Control of the danger.

chars.name: Ferdinand
chars.desc: Director of Rhine Lab's Energy Section and Elena's superior. An ambitious man with his eyes on the seat of Control.

chars.name: Ho'olheyak
chars.desc: A Liberi mercenary working hand in hand with Ferdinand. She rarely shows what she is thinking.

chars.name: Kristen
chars.desc: Rhine Lab's Control and its founder. Little outside her research holds her interest.

chars.name: Parvis
chars.desc: A veteran Director at Rhine Lab and Silence's former mentor. A wily old Caprinae.

chars.name: Ifrit
chars.desc: A girl who looks to Silence as family.

terms.name: Rhine Lab
terms.desc: A major Originium Arts research corporation headquartered in Trimounts, Columbia. Under Control, nine Directors each run one of its research sections.

terms.name: Trimounts
terms.desc: A nomadic city at the center of Columbian science and technology. Hundreds of companies keep their headquarters here.

terms.name: Pioneer Team
terms.desc: Bands of laborers who work the wastes outside the nomadic cities. Most are people the city has pushed out: the Infected, debtors, ex-convicts.

terms.name: Test Site 359
terms.desc: Rhine Lab's new experimental site, about 100 km from Trimounts. Dorothy is in charge of it.

terms.name: Infected Treatment Zone
terms.desc: The zone in Columbia to which Infected who cannot pay their insurance premiums must relocate.

terms.name: Loken Watertank
terms.desc: A Columbian laboratory once led by the scholar Loken Williams. It collapsed after an accident and now lies in ruins.

terms.name: Transmitter
terms.desc: A new Rhine Lab substance said to turn even people with low Originium Arts aptitude into capable Casters. It is a medium that receives and carries neural signals.

terms.name: Hub
terms.desc: The name of the experimental device Dorothy built at Test Site 359.

blocks.x: **Trimounts**, a nomadic city in Columbia, was founded by seven Pioneers who arrived leading three burdenbeasts. Today it is a thriving center where hundreds of technology companies gather. But out in the wastes beyond its walls, there are still Pioneers.

The Infected, people running from debt, people who chose the wastes over prison. They clear the ground for the corporations' dangerous test sites. Rhine Lab's **Test Site 359**, 100 km from Trimounts, was built the same way.
The site's overseer, **Dorothy Franks**, was a scientist who was unusually kind to the Pioneers. In the future she imagined, no one would have to struggle in the wastes anymore.
1. A Disappearance at Night, Hostages at Dawn

One night, **Muelsyse**, Director of Rhine Lab's Ecological Section, left a message for Rhine Lab's Control, **Kristen Wright**. **Ferdinand**, Director of the Energy Section, would make his move soon, she said. She did not think she could get away.

That same night, in a back alley off the busy streets, Muelsyse was caught by a winged mercenary. The mercenary heated the air around them to cut off her water-wielding Arts, and when Muelsyse still would not talk, said only: "Terminate her."

blocks.cap: The back alley off the busy streets where Muelsyse went silent.

blocks.x: Around then, **Saria**, the former Director of the Defense Section, had been waiting for her. When a message arrived in Muelsyse's place, Saria immediately asked Rhodes Island for help.

Then, at 5 a.m., at Test Site 359. Dorothy, who had not slept in days, asked Rhodes Island's **Ptilopsis** (Joyce), there to provide medical support, and Energy Section researcher **Elena** to deliver some modified heater modules to the Pioneers. Elena asked why she went so far for them. They were only a hired Pioneer Team.

At the same hour, Pioneer Team leader **Sonny** was walking his eighth lap around a hut. When he was infected, his friends from law school never once came to see him. On this site, he told his team, the only ones who truly cared about them were themselves.
Some time later, a Pioneer came saying his comrade Sam was having an Oripathy attack. Joyce and Elena followed him to a hut, but there was no patient there. Instead, a nail gun was pointed at them.
2. Armor With No One Inside

That afternoon, in downtown Trimounts, Rhodes Island Elite Operator **Mechanist** and the Doctor were going over records sent by 'Device #9,' the chip implanted in Joyce's brain. By those records, Dorothy too was being held by the Pioneers.

blocks.cap: Downtown Trimounts.

blocks.x: When the two of them visited the alley where Muelsyse had vanished, they found a narrow scorch mark on the ground. The moment they raised the possibility that the culprit was someone inside Rhine Lab, a new model of power armor they had never seen before attacked. Even with its arms and legs smashed, it did not flinch.

Then a knife-hand clad in pure white armor pierced the center of the machine. It was Saria. She was the one who had drawn Rhodes Island into this, she said, so protecting the two of them was her responsibility.
The broken armor was empty. When Saria cut the tubes that served as its nerves, a silver liquid flowed out, its composition matching no known substance.

For half a year, ever since this armor first appeared among mercenaries, Saria had been tracing where it came from. Wasteland mercenaries were as convenient a test subject as the Pioneers, she said. When they were used up, no one asked where they had gone.
Meanwhile, Ferdinand was being pressed for results by a voice called 'the Colonel.' He instructed the Liberi mercenary **Ho'olheyak** to make sure Saria found nothing.
3. The Officer Was a Childhood Friend

In the meantime, Trimounts police officer **Mary** had set up at the observation station outside the site. **Silence**, Joyce's attending physician from Rhodes Island, and electrical engineering intern **Greyy** asked to be allowed to talk with the Pioneers. Mary cut them off. Infected with a company paying their premiums were not the same as those people.

blocks.cap: The Test Site 359 observation station, watching over the Pioneers' quarters.

blocks.x: When the comms connected, Sonny and Mary recognized each other at once. They had played together since childhood, and on the day Mary joined the police, they had promised to uphold Columbia's order together. Mary snapped that she regretted not turning him in the day he broke into her house.
Then, in the hut, Joyce had a seizure. One of the Pioneers fastened his own emergency medical band onto her wrist. The doc always looked after us, he said.

Meanwhile, orders came down from above to cut the power to the living quarters, which froze at night. When Silence asked over the comms why he was doing this, Sonny answered that he wanted to stop the experiments at this site. But who would believe a Pioneer with nowhere to go?
When Joyce lost consciousness completely, Silence walked into the site unarmed, with Greyy beside her. Whatever Rhine Lab decided, she said, treating the Infected was Rhodes Island's work.
4. A Hand Held Out in the Dark

In the darkness of the blackout, Sonny was remembering the day the insurance bill arrived. If he could not pay by the deadline, he was told, he would have to move into an **Infected Treatment Zone**. When he heard that, he thought his life was over.

Greyy sat down beside him and said Rhodes Island had saved him when he was dying, and had even given him the chance to study. Sonny laughed. You're just one of the lucky few who got picked, he said. The unlucky rest are only waiting for the day they sink into the mud.
Greyy asked in return: couldn't the next step forward land on our side? At that moment, the circuit Greyy had been repairing with his Arts the whole time they talked lit up.

blocks.cap: The Pioneers' quarters on the night of the blackout.

blocks.x: In the meantime, Elena, who did not trust Sonny, secretly set off the alarm. And a light that was not Greyy's began to fly over the site.

Strange silvery objects crawled up behind the Pioneers, rising and falling as if breathing, watching the people. In moments they multiplied into dozens and took an entire hut apart. A Pioneer named Myers carried the unconscious Joyce out of it.

When Greyy worked out that the objects followed light and sound, Silence and the Pioneers decided to make noise on purpose and serve as bait. Then Dorothy's gentle voice came over the site's speakers: the doors to the experimental area were open to everyone, equally.
5. Do Not Follow the Gentle Voice

The group threw their last firebomb and ran into the experimental area. The exit locked behind them, and the voice from the speakers showed them the way. Don't be afraid. I'll protect you, just as I always have.

blocks.cap: A corridor in the experimental area of Test Site 359.

blocks.x: But Sonny stopped. That woman is controlling us, he said. She wants us to walk into her prison on our own feet.

The Dorothy that Elena knew had quietly found a doctor for Dirk, a Pioneer who could not afford his son's heart surgery. The Dorothy that Sonny knew had handed Dirk a consent form once the surgery was over. Sign it, and he could go home. Dirk said it had been a long time since anyone had offered him a 'chance,' and he left.
Alan, Gale, and Sophia followed him. Hold a person's weakness so that they cannot refuse: that, Sonny said, was how Dorothy Franks worked.

As she ran from her pursuers, Silence remembered a corridor filled with flames. The subject of the experiment she had led at Rhine Lab was **Ifrit**, a child who looked to her as family. The child lived, but never got a normal life back.

Silence confided in Sonny. As the one in charge of that experiment, she could not have been unaware of the risk, and admitting it had been harder than blaming someone else. That was why she wanted to save the Pioneers, and Elena, and Dorothy too.
6. The Eye Inside the Armor

Back in the city, Saria concluded that the silver liquid was a medium connecting an operator's neural activity to a machine. In the bar where she took the Doctor and the others was a man who had once been a surgeon at **Loken Watertank**.

The man smelled the silver reagent and laughed that the ghosts who had died on his operating table had come back. Who did they think had dug the most legacy out of the ruins of Loken Watertank? Saria answered: Rhine Lab.
Then Ho'olheyak appeared.

blocks.cap: Ho'olheyak appears at the bar.

blocks.x: The man told Saria she was on her own, drained his glass, and collapsed. It was a drug he had hidden long ago in a false molar he had fitted himself, and with Saria's first aid it seemed he would live. Ho'olheyak said that in Columbia, a person should at least have the freedom to choose their own death.

Saria's knife-hand reached Ho'olheyak's stomach, but what her fingertips met was not human flesh. Ho'olheyak changed the composition of the surrounding air to disrupt Saria's Arts, told her not to be too eager to make an enemy of anyone, and slipped away.
In the alley they chased her into, power armor was waiting. Just as Saria's fist was about to pierce the seventh suit, the Doctor shouted. Saria, stop.
The fist missed the core by a hair. Through the cracked shell, a single eye appeared. It was asking for help.

blocks.cap: The eye inside the broken armor. "Hello, Muelsyse."

blocks.x: Muelsyse, who had been trapped inside the armor, took the Doctor's hand, and drops of her sweat traced a number on the Doctor's sleeve. 359.
7. The Master of the Laboratory

Around then, Elena was alone, recording the silver objects. When Silence asked what she was hiding, she said this was her work and her dream. To her, Ferdinand was the man who had picked her out of tens of thousands of students, and the goal she had to chase.

Then a terrified Myers grabbed Joyce, pulled the medical band he had given her off her wrist, and shoved it into his mouth. Every Pioneer who had secretly swallowed the painkillers inside such a band had died. While Sonny and Sam struggled to make him bring it up, Joyce, freed of the band, opened her eyes.

But what came out of her mouth was not the way she spoke. Where there is light, it will be warm, she said. Let us go forward together. Then Dorothy, over the speakers, called everyone to her laboratory.

At the same hour, in the Pioneers' quarters, Mary received Sonny's letter from Greyy. It began with memories of a fifteenth birthday. At the end was a hurried scrawl: those people are running dangerous experiments on us.

blocks.cap: The Pioneer hut where Mary opened Sonny's letter.

blocks.x: Then the laboratory door opened. Dorothy greeted them, and Sonny shouted. "Sam, get her!"

The Pioneers' crossbows all turned on her at once. The hostage-taking and the anger had both been an act for this moment. Three days earlier, Sonny had slipped into the experimental area to ask whether he too could become a test subject. There he saw silver monsters gather around Dorothy, and heard her speak to them the way one speaks to pets.
Dorothy said that knowing the truth would only put them in danger. Sonny asked in return: deciding on behalf of others, was that what you upper-class people loved most?

Dorothy stepped forward until the tips of the crossbows nearly touched her. Dying frightened her, she said, but it frightened her more that they would hurt themselves. There was still a chance, and she held out her hand. At that moment, the silver objects closed around her.
8. Beyond the Door

Long ago, in archived footage from Loken Watertank, Dorothy had seen a white-haired girl who had stained a laboratory with blood. She wanted to find that child and hold her, she had said. If she could save that child, then someday, if she herself went mad, there would be someone to stop her.

And now the arrows the Pioneers fired stopped in midair in front of Dorothy and fell, their heads cut away. As the silver objects bore down on them, Sam spoke between ragged breaths. Take the survivors and run into the wastes. We're Pioneers, after all.

blocks.cap: Dorothy's laboratory.

blocks.x: Sonny did not run. Even with blood running from the palm that gripped a snapped arrow, he pushed forward against the invisible force. Dorothy said her research was meant to protect them. He asked: did you ever once ask what we wanted?

In the meantime, Elena poured starlight Arts behind Dorothy, and the silver objects swung toward it. The sand in the laboratory vibrated and bound everyone's hands and feet, but Silence, a doctor to the last, dragged her paralyzed body forward and stood before Dorothy.
When a drowning person thrashes, Dorothy asked, can you call that a refusal? Even through the muddy water, she said, she could hear them calling for help.
Then Joyce, who was not held by the vibrations, pointed to a door where the silver objects were gathering. When it opened, all the vibration stopped, and Dorothy froze, staring only at that door.
9. Waking From a Sweet Dream

Beyond the door, a huge machine slept in the dark. Electrodes at the ends of tangled cables had been fitted to the heads of the missing Pioneers, and their consciousness ran through the silver liquid into Dorothy's 'Hub.'

blocks.cap: Where the missing Pioneers lay.

blocks.x: Dirk, Gale, and Sophia were there, and so was Helen, the fellow researcher who had been laughing and talking with Elena that very morning. It was Dorothy who had suggested that Helen, crushed by loans and evaluations, become a test subject.
Differences in talent should not decide a person's life, Dorothy said. So she had connected people, so that anyone could feel the earth, the air, and the rain in the same way.

Silence understood what that meant. The Caster commanding the silver objects was all of the connected Pioneers together. If such a power grew, nowhere on the land would escape its gaze, and the test subjects would live under surveillance for the rest of their lives. For the first time, Silence raised her voice.
Dorothy said she would protect them, even if it cost her life. Sonny admitted that the future she offered was tempting. Many times, he had wanted to take her hand.
Because my future... has to be my own.

It is harder to wake from a sweet dream than from a nightmare, Sonny said. Perhaps Dorothy was inside that dream too. Just as he said that killing her here might be the safest choice, Joyce woke and stopped him.
The test subjects had one message, and Joyce delivered it. **This was our choice.**

When Silence promised to set every wrong right, Sonny let Dorothy go, and the experiment stopped. Before leaving the site, Dorothy took a single photograph with her. Her mother, a Pioneer, had been swept away by a Catastrophe while her daughter was away at a summer camp for prodigies.
10. The Silver Giant
But for Ferdinand, there would be no halt to the experiment. He ordered Elena to withdraw, and the Defense Section began injecting the Pioneers leaving the site, calling it 'quarantine.'

Just as Sonny was about to be injected, Elena shoved him away. The syringe held the **Transmitter** she had been researching, and the Pioneers' medical bands carried sensors that reacted to it. Realizing she had been used from the start, Elena told them their enemy had never been Dorothy.

At the same hour in the city, a recovered Muelsyse produced evidence that Ferdinand had joined hands with the military. Ferdinand's first target was Control, who had been out of contact for over a week, and the Doctor and the others headed for Rhine Lab headquarters.

blocks.cap: Rhine Lab headquarters.

blocks.x: In the meantime, at the site, the injected Pioneers fell into comas, and Mary, having caught Sonny, poured out what had happened four years ago. She had covered for him the day he broke in through a window and demanded anything worth money. After that day, her grandmother took to her bed and never rose again.
Then the laboratory building tore open from the inside. Over the ruins rose a vast, silver geometric object, and it took the entire site into its embrace.

blocks.cap: The silver object rising over Test Site 359.

blocks.x: Dorothy looked up at it and murmured that it was so beautiful, that the experiment had succeeded. And yet it frightened her, strangely so.

Meanwhile, Ferdinand called the people left at the site a 'noble sacrifice.' As their forebears had driven burdenbeasts to conquer the wastes, he would harness this beast to push back the borders of civilization.

At that hour, at the site, Mary put Elena in her car, saying she would catch the real culprit. When Sonny asked to come along, she held out her hand without a word. A police officer, a Pioneer, and a researcher ran together for the edge of the site.
11. You and I Are Done

4 a.m., Rhine Lab headquarters. Veteran Director **Parvis** let the infiltrating group pass, pretending not to see them. Muelsyse took it to mean he would not bet on either Ferdinand or Kristen until the very end.

Around then, at the observation station, Mary and Sonny stood side by side against the Defense Section, while Elena faced Ferdinand alone. Ferdinand held out the key to a laboratory of her own, and told her she was more like him than his own children.
Elena refused. If he had really trusted her, he would have told her the truth. Once she was no longer useful, he would have erased her along with the evidence.

blocks.cap: "Ferdinand Clooney, you and I are done."

blocks.x: With Elena held by the Defense Section, Ferdinand called the silver object outside the window a new era. The present is all we can grasp, he said.

Meanwhile, at headquarters, Saria broke straight through the shields of her former subordinates, and Muelsyse, rescued by the Doctor, called up particles of water, saying she was on their side, just this once. For the first time in 1,497 days, the door to Control's office opened.

Saria asked whether the experiments at Test Site 359 had been on her orders. Kristen said no. She did not lie, she said. But she had no interest in 'insignificant' matters unrelated to research, and Saria told her those people were anything but insignificant.
12. To Find the Answer

In the meantime, the silver object was swallowing the living quarters one by one. Forcing the bands off could damage the test subjects' brains, so Dorothy used the Arts Unit implanted in her own body to raise walls of sand and hold back the erosion. Watching her bleed from the nose, Silence understood that her words about giving her life had not been empty.
Greyy went outside alone. That thing was only a creation of human hands, he told himself, and people who endure the dark of night will not lose to their own creations. He raised light from his hands.

blocks.cap: The light Greyy sent up.

blocks.x: Meanwhile, inside the walls of sand, Dorothy asked: what had her mother felt before the sandstorm swallowed her? Why was she the only one who survived? Holding her as she collapsed, Silence answered that the storm had ended long ago.
Outside, as Greyy's hands reached their limit, Joyce's Arts wrapped around them. What decides the outcome is not calculation, she said, but the 'impulse' that makes one step forward.
The moment a light no one had calculated pierced the silver object, Joyce caught a faint signal, and Silence's drone burst in the night sky. Message sent.

When the light faded, Dorothy was holding a medical band and a reagent. Silence said that, as her physician, she could not watch. Dorothy told her: It's all right, Olivia. This way I can be with my family.
The reagent, cold and yet gentle, flowed into her body like the touch of family. I'm going to go find the answer.
13. The Land of Dreams

When she was small, her mother had told her a story. A girl who lost her home to a storm sets out with a fowlbeast that cannot fly and a hollow tin man to find a miraculous Caster. In the end she decides that wherever her friends are is her new home, and takes to the road again.
In the land of dreams Dorothy reached, people waved to her. But they said they could not stay here too long. When day broke, they would set out again.

blocks.cap: The land of dreams Dorothy reached.

blocks.x: At the same hour, at the edge of the site, Sonny laughed beside Mary as her arrows ran low. He used to dream of dying in a room with a window, he said. Now he did not mind dying on the road.
Back in the dream, Dorothy remembered the day she left for summer camp. When her daughter said she would not go if Mom did not want her to, her mother had wept and said:
No, Dorothy... your future doesn't belong to me.
In the dream, a young Pioneer stood on tiptoe and tried to wipe away Dorothy's tears. Dorothy reached for that hand, then let her own fall.

blocks.cap: "Dorothy, why are you crying? Don't you like it here?"

blocks.x: But your futures don't belong to me.

She should never have kept them here, Dorothy said, nor herself. And as her mother had done, she promised to see them off. The views you will see, she told them, will be far more beautiful than the ones I saw.
Then all the silver liquid flowed back to the laboratory at once. In the place where it was born, the giant object tore out its own heart, and where it fell, a silver river ran.

blocks.cap: The silver object crumbling.

blocks.x: When she woke, Dorothy said she felt lighter. What she had seen was not an answer, but those people's new journey.

Around then, Elena's Arts finally reached the comms jammer in the observation room, and soon Columbian soldiers stormed in on charges of illegal experimentation. When Ferdinand called the Colonel, the number did not exist.

After a final call with Kristen, Ferdinand fled through a hole in the floor. Ho'olheyak was waiting at the end of his escape route. Since he had not dragged Rhine Lab into the mire, she said, she would forgive him. She left him one suit of power armor and said: Go on, 'Pioneer.'
Epilogue — Rain Is Coming to Trimounts

The site collapsed, leaving only silver behind. Elena admitted that what she had wanted most was Ferdinand's recognition. Dorothy told her she was no longer anyone's assistant. His end was her starting point.
No one knew what would become of the Transmitter flowing in their bodies. Dorothy said it was no more frightening than the crystals inside an Infected body, or a storm that could come at any time.
The site's affairs passed to the government, and Saria moved on again, pursuing the backer behind Ferdinand. And in two places 100 km apart, Saria and Silence looked up at the same rain clouds.

blocks.cap: "It's about to rain in Trimounts."

blocks.x: Meanwhile, Mary did not arrest Sonny. Sonny told her why he had tried to volunteer for the experiment. He wanted to go back to the city and apologize to his closest friend. On that night four years ago, he said, he had killed with his own hands the Sonny Romano who pursued fairness and justice.

If he were arrested, Mary had said, he would go through prison to a treatment zone, or become a Pioneer barred from the city forever. Then she added: but you're already a Pioneer. Their embrace, after so long, was a reunion, and the first proper farewell in many years.

Around then, out in the wastes, Pioneers blocked the path of Ferdinand's power armor. He held the Transmitter in his hand, but never injected it. The armor stretched both arms to the sky, and the enraged Pioneers swallowed it.

And at Rhine Lab headquarters, Ho'olheyak said that, contrary to the report that Dorothy had completely destroyed the Hub, Kristen had obtained its core. Kristen replied that a researcher only explores possibilities. She does not make prophecies.

blocks.cap: On a night after the rain, Kristen looks up at the stars.

blocks.x: Trimounts is a city founded by seven Pioneers. Beyond its walls, Pioneers walked out into the wastes once more. Not toward a land of dreams someone else had drawn for them, but toward farther views each of them would go and see with their own eyes.

act20side.tagline: A letter claims 'fireballs fell from the sky,' so Gavial charges in with an axe, lands in a water park full of Durin drunks, and ends up moving an entire underground city to the jungle. Plus one act of persuasion won with words, not fists.

chars.name: Gavial
chars.desc: The strongest warrior of Acahualla's Tiacauh and a Rhodes Island Medic. Settles most problems by whacking them with a single axe · Operator Gavial

chars.name: Eunectes
chars.desc: Gavial's childhood friend and an engineer who lives and breathes robots. Every machine she meets becomes a 'friend' · Operator Eunectes

chars.name: Tomimi
chars.desc: Chief of the Acahualla tribe 'Gavial's Will' and a Rhodes Island Operator. A cheerful warrior with a collecting habit · Operator Tomimi

chars.name: Elysium
chars.desc: Rhodes Island's do-it-all guide. Adapts fast anywhere, and is very good at acting sober when he isn't · Operator Elysium

chars.name: Inam
chars.desc: Grand chief of Acahualla and a Messenger planted there by the Sargon government. A realist with an unusually sharp head for business

chars.name: Stitch Canvas
chars.desc: An architect of Zeruertza. Has Oripathy, and is a minimalist who'd much rather stay holed up at home

chars.name: Avdotya
chars.desc: Zeruertza's literature representative. An immigrant living with her past hidden behind a Durin-style name

chars.name: Catch Lightrace
chars.desc: Zeruertza's (acting) design representative. Stitch's longtime rival and one-of-a-kind best friend

chars.name: Edge Eartheart
chars.desc: Zeruertza's environment and climate representative. A nagging old hand in charge of Originium prospecting

chars.name: Croque Diamondface
chars.desc: Zeruertza's business representative. An all-purpose MC who can't resist booze or a good show

chars.name: Deculture Silvermint
chars.desc: Zeruertza's industry representative and robot manager. Everyone just calls her Deculture

terms.name: Zeruertza
terms.desc: A Durin city beneath the Acahualla jungle. Famous for its giant water park, the 'Great Aquapit'

terms.name: Durin
terms.desc: A people who build their cities underground. When disaster strikes, they take it for granted that you abandon the city and build a new one

terms.name: Great Aquapit
terms.desc: A massive water park built by citizen vote in Zeruertza. It started out as a way to plug a hole in the collapsed dome

terms.name: Originium vein
terms.desc: An active Originium vein found in the strata near Zeruertza. It could blow at any moment

terms.name: Stranger Things
terms.desc: A surface-world magazine popular among the Durin. Most of what the Durin know about the surface comes from here

blocks.x: These days, the jungle of Acahualla is gripped by 'manure-factory' fever (that's 'manufacturing,' more or less). Thrilled by all the new machines, **Yota** and his little brother **Yogi** are planning Yota's own tomb-slash-monument: the 'Great Gold Originium Pearl Triangular Tower of Great Acahualla.' It was the Durin standing next to them who pointed out that 'Great' shows up twice.

That Durin is **Stitch Canvas**, an architect who came up from underground. He warned that if the underground city fell into crisis, the jungle wouldn't be safe either — and once **Tomimi**, home on vacation, put that into a letter, things got a little spicy: 'Fireballs fell from the sky and burned everyone's quilts.'

Meanwhile, the letter reaches Rhodes Island Medic **Gavial** 'the Invincible,' who grabs exactly one thing: an axe her friend **Eunectes** (everyone calls her 'Zumama') threw together in a hurry. The solution is the same as always, after all. Fists.
1. We Came to Rescue Them. It Was a Water Park.

The first to head down are Tomimi, the quick-calculating grand chief **Inam**, and self-proclaimed outdoors expert **Elysium**, who got roped in mid-vacation. Elysium pitches a tent inside the elevator and keeps calling Stitch, a fully grown adult, 'kiddo.'

At last, the elevator arrives at the Durin city of **Zeruertza**. Just as Stitch is about to introduce a garden that is 'beautiful yet simple,' everyone's eyes lock onto the Super Spinner Slide in the middle of town.

blocks.cap: "Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to Zeruertza." The guests' eyes were already on the giant slide.

blocks.x: Even when Stitch shows off the home he designed himself as 'the quintessence of wisdom in this city,' the reaction is lukewarm. Tomimi and Inam are eyeing the swimsuits at the shop next door, and Elysium is eyeing the grilled mushrooms.

blocks.cap: 'The core of my profound philosophy,' designed by Stitch himself. Not a single visitor stuck around.

blocks.x: In this city, booze is your ID. Stitch, who says he doesn't drink, gets branded an 'alien' in the street, while Elysium swears brotherhood with the Old Karl Mead fan club — and then puts his meal on Stitch's tab.

Then they drop by the water park, the 'Great Aquapit,' where easygoing design representative **Catch Lightrace** leads the group out to the square and opens this quarter's 417th citizen vote. The last motion was the color of this week's streetlights; today's is whether to let the new visitors in.

blocks.cap: The mead faction and the whiskey faction, snarling that they'll each vote the opposite way of the other. A very solemn vote indeed.

blocks.x: The result is an easy yes, and Catch tells them to have all the fun they want at his masterpiece, the water park.
2. No Fireballs, No Mushrooms

Meanwhile, Stitch gets collared by **Edge Eartheart**, the elderly environment and climate representative. Half a year ago an earthquake punched a leaking hole in the dome and broke the Originium prospecting equipment too, but Stitch holds out, saying he's already refused to fix it about a million times, and clams up the moment his mentor comes up.

At the same time, Gavial and Eunectes are wandering the underground caves, guided by the old **High Priest**, who 'can do anything.' Left, right, right, left, then four lefts in a row. Right back where they started.

In the end, the two opt for a straight line, jumping and jumping again until they crash into some random Lupo and knock her out cold. When she comes to and fires off something about 'the beast of civilization baring its fangs,' they assume there's an actual beast, so they scoop her up and jump again.
You face the problem, find the bad guy, and take him down. What's so hard about that?
And where they finally land is under a waterfall, smack in the middle of the Great Aquapit. Elysium, in a swimsuit, waves. 'Oh, Gavial, what took you so long?'

blocks.cap: Where she leapt in, axe in hand, to stage a rescue: the water park, the 'Great Aquapit.'

blocks.x: Tomimi tearfully admits that 'polishing the wording' of the letter was Elysium's idea, and once they leave the chaos of the waterside for somewhere quieter, Stitch confesses he polished his wording too. Apparently there's a very high probability the whole jungle will sink due to tectonic shifts... in a few million years.
'Can I beat the snot out of this runt?' (Gavial) 'By all means.' (Inam)

The real goal was to repair the railway bridge cut off by the earthquake and mount the prospecting equipment on it — and to blow up the giant slide blocking the way. And why borrow surface folk for the job? Railway design didn't suit his aesthetic, so he slept through every one of those classes.

Come to think of it, the Lupo Gavial carried in is **Avdotya**, a surface-born writer who makes her living on ad copy. Back at the waterside she ranted about the greed and schemes of surface folk and told them to leave at once — while the actual Durin were busy handing Gavial, the woman who'd just jumped off a waterfall, an invitation to a beer party.
3. Operation: Lobby to Blow Up the Slide (Finishing Blow: Berry Tomato Wine)

To get rid of the slide, they need to win over three representatives — business representative **Croque Diamondface**, industry representative **Deculture Silvermint**, and the slide's owner, Catch. Gavial's opening line at the negotiating table: 'Hello, I want to blow up that big slide.'

The real negotiating falls to Inam. Croque believes the trashy magazine 'Stranger Things' is an encyclopedia of the surface and even learned Sargonese from it — and Inam topples her with a single videotape of the Dossoles 'Warrior Championship.' Pitched on a 'super water race,' Croque drains her glass, shouting about next season.

Meanwhile, Eunectes befriends **0429**, an assistant robot nearing the end of its service life, and tells its manager Deculture — who insisted 'robots just work' — 'You're these little guys' parent.' Deculture says that from now on she'll ask them as a friend instead of giving orders... and her first request is delivering three crates of beer and attending the representatives' meeting in her place.

Catch, on the other hand, readily agrees to the demolition, but in return he pesters Stitch to talk about the dome. When Stitch yells 'I! Don't! Give! A! Damn!', Catch asks for just some advice, then, and unrolls his own dome renovation plan...

blocks.cap: A dome like a glass tray, with yellow, green, red, and blue all clashing. Its designer is extremely pleased.

blocks.x: 'Don't you lay a single finger on that dome.' The same Stitch who said he didn't care lunges in, calling it a desecration. Pretty quick reaction for someone who isn't interested, huh?
