terms.desc: The Nightzmora warriors who followed the Khagan, the ruler of legend.

terms.name: Khaganquest
terms.desc: The Nightzmora's coming-of-age tradition. Carrying only a single weapon given by their parents, they must walk alone into unknown lands and prove their own fate.

terms.name: Silverlance Pegasus
terms.desc: Kazimierz's elite campaign knights, who guard the nation from its frontier fortresses.

blocks.x: Every few years, **Kawalerielki**, a Grand Knight Territory of Kazimierz, chooses the three fastest-growing nomadic cities and merges them with its core. The special knights' tournament held to mark that merger, the Major, is the greatest festival the nation of knights has to show.

But in this city, knights became merchandise long ago. The **General Chamber of Commerce**, which hosts the matches, holds the money and public opinion, and the **Adeptus Sprawiedliwi**, a faction of nobles and campaign knights, contends with it. Those with Oripathy found it hard to stay in the city unless they bled in the arena as knights.

Six years ago, **Margaret Nearl**, the youngest champion in the Major's history, was exiled from Kazimierz for being Infected. Now she had left Rhodes Island and come home, reclaimed the title of the Radiant Knight, and stepped into the Major once more.
"The city is a monster." It swallows people whole, yet people go on living inside its belly, grateful for what they are given.

blocks.cap: The Kazimierz National Arena. The curtain rises on the main rounds of the Major.

blocks.x: 1. The Second Day, Above and Below the City

On the evening of the second day, **McKee**, a spokesman for the General Chamber of Commerce, was reassuring **Malkiewicz**, a new spokesman who had abruptly inherited the post of the dismissed Czarny. Around the same time, **Roy**, an executive of the **Armorless Union**, the assassination organization the K.G.C.C. secretly employs, was pressing **Platinum**.

The Radiant Knight had charged into an Infected-dense district and wrecked an operation run by his fellow executive Monique, and **Szewczyk**, 'the Plastic Knight' the K.G.C.C. had been after, had vanished into the hands of the Infected. Roy said that every Infected in the territory was now their target, and that **Area 0** would soon serve its purpose.

Meanwhile, in an Infected-dense district hidden in the cracks of the city, **Sona**, leader of the Infected knights' **Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub**, spoke of being saved by the Radiant Knight. **Justyna**, a sharpshooter who had grown up on the Radiant Knight's legend, said she might be the true Radiant Knight the Infected had dreamed of. Beside them, Szewczyk, whom Justyna had spirited away, was swearing revenge.

That same day, **Amiya** and the Doctor of Rhodes Island arrived under a medical contract for the Infected. A kindly old knight assigned the fourth-order campaign knight **Gravel** as their guard, and on a giant screen outside the window, Amiya saw the face of Nearl, who had left Rhodes Island.

And in the Nearl family home, its furniture sold off, Margaret's younger sister **Maria** found blast marks on her sister's weapon. Recalling the lights of the Infected glimmering underground, Margaret said that no one should be treated as a plaything because they are sick.

Around the same time, in another room, their uncle **Młynar** was turning away the Sarkaz bounty hunter **Toland**. Toland had tried to draw Młynar in by pointing to how he had protected the Nearl sisters; he withdrew, saying it was hopeless.

blocks.cap: The Nearl family living room, its furniture sold off piece by piece.

blocks.x: 2. The Knight Who Died in Capture the Flag

Meanwhile, at the bar where old knights close to the Nearl family gather, Margaret and Maria's aunt **Zofia** heard that Młynar had lost his duel with the returned Margaret without using his Arts even once. Zofia said that was not throwing the fight. It was looking down on the Radiant Knight.

Then, in a game of capture the flag, an Infected knight of the Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub was surrounded by 'Brassrust' Olmer Ingra and a band of noble knights. The crowd shouted to keep the Infected on his feet to the very end, and when 'Wild Mane' **Iwona** came down from the Infected seating, a cry went up that the Infected were attacking citizens.

Cornered, the Infected knight summoned his wind Arts, but the moment Ingra's axe came down, the wind stopped. Security staff sealed him, still breathing, inside a containment box to prevent infection, and he asked Iwona to look after his wife and daughter.
Remember their faces... every one of them! Don't let a single one get away...!

blocks.cap: The stands, chanting Ingra's name.

blocks.x: That evening, the news reported that he had concealed his condition, used his Arts, and died of shock. His name was Jamie. Infected in an accident and divorced afterward, he had paid off the association to keep his illness hidden so he could go on competing, and every morning he had looked after the children of his district.
Sona was left speechless that a man who had lived so earnestly ended with a grudge that cut to the bone. Iwona said she would become strong enough to break the hypocrites.
Watching the same news, Maria heard the Infected's Arts called 'unfair,' and remembered what her uncle had said.
Surmounting the rulesetters within their own rules? Lunatic ravings.
3. The Knight from the Grasslands, the Candle of Leithanien

Some time later, an eccentric newcomer who sang in an ancient tongue, **the Nightmare Knight**, appeared at the bar. He addressed the old knight **Vogelweide** by his old name, 'Batbayar,' and said he had come in search of a kinsman; then, disappointed, he left with only the words that he was looking for the Radiant Knight. Vogelweide muttered that he might be one of the **Nightzmora**, the Kuranta clan of legend.

blocks.cap: The bar where the Nearl family's old comrades gather.

blocks.x: Meanwhile, Margaret defeated 'Left-hand' Tytus. Tytus, who had been set on a rematch, had to admit it had not been a contest between equals, but a challenge to the one at the summit.
Outside the arena, the one who led her away from the reporters crowding around her was her next opponent, a popular Grand Knight from Leithanien: **the Candle Knight**, Viviana Droste.

When Margaret said that chivalry had become a legacy pushed around by capital, Viviana answered that Margaret seemed a true knight, but still only a knight. And she warned that a storm would soon break.

The K.G.C.C., meanwhile, did not want the Radiant Knight to keep winning. When McKee asked for her cooperation, Viviana refused, saying she wanted a fair fight, and told McKee she was disappointed that he had sided with the K.G.C.C.
I simply wish to witness, in this age, a knight's radiance. True radiance.
4. The Great Separation, Once More

Meanwhile, the Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub was digging into the **Great Kawalerielki Separation** of three years earlier, the incident in which the core power reactor failed on the eve of the Major and the territory's sectors broke away.

Around then, Iwona, guarding a district alone, was targeted by **Monique**, an executive of the Armorless Union, and Toland stepped in to save her. Monique called him the 'Guildmaster' of a bounty hunter organization with a price on its head.

And the plan the knightclub settled on was to cause the Great Separation all over again. 'Ashlock' **Greynuty** would strike the power center the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi had deliberately left unguarded and cut the power, and while Iwona drew the Armorless Union's attention, Sona would infiltrate the K.G.C.C. building. If they handed the truth about Area 0 and the Armorless Union's roster to the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi, the Infected would gain legal status.

Toland, who had been eavesdropping, handed over the blueprints of the K.G.C.C. building. He said he had watched villages driven by taxes and Catastrophes rob and kill one another, and that he wanted to see that building fall.

blocks.cap: An Infected-dense district hidden in the cracks of the city.

blocks.x: Around the same time, Amiya, working at the Infected treatment center, noticed something strange. The only people who came in for treatment were 'knights,' and the other areas of the platform were closed off entirely.

And the old knight who had assigned Gravel told her that the Armorless Union had begun moving to sweep away the Infected, and that the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi would back the Radiant Knight's victory with everything it had.
5. When the Candle Hides the Sun

At last, the Candle Knight and the Radiant Knight met. Before the match, Viviana confided that she was the illegitimate child of a great Leithanian noble, that she had lived hidden in a tower and read tales of knights by the candles her mother secretly brought her. The knight's path she had chosen to survive after being sent to Kazimierz had disappointed her, she said, for all it asked was winning and popularity.
Asked what she had wanted to do as a knight, Margaret gave back the very words she had once said to her sister.
To be a knight is to be the noble light that illuminates the land.

Viviana said most people are only small candles, barely lighting what lies in front of them. Calling her by name for the first time, Margaret answered that fate is not decided by birth, and that she was an outstanding knight.

At that moment, Maria was being held by Platinum. Told that everyone would be better off if her sister just lost, Maria said only that her sister would not lose, and Iwona and Toland, come to strike at the Armorless Union, got her out. The killers who stormed the bar in pursuit of Maria were stopped by Marcin, the bar's owner, by the old knights, and by Zofia.

In the arena, meanwhile, each time the candle went out, Viviana's shadow swallowed the light. Amid commentary asking whether they meant to dance, the light scattered in every direction and, like the morning sun, reached out toward the candle's darkness. That night, Kawalerielki was as bright as day.

blocks.cap: A candle and the shadows around it. Viviana, the Candle Knight.

blocks.x: At last, Margaret's blow cut the candle-sword in half, and Viviana, conceding defeat, asked her to show how far she would go from here. After the match, she told McKee that the Radiant Knight, seen in person for the first time in six years, had been like the sun rising high into the sky.
6. The Man on the Bench, the Beautiful Slaughterhouse

Meanwhile, Malkiewicz filed charges against Ingra with the National Council, but the associate justice set a condition: he would deal with Ingra if the dismissed Czarny were silenced for good. In the meantime, a ruling found that Jamie had died of Oripathy, and Ingra returned to the arena.

In the end, Malkiewicz promised to silence Czarny but told the man not to ask how. Then he asked who he thought held command of the Armorless Union now, and hung up. Seeing that smile, McKee murmured.
Authority is always sweet. Wouldn't you agree, Malkiewicz?

That night, the Armorless Union, led by Roy, set out to purge the Infected. Three hundred gold for each illegal Infected. But on a bench in the empty street sat Młynar, and just as Roy was about to give the signal, the white-horned Sarkaz **Shining** appeared, and Roy withdrew.

blocks.cap: The night of the purge. Three people on a single bench.

blocks.x: Młynar told Shining she should have stopped Margaret. When she offered to tell him what Margaret had been through, he said he knew from her eyes alone; Margaret's parents, and he himself once, had carried such a shining age within them. Then he told her to leave this territory as soon as she could.
And the Infected knight Shining had saved told her that Infected who were hurt and could no longer work were sent to Area 0, and disappeared.
That place is a beautiful slaughterhouse, Sarkaz.
7. The Arrow That Fell from the Sky

After the Radiant Knight's victory, violent incidents involving the Infected followed one after another, and protesters took to the streets demanding the Infected be driven out. A protesting knight, once a fan, snapped that Margaret had planted false hopes in the Infected.

That night, Margaret walked the night streets with Shining and **Nightingale**. At the sound of singing drifting from a bar, she took Nightingale's hand and danced, and promised that on the day Nightingale could truly dance, she would be by her side.

blocks.cap: The knight, holding the Sarkaz's hand, passes beneath a faint light.

blocks.x: At the end of that road, Roy and Monique were waiting. Roy said the Armorless Union meant to break free of the K.G.C.C.'s control, and offered a deal: if she did not get in their way, they would not get in the way of her victory. At that moment a black arrow as large as a lance fell from the sky. Margaret and Shining struck it aside together, but could not break it.
Monique said there were three of the **Darksteel** like that, and vanished.

Around then, McKee reported that several managing directors had ordered Rhodes Island investigated and 'dealt with,' and that he had recommended Malkiewicz to take charge of it. Command of Platinum passed to Malkiewicz as well.

Around the same time, Gravel confided to the Doctor that she had been sold as a slave and raised to die for others. The Doctor answered that if she thought something worth sacrificing for, she should survive all the more. She was free.
8. Kawalerielki Sleeps

The night of the operation. Iwona raided an Armorless Union patrol, but lost contact with Justyna, and from the top of a building Monique descended without a sound. When Monique told her to run, Iwona remembered Jamie's last words and stood her ground.

blocks.cap: "Do I look like the kind who runs?"

blocks.x: Monique brought Iwona down and demanded the lives of the remaining Infected knights, and Toland stepped in to hold Monique off. Just before Greynuty could hit the power center, someone struck the power reactor first.
Somewhere, Roy whispered, "Now sleep, Kawalerielki," and every light in the city went out.
In that darkness, Iwona had fallen in a pool of blood and risen again to throw herself at the killers. Heavy footsteps approached her. Someone said it was enough now, that she had done very well.

Meanwhile, Sona, having slipped into the K.G.C.C. building, obtained the files on Area 0 and the Armorless Union with suspicious ease. In a dark conference room a phone rang, and the voice on the other end said she could take the rest as long as she handed over the Armorless Union files. Instead of answering, Sona leapt out the window.

blocks.cap: A phone rings in the middle of an empty conference room.

blocks.x: Greynuty caught her, but Roy gave chase. Fleeing, saying she was sick of being ruled by others, Sona blocked a blue arrow and fell into the gap between sectors. Greynuty fooled Roy by feigning rage and got away.

blocks.cap: Sona, struck by a blue arrow, falling into the gap between sectors.

blocks.x: 9. The Night the Silver Lances Came
The one who caught the falling Sona was Viviana. In the instant she blocked the arrow, Sona had slipped the chip into Greynuty's pocket. Viviana took her to the Wall of Champions exhibition hall.

The old knight waiting there, the one who had assigned Gravel to Rhodes Island, was **Ioleta Russell**, Grandmaster of the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi. She promised to give the Infected legal status, yet said the Originium crystals growing on Sona's body were a murkier matter.
Go, and see whether the morning sun of Kazimierz still burns hot.

Around then, a silver light rose in the darkness. Some forty knights of the campaign knight order **Silverlance Pegasus** entered the city on a forced march, concealing who they were, and Roy told the entire Armorless Union to do nothing for now.

blocks.cap: Through streets called the city of knights, knights from the frontier fortresses pass by.

blocks.x: Meanwhile, McKee, about to lodge a protest, was told that Associate Justice Duke had been detained on charges including bribery and murder. When communications came back, Malkiewicz said the telephone was the great symbol of modern society, and McKee sensed an unfamiliar force in him.

That night, having heard from Shining what Area 0 truly was, the Doctor said they would solve their problem by their own methods, with neither violence nor money. Malkiewicz, arriving at dawn, admitted that the K.G.C.C. had chosen 'humane disposal' for the irrecoverably injured and for Infected whose condition had worsened.

The next day, McKee said that the three Darksteel had disappeared and that several K.G.C.C. executives had been assassinated during the blackout. Every clue pointed to the Infected, but it was the Armorless Union that had betrayed them.
10. The Last Kheshig

That night, the Radiant Knight faced the Nightmare Knight. The commentary introduced the Nightmare Knight as the last **Kheshig** from the grasslands, **Tola**. Tola said he hoped that she would be the meaning of his **Khaganquest**, the solitary walk the Nightzmora take upon coming of age.

When he unleashed the terror carved into his blood, the stands held their breath, and the judges forcibly ended the match, ruling that his Arts had affected the crowd and the officials. When the two would not stop, a massive axe drove into the ground between them. It belonged to the champion of the previous Major, the hero of the Infected: **the Blood Knight**, Dikaiopolis.

The match was declared a draw, and Margaret's arm was badly injured. Robbed of his duel, Tola went looking for Margaret and came face to face with Maria. Even when told that her dream was borrowed and that she was not even a knight, Maria raised her sword and stood in his way.

blocks.cap: The memory of the day she raised her sword to the cheers. Something was missing.

blocks.x: When Vogelweide cut in with an arrow and asked where his Khagan was, Tola answered that from the moment his mother died to a beast's fangs, he had made this path his last dream.

Blood running down her face, Maria did not back down. Right now, she said, she was not a knight; she only wanted to protect her sister. For a moment her blood looked golden in Tola's eyes, and he turned away, saying he would put off the duel.
Around then, Platinum came for the Doctor with orders to eliminate Rhodes Island. When Gravel moved to block her, the Doctor instead stepped in front of Gravel.

blocks.cap: "The Armorless Union doesn't have a monopoly on killers, you know."

blocks.x: The Doctor pointed out that the order came not from the board but from a handful of managing directors, and revealed that, with Malkiewicz's help, Rhodes Island had already become a provisional member organization of the K.G.C.C. A call soon came ordering Platinum to withdraw, and to halt the 'disposal' at Area 0 as well.
On her way back, Platinum got hold of the Radiant Knight's real medical examination report, and could not believe her eyes.
11. I Am My Own Khagan

Then, in the semifinal, when Tola asked what he fought for, the Blood Knight answered: survival. Faced with the question of where his own Khagan was, Tola, who had lost his family and his people, hummed an old song.
I am my own Khagan!

blocks.cap: A banner and an army rising from black mist. Tola's obsession.

blocks.x: The Blood Knight saw that the army was nothing but a young man bent on destroying himself. Deliberately smearing his own blood on his opponent's weapon, he cleared the mist with a single counterattack, and chants of 'Blood Knight' erupted from the Infected seats.

At the same moment, Monique, who had been targeting the Doctor and Amiya, made a wager with Shining: if Shining could withstand three shots, she would withdraw. Before the last shot, Shining revealed a light that divided day from night, and Monique withdrew as promised.

After the Wind Knight forfeited, Margaret also advanced to the final. Szewczyk, reunited with his family, said he would leave for another city, and advised the Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub not to stand against the city.

At the Nearl home, Młynar rebuked Margaret: her greatest mistake was deciding the course of other people's lives for them. When Margaret asked whether she had stolen Maria's dream, Maria, who had given her own entry to her sister, confessed she no longer knew what it meant to become a knight now.

Margaret said there was no meaning in winning. The meaning lay with those who watched. A knight's work, she said, was to teach everyone who did not want to live only as they were told how to overcome hardship.
Waking from his injuries, Tola said he would leave for the far north. Vogelweide asked whether he wanted to die, but no answer came.
12. The Lighthouse and Survival

Years earlier, the Blood Knight had drifted from one underground arena to the next, hiding his infection, until Spokesman Czarny noticed him. Czarny created the Crimson Chalice Knightclub for him, and the system he proposed for Infected participation in the Major went before the board. The Blood Knight took Infected with nowhere else to go into his knightclub, and told the K.G.C.C. that he alone would be enough.

Just before the final, he called the Radiant Knight 'a magnificent failure.' She had fought for her convictions, yet she had been exiled and had dragged her family into it. Had she ever protected even a single person?

The final of the 24th Major. Removing his helmet, the Blood Knight said that Margaret had wanted to be a lighthouse. But she had taught the weak how to break down walls of stone, never how to build a new home, he said, and raised his axe.

Around then, Ioleta told Liam of the Silverlance Pegasus about the Nearl family motto. Margaret's grandfather, Kirill Nearl, had plunged into a swamp with only seven knights to rescue besieged comrades, and forty-one came back. Of the seven, only Kirill and Ioleta returned alive.
At the same moment, outside the arena, Platinum, leading thirty members of the Armorless Union, ran into seven of the Silverlance Pegasus.

blocks.cap: "Three of us will suffice."

blocks.x: In the arena, meanwhile, Margaret brought the Blood Knight to his knees, and as he rose again, he felt a pain deep within his body. The pain of the disease, and its limit.

At last, both their weapons shattered together. The Blood Knight said he had never enjoyed a match so much, and thought of his home in Minos. The Infected fight only to survive, he said, and asked what Margaret had been through.
Margaret answered that she had seen cities crumble to Catastrophes and parents sell their children, but because she had also seen people press on through such hardship, she was not alone.
Margaret Nearl! My family motto: "Fear neither hardship nor darkness!"

blocks.cap: Light and blood. The final blow of two champions who have lost their weapons.

blocks.x: Somewhere outside the arena, Tola's horn sounded. A salute: the hero had already risen.

Asked whether she would stay in Kazimierz and keep the lighthouse burning, Margaret answered that she would never run again. After the final blow, the Blood Knight told her she had won, and Margaret, holding him up as he collapsed, said there was no loser here.
13. The Walk to the Wall of Champions
When the victory was declared, the commentator Mob relayed 'astonishing news' from the K.G.C.C.: the exile six years ago had been a conspiracy by criminals who had bought off the Knights Association.
The Radiant Knight! Our champion! Is not! Infected!
The champion who had defeated the hero of the Infected was not Infected. In the stands, the Infected knights called the Radiant Knight a traitor.

Marcin, the bar's owner, who was in the stands, revealed that Grandfather Nearl had deliberately sent his hot-blooded granddaughter away to protect her. Margaret herself had realized it not long after leaving, and the Doctor had told her before she left Rhodes Island that something like this might happen.

Taking advantage of the chaos, the Armorless Union went after Maria and Zofia, but Shining and Amiya stopped them. Outside the arena, Młynar held his sword to Roy's throat and told him that whether a Nearl is a knight was not for them to decide.

The Blood Knight said the K.G.C.C. had made Margaret out to be a woman without loyalty. Even so, Margaret said that avoiding the ceremony would only be running away, and, holding the Blood Knight up, walked with him to the Wall of Champions.
When the Armorless Union blocked their way, an arrow struck the ground between them. It was Sona and the Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub.

Sona said they were only passing through the city, but that it was a great thing. Szewczyk held Platinum back, Maria, Zofia and the old knights faced the killers, and Viviana, candle in hand, stood in McKee's way.

Then the Silverlance Pegasus marched in. Hearing Margaret's answer once more, that what a soldier carries out is duty, not justice, Liam said that carrying the Infected through the city was beyond him. Then he ordered the two knights escorted to the Wall of Champions.

blocks.cap: The Radiant Knight supporting the Blood Knight, with the silver lances guarding them.

blocks.x: Monique loosed a single shot, but what reached Margaret was not an arrow but Shining's warm hand. Waiting in the hall, Ioleta said this was Margaret's true beginning. She had only just begun to meet the great wave.
Day is breaking.
Epilogue. Entrusted to Each

The news reported that the Radiant Knight had refused the award and left. Margaret chose to stay in Kazimierz. Młynar left the territory for a time to look for the brother he had lost touch with fifteen years ago, and for the one he said had been like a jewel. What he truly wanted to find, he said, was in the end himself.
And when Sona asked why she had fought despite knowing she was not Infected, Margaret answered that she had only fought for people who suffer, and recommended Rhodes Island to her.

Meanwhile, McKee and Malkiewicz took a call from Kain, 'the Newsman,' head of the Rose Paper Union. Kain was McKee's father. He said people would soon forget the Radiant Knight and return to consumption and entertainment, and that Czarny's ouster had been nothing more than a power struggle, with an old bribery case as the pretext.
We will become the voice of this land.

Around the same time, Roy and Monique opened a hand sanitizer shop and called Platinum over. Told that the three presidents of the company that made the product would soon join the General Chamber of Commerce, Platinum understood why every director tied to the Armorless Union had died on the night of the blackout. Told that she herself had been meant to die as a scapegoat, she thought she had to run.

To the departing Doctor and Amiya, Margaret promised she would come whenever Rhodes Island called. When Shining said she would one day go to Londinium and cut ties with the past, Margaret swore that if she was needed then, the Radiant Knight would fight for them.

Three days later, Sona followed Toland to a village outside the territory. There, among the Infected and farmers, knights and laborers, fallen nobles and university students, Toland said that those the city had ignored had to join forces.

blocks.cap: A village outside the Grand Knight Territory. Day has broken.

blocks.x: Kawalerielki's lights came back on, and civilization keeps advancing. The monstrous city still swallows people today, but along the path one knight lit that night, a few have taken steps of their own.

act12side.tagline: Two old Lungmen classmates who can't stand each other stumble onto the same team in a pleasure city's survival reality show — and end up stopping a rebellion and becoming heroes they never wanted to be. In a city where only results remain, not right and wrong.

chars.name: Ch'en
chars.desc: Former Chief of the Lungmen Guard Department's Special Inspection Unit. Now a Rhodes Island Operator, she was on vacation in Siesta.

chars.name: Lin Yühsia
chars.desc: Daughter of the Rat King, who rules Lungmen's slums. Comes to Dossoles in Wei Yenwu's place · Operator Lin

chars.name: Candela
chars.desc: Mayor of Dossoles. Sends invitations to Wei Yenwu and the Rat King every year.

chars.name: Ernesto
chars.desc: Deputy director of Dossoles's International Trade Management Department. The guide Candela assigns to the pair — he also runs a weapon shop.

chars.name: Pancho
chars.desc: Guest commentator for the championship. Ernesto's father, who rose as high as colonel in the army.

chars.name: Rafaela
chars.desc: Captain of 'Grey Feather,' a team of locals. A girl who carries a huge scythe.

chars.name: Mizuki
chars.desc: The sole member of team 'Pacer-man,' who ate his way through the eating-contest prelim. A truly bottomless appetite.

chars.name: D.D.D.
chars.desc: A popular Monster Siren Records DJ invited by Candela. Face hidden, serving as the championship's special MC.

chars.name: Swire
chars.desc: Young lady of the Swire family. Now acting chief of the Special Inspection Unit Ch'en left behind.

chars.name: Hoshiguma
chars.desc: A member of the Lungmen Guard Department's Special Inspection Unit and Ch'en's old partner. Came along on Swire's vacation.

chars.name: Wei Yenwu
chars.desc: Chief of Lungmen. Hasn't accepted Candela's invitations since visiting Dossoles ten years ago.

chars.name: Fumizuki
chars.desc: Wei Yenwu's wife. Ch'en looks up to her like an aunt.

chars.name: Rat King
chars.desc: A power in Lungmen's slums and Lin Yühsia's father. Wields sand-manipulating Arts.

chars.name: Shirayuki
chars.desc: A Rhodes Island Operator who serves Fumizuki, calling her 'the Princess.'

chars.name: Sideroca
chars.desc: A Rhodes Island Operator. Stopped by Dossoles on vacation after finishing a mission in Bolívar.

terms.name: Dossoles
terms.desc: A pleasure city in northwestern Bolívar. Wrapped around an artificial sea and lined with casinos and nightlife.

terms.name: Bolívar
terms.desc: A country where three factions fight without end: the Singas dynasty backed by Leithanien, the Coalition government backed by Columbia, and the 'True Bolívarians.'

terms.name: Dossoles Warrior Champion
terms.desc: The reality show Dossoles stages across the entire city every summer. The winner gets to press the button that opens and closes the artificial sea's floodgates.

terms.name: LUNG wRATh
terms.desc: The name Ch'en came up with on the spot for the team of Ch'en, Lin Yühsia, and Ernesto.

terms.name: True Bolívarians
terms.desc: A resistance movement sworn to drive out both the Coalition government and the Singas dynasty and make Bolívar an independent nation.

blocks.x: The Coalition government, the Singas dynasty, and the 'True Bolívarians.' In **Bolívar**, a country where the three-way war never ends, there's one city that knows nothing of war. A pleasure city wrapped around an artificial sea, with casinos and bars stretching on forever — where, they say, two suns rise, one in the sky and one in the sea. Welcome to **Dossoles**.

blocks.cap: One in the sky, one in the sea. Dossoles, the city of two suns.

blocks.x: At the prelims for that city's summer championship, two people who never even signed up came out of a free-for-all as the last ones standing. One was **Ch'en**, former Chief of the Lungmen Guard Department's Special Inspection Unit. The other was **Lin Yühsia**, daughter of the Rat King who rules Lungmen's slums.
When the MC praised their 'flawless teamwork,' Ch'en just sighed: "I sure hope not." "Ugh... how did this happen?"
1. One Invitation, Two Stand-Ins

It all started in Lungmen. Every year, Dossoles's mayor **Candela Sanchez** sends invitations to Lungmen's Chief **Wei Yenwu** and to the **Rat King**. The Rat King's position: if Wei isn't going, neither is he. So Lin Yühsia, standing beside him, was about to toss the invitation in the trash.
That's when Wei's wife, **Fumizuki**, called with a suggestion: send Yühsia in her husband's place. Her father said it was still too early for that, but Lin wouldn't budge. "I am going."

blocks.cap: Lungmen. Once again this year, an invitation from Dossoles lands on the Rat King's desk.

blocks.x: As it happens, the person Fumizuki really wanted to send was Ch'en, who'd left for Rhodes Island. Wei fretted about Candela — "Hui-chieh and Yühsia are still far too young to handle her" — but in the end he left it to his wife.

Around then, Ch'en was vacationing in Siesta when Operator **Shirayuki** showed up with a letter from Fumizuki. The request: go enjoy Dossoles in the Weis' place. Unable to turn down her beloved 'auntie,' Ch'en set off on a two-week journey.
2. What Are You Doing Here?!

The moment Ch'en reached Dossoles, bodyguards whisked her aboard the mayor's ship. Candela greeted her in fluent Yanese, laughed that she looked just like Chief Wei in his younger days, and let slip that Wei had sent a separate representative to save face.

blocks.cap: The reception room aboard the ship, where Candela receives her guests.

blocks.x: Soon the door opened, and a polite voice announced it had come on behalf of Chief Wei Yenwu. Then Ch'en and Lin shouted in perfect unison: **"What are you doing here?!"**
Ch'en said they were just old classmates. Lin made it crystal clear: "She's a friend of a friend. We barely know each other."

Candela launched into a sales pitch for her city. The artificial sea needs its water changed twice a year, and she'd turned that tedious chore into a citywide reality show: the **Dossoles Warrior Champion**. The winner gets the honor of pressing the floodgate button.
The statue on the ship's prow? "Just my own little addition," apparently. Lin's verdict: "So you turned something that used to be trouble into a huge event..."

But Candela had a 'special entertainment' lined up, too. She'd recently cut off a smuggling route for explosives and Originium circuits — so if they got bored, they were welcome to amuse themselves by figuring out who was plotting what ahead of the championship. She assigned them a guide, **Ernesto**, deputy director of the International Trade Management Department, and even handed them a card with no spending limit.
Left alone, the two muddled through some awkward catching-up before Ch'en asked, "Why are you helping him?" Lin never answered.
3. Went to Wreck a Casino, Won a Prelim

One day Lin vanished first thing in the morning, so Ch'en wandered the streets alone. Bars and casinos everywhere, and she sent off everyone who approached her with a flat "Piss. Off." Then, from a TV in a shop window, she heard that the last prelim — the 'Smash Splash' free-for-all — was about to begin.

blocks.cap: "After ten days of fierce competition, the prelims come to a close today!"

blocks.x: Figuring anyone targeting the tournament would pose as a contestant, Ch'en called Ernesto — and heard battle cries on the other end. "Long story short, Miss Lin is having trouble making friends."

At that very moment, Lin was storming a casino she'd picked because cleaning up after it wouldn't cause much fuss. When the owner dealt himself four of a kind off the bottom of the deck, she answered with a straight flush and one line — "You're awful at palming cards." In the brawl that followed, the owner and his gang turned tail and ran.

Of all places, the gang ducked into the Smash Splash venue. Lin chased them in, Ch'en followed, both got swept into the brawl — and both ended up the last ones standing. Guest commentator **Pancho** gave them his blessing: "It isn't so bad for something like this to happen once in a while."

Add Ernesto, and they had a team of three. When Lin told Ch'en to pick a name, Ch'en came up with **LUNG wRATh**. Lin's response: "...I'll remember this." Pancho, who handed out the awards, turned out to be Ernesto's father — and the prize for clearing the prelims was a solid gold statue.

Two tourists nearly dropped their ice cream at the sight: **Swire** and **Hoshiguma**, who'd burned through all their leave to sneak off on vacation. While Hoshiguma howled with laughter — "LUNG wRATh! Haaa ha ha!" — Swire decided to wait until the pair got eliminated, then pop up and tease them to her heart's content.
4. Winning Isn't Enough

According to Ernesto, soldiering is the best-paying job in Bolívar, which is why this pricey city is full of soldiers. His father Pancho made it all the way to colonel, too, but he refused to flatter his superiors, got framed, and was drummed out.
First impressions of the city — Ch'en: "Corrupt." Lin: "Stinks to high heaven." For once, they agreed.

Next stop: Ernesto's weapon shop, where Ch'en traded her sword for a high-pressure water gun that fires water bombs and got briefed on the rules. Three rounds — a gold hunt, a triathlon, and survival aboard a cruise ship. No comms allowed. And after every round, an audience vote can knock out any team 'unworthy of winning.'

blocks.cap: Round 1's stage: a residential district emptied of residents. The city rebuilds any house that gets wrecked, so some residents actually ask for theirs to be smashed.

blocks.x: Once the briefing was over, Ch'en turned to Lin: "I've been putting up with you forever. I think you've been putting up with me forever." Time to settle it with a fight. Ernesto could only sigh.
5. Round 1: Split Up, Same Alley

At the opening ceremony, Candela declared, "It doesn't matter who you are. You've made it here, so let all that fall away" — this city, she proclaimed, was the paradise she'd built. On the mic: masked superstar DJ **D.D.D.**

Also competing: 'Pacer-man,' a one-man team consisting solely of the big eater **Mizuki**, and 'Grey Feather,' a team of locals led by **Rafaela**, a girl with a huge scythe. As for LUNG wRATh's captain, the job fell to Ernesto, since the other two refused to listen to each other.

Right off the bat they were surrounded by three teams — until Lin stroked a windowpane and the glass melted into a transparent blade. Like the Rat King, she wields sand-manipulating Arts, and her specialty is turning sand into glass.

The problem was teamwork. Pancho pointed out that they weren't in sync, and Swire giggled that they'd nearly taken each other out several times already. In the end, the two agreed to split up and regroup every hour.

Searching the cameras' blind spots on her own, Lin overheard Grey Feather planting bombs in the residential district. "Hermano told us not to take on what we can't handle." Lin pocketed one of the bombs — and told no one.
Meanwhile, Ch'en, moving with Ernesto, spotted Mizuki surrounded in an alley. Ernesto warned that nobody helps anybody in this competition. "I know," said Ch'en — and jumped right in.

blocks.cap: Ch'en stands in the middle of the alley. The sound of a falling drop of water signals the start of the melee.

blocks.x: Up on the roof, Lin muttered, "There she is, playing the hero again" — but she hopped down anyway and blocked the other teams closing in. When Mizuki asked why Ch'en had helped, she said, "No reason. I saw you, so I helped." Mizuki replied, "You're a nice person, Miss," and handed over the gold.

Round 1 ended once all twenty pieces of gold had been turned in. When Ernesto asked whether they'd found any leads, Lin said, "Not on my end" — then told Ch'en she had something to discuss with her privately.

blocks.cap: Round 1 results. 'LUNG wRATh' on the top line — that's our team.

blocks.x: 6. A Fist Between Whiskey and Soda Water

The place Lin took Ch'en was the very casino bar she'd turned upside down on prelim day — now her turf, where the owner calls her 'boss.' Over whiskey and soda water, Lin brought up Grey Feather's bombs, and the two came to suspect Ernesto of tampering with the smuggling intel along the way.

blocks.cap: The casino bar that became Lin's new turf.

blocks.x: But when Ch'en wanted to tell Candela, Lin stopped her. Was a mayor who lets everything slide even worth helping? She was only acting to protect Chief Wei's reputation, she said — what actually worried her was Ch'en's overflowing sense of justice.

"Stop faking all those feelings for people you've never even met." Ch'en's fist stopped right in front of Lin's face, and Lin clamped her hand around it. The owner, watching, was already tallying up everything he'd sunk into the place.
"One day, I will make sure you pay for all that you've done." "And how will you do that?" "With righteousness."
Well, at least that has a slightly better ring to it than justice. If that day ever comes, I will be ready and accept my punishment.

Meanwhile, at Ernesto's weapon shop, closed for the night, a visitor gave the password and walked in: Rafaela. It was Ernesto who'd disguised their operation as ordinary weapons smuggling to fool Candela, and of the twelve teams of comrades they'd planted as contestants, nine had made it to Round 2.

He said he wouldn't deal with the two outsiders. The cost would be too high — and above all, they were 'good people.' Instead, he'd make sure they never got aboard the ship and anywhere near 'Father.'

Ernesto also told the story behind the city's name. 'Dossoles' — two suns, the one in the sky and the one reflected in the sea. But it almost became 'Tressoles,' the City of Three Suns. The third sun? The golden statue on Pancho's ship.
"But you enjoy living here." Ernesto answered Rafaela with a question of his own: "If that's the case, why would I help Father?"
7. Round 2: A Collapsed Shop, One Bicycle, and Other People's Heads

Two days later, the triathlon kicked off. A beach marathon, a cycling loop around the city, then a swim out to a cruise ship at sea — only the first eight teams to reach it survive. Pancho had already boarded the ship to prepare for Round 3. And in the stands sat Rhodes Island's **Sideroca** and her companions, in town on vacation.

On the cycling leg, the other teams didn't fight — they just crowded in close to get in the way, herding LUNG wRATh toward a shortcut where the mayor's crack troops lay in ambush. Both of them knew they were being herded, and went in anyway.

blocks.cap: The cycling leg. You can't throw punches from a moving bicycle.

blocks.x: When the ambush hit, Ernesto said he'd hold them off and tossed over a key — there was a faster passage under his weapon shop. But the moment the two stepped inside, the whole shop blew up.

Trapped in the rubble, their way out was in Lin's bag. Candela had left the bombs alone — investigating now would only tip the plotters off — but Lin had sent her underlings in, disguised as thieves, to steal the bombs from the residential district.
"I have always deeply respected you and the Rat King. ...Just don't let me catch you enjoying yourself." Lin shot back, "Nobody goes looking for trouble as a hobby."
A second explosion, and out they walked — but only one bicycle was left. Ch'en told Lin to go on ahead. Lin's answer was two words: "Hop on."

With Lin pedaling and Ch'en shooting down troublemakers from the back, the broadcast booth gushed over their perfect teamwork. Never mind that when Ch'en shoved Lin's head down to dodge a flying wheel, Lin snapped her head right back up into Ch'en's face. "Oops. Accident."

On the swimming leg, Lin sent Ch'en into the water first, then ran across the sea on glass stepping stones made from sand. Whenever she didn't feel like wasting a stepping stone, she used a nearby contestant's head instead — and her very first stepping stone was Ch'en.

Hopping across the leaders' heads too, Lin reached the cruise ship in first place. Meanwhile, Ernesto, who'd been knocked flat, couldn't help laughing — that had to be cheating — and muttered, "What do I do now?"
8. Confessions on the Cruise Ship

A cabin aboard the cruise ship. His adopted daughter Rafaela reported that everything was ready, but Pancho took no joy in it. If things went wrong, she was to get away with Ernesto. If Pugh — the comrade who had entrusted his daughter to him — learned of this, he said, he would claw his way out of the grave.

blocks.cap: The cruise ship's cabin. Pancho asks for his pipe and stays behind alone.

blocks.x: On the same ship, Ernesto met Ch'en. He admitted who he was without resistance and told her Bolívar's history. A country that had been a dependency of Iberia, then of Leithanien, before sinking into an endless war among three factions. Dossoles, he said, was a prosperity built on top of that suffering.
The goal was not to destroy the city, only to sow fear — so she should simply stay out of it. Ch'en answered:
There is no justice in spreading terror.

Ch'en went a step further. Trapping the two of them in the weapon shop, knowing full well it would expose him, was too forced. Which meant Ernesto was not the ringleader. He was the bait, there to draw their eyes. Instead of denying it, Ernesto turned on the TV.

On the screen was Pancho. Ten years ago he had fought for the 'True Bolívarians' and led three thousand of his brothers to their deaths; had his own brother not given his life, he would have been shot as well. None of the factions had ever meant to save this country, he said — and Candela was more hopeless than any of them.
If no one else will save this country, I will.

Soon explosions went off in the Round 1 residential district, and unidentified forces appeared across the city. When her bodyguard urged her to evacuate, Candela did not move. "I have the front row seat here." She had people evacuated, but ordered the broadcast to keep running.

In the broadcast that followed, Candela announced that Pancho had made the championship more thrilling than ever — it had "reached its true climax." She reinstated every team and called on them to stop those causing the chaos.
9. LUNG wRATh

Swire and Hoshiguma had fought off assassins alongside Sideroca, and Candela seated them in the front row. She was in no hurry. Powerful figures from all three governments were being held on the ship, but she had left this to Ch'en and Lin. If anything happened to those two, she said, the dignitaries would be buried along with Pancho.

At the same moment, Ch'en, aboard the ship, had taken Ernesto down and was planning with Lin over the phone. Ch'en would stir up trouble all over the ship to draw attention, while Lin got the hostages out of the restaurant where they were being held.
Ernesto came to soon after. He saw through Ch'en's plan and sent Rafaela to the hostages, then staggered back to stand before Ch'en and told her what he truly believed.

Candela was the daughter of the previous mayor, a man who knew nothing but embezzlement. She had followed her father abroad, learned what money really means, and come back. While the resistance accomplished nothing, she used Bolívar's finest liquor, coffee, sugar, and entertainment to make even the nobles of Leithanien and Columbia play by her rules.
From a certain point of view, and all things considered, perhaps Ms. Candela loves Bolívar far more than my father does.

So he had placed a bet on this. If his father succeeded, he would keep helping him; if he failed, he would follow Candela. Ch'en said, "That's sophistry," and there was nothing left to say between them.

Around then, Lin dropped from the restaurant ceiling, took out the guards in an instant, and got the hostages out. When Rafaela arrived too late and demanded to know why she was interfering, Lin spoke to her quietly.
When it comes time for you to take over, you can't always do as they did in the past.
Then: "It's time for you to be good and go to bed now, little girl." After that, Lin's line to Ch'en went dead.

Meanwhile, on the deck, Ch'en came face to face with Pancho. However much blood this country sheds, he said, it is less than what this city drains from it in a single day. Ch'en could not argue. She understood his motive. And she, who knew neither Bolívar nor its war, had no better way to offer.
So Ch'en did not draw her sword, Chi Xiao. Chi Xiao would never accept her as she was now. As Ch'en raised her water gun and Pancho raised his anchor, a voice called up from below: "Jump, Hui-chieh."

Ch'en jumped without hesitation, and below, Lin was waiting in a boat. Moments later, a massive explosion tore through the cruise ship. Lin had remembered the bombs she still had — her 'little surprise.'

blocks.cap: The two of them in the boat, the burning cruise ship at their backs.

blocks.x: Lin held out a bottle she had taken from the ship, but Ch'en asked something else. She had heard what Lin said to Rafaela, too. "You didn't do what I think you did back then, right?"
Instead of answering, Lin said, "...We're here."
10. A Table With No Winners
The boat came ashore at the front-row seats on the beach, and there Lin spoke to Pancho. "You lost, old man."
Pancho held his men back and admitted defeat. Instead of arresting him, Candela sat him down across from her and served him a meal.

blocks.cap: Front-row seats on the beach at sunset. Candela serves the loser a meal.

blocks.x: Pancho's bitterness poured out. A plan years in the making, undone by two outsiders who happened to be invited. "Why did you, of all people, win?!"

Candela's answer was cold. He had never been up against her in the first place; he had simply failed. For all his hatred of the three governments, hadn't he accepted help from one of them? Had he come to her sooner, she might have let him fight the war he wanted.
Pancho never bowed his head. "My undertaking may not be righteous, but, at the very least, I am more righteous than you are!"
I have never once called myself righteous. ...What I care about is the meaning that this city represents.
After Pancho was taken away, Hoshiguma and Swire, who had been watching, stepped forward. Ch'en asked Candela: hadn't she said no one could threaten this city as long as she was here?
The real threat is people losing their desires, never to seek enjoyment again.
Ch'en, who had spent so many years as a police officer, had no answer. As long as that remains impossible, Candela said, this city is eternal. If Dossoles falls, Tressoles will rise in its place.

Then Candela took up the microphone and announced the championship's final victors and the heroes who saved the city: Ch'en Hui-chieh and Lin Yühsia, from Lungmen. She did not forget to thank Pancho, either, "for taking it upon himself to give us such a grand performance."
Epilogue: The Waves Roll On

The next day, the city was as loud as ever. D.D.D. remarked that the whole affair had been successfully watered down and called Candela a frightening woman. Mizuki decided the people here were boring, and set out to learn where Ch'en would go next.
Ch'en, for her part, called yesterday's victory "the one honor I never wanted in my entire life." Then she went to that bar to find Lin, and each told the other, "I learned something this time."
Lin said she had understood why Fumizuki sent her the moment she saw Ch'en. Asked whether that made her angry, she said, "This is an opportunity for me."
The Rat King's daughter won't necessarily become the Rat King. But that also means she could be.
"So that's why you helped him?" Lin never did answer that question from the first day. "Because I'm not like you."

On the way, they ran into Ernesto. Candela had pardoned everyone except Pancho and exiled them; in recognition of his part, she had allowed Ernesto to stay, but he had decided to leave with Rafaela. Rafaela was the daughter of Pugh, Pancho's comrade, who had died breaking him out of prison.

Ch'en told him, "I don't have the right to pass judgment on you." Ernesto said he knew no way to give Bolívar a paradise other than this city — but seeing the two of them, from another country, made him think other places might have other ways. Then he turned and walked away.
After he left, Lin murmured, "Seems a bit of a waste to just leave him like that." Ch'en replied, "I'll think about it."

Candela covered the cost of the sunken cruise ship with the pair's prize money. Sideroca, granted permission to open an office in recognition of her help, took a vacation photo of the four of them while they were all together.
And in Lungmen, coffee from Dossoles sent up its aroma from Wei Yenwu's cup. Having read Yühsia's report, Wei said the young ones probably wouldn't know what to make of Candela's goodwill.
That woman doesn't see right and wrong. Results are the only thing that matters.
Still, he admitted, the experience would do them no harm, and his wife had been right. Fumizuki then took out a photo Yühsia had sent.

blocks.cap: A souvenir photo from the Dossoles vacation.

blocks.x: "Is our little Ch'en going to come back?" "She will." "Then that's all I need."

The sun in the sky, the sun in the sea, and the golden statue that nearly became the third. Dossoles lost a cruise ship and still keeps the waves rolling. In that city, the dragon and the rat never did reach the same answer — but they shared one bicycle and one boat.

act18d3.tagline: An Ægir hunter, disguised as a wandering singer to follow a vanished comrade, confronts the bargain a starving ruined city has struck with the sea, and the truth in her own blood. Home lies behind. The path lies ahead.

chars.name: Skadi
chars.desc: An Ægir Operator of Rhodes Island. Formerly of the Abyssal Hunters.

chars.name: Gladiia
chars.desc: Captain of the Abyssal Hunters' Second Company. Believed dead, she comes and takes Specter away.

chars.name: Specter
chars.desc: A Hunter of the Abyssal Hunters' Second Company. She had lain unconscious in a Rhodes Island sickbed for years.

chars.name: José
chars.desc: An old broker who sells information in the wastes. He and Skadi go back a long way.

chars.name: Anita
chars.desc: A girl of Sal Viento. Among its taciturn inhabitants, she is unusually talkative.

chars.name: Grandma Petra
chars.desc: The oldest and most knowledgeable person in Sal Viento. Her mind drifts in and out.

chars.name: Sheetmetal
chars.desc: An inhabitant of Sal Viento. He remembers the priest's teachings better than anyone.

chars.name: Inquisitor Irene
chars.desc: A young Inquisitor of the Iberian Inquisition. She is pursuing the Ægir who has entered Sal Viento.

chars.name: High Inquisitor
chars.desc: A seasoned High Inquisitor of the Iberian Inquisition. He wears a mask and carries a lantern.

chars.name: Kal'tsit
chars.desc: A doctor of Rhodes Island. She always keeps her word.

terms.name: Sal Viento
terms.desc: A ruined city half-buried on the Iberian coast. It is said that nothing has been left there for decades.

terms.name: Abyssal Hunters
terms.desc: Ægir's elite fighting force. After the final battle, Skadi believed everyone but herself and Specter was dead.

terms.name: Sea Terror
terms.desc: Monsters that rise from the sea and attack people. They appear along the Iberian coast.

terms.name: Church of the Deep
terms.desc: A secretive religious group that worships the sea. Skadi has not one good memory attached to the name.

terms.name: Seaborn
terms.desc: Sea creatures ranked above the Sea Terrors. They speak human language.

blocks.x: A silent, strange, unfathomable outsider. That was what people said of her. Behind her back, they called her a gloomy, cold-blooded monster.

The moment one loses one's home, one becomes nothing at all. She had thought she could begin again. But the past comes riding on the shadows, seizes the legs, and drags one down into the depths of the swamp.
**Skadi**, an Ægir Operator of Rhodes Island, was one who had lost her home in that way. Then, one early morning, the home she had lost came looking for her first.
1. 2:33 A.M., a Song Aboard the Ship

In the small hours, having just filed her field report, Skadi stopped in a corridor of the ship. Singing and the smell of seawater drifted from somewhere, but the Operator beside her heard only the hum of machinery.
'A hunter is walking on seacoast way.' The language of Ægir, the melody of Ægir. This song should never have been heard aboard a ship on land.

Thinking that her comrade **Specter**, unconscious for years, had finally woken, Skadi ran for the stairs and threw open the door of the medical ward. The bed was empty. Only Specter's gold necklace lay on the floor.

The scent left behind was stronger and colder than Specter's. At the end of the corridor, Skadi came face to face with the one holding the sleeping Specter in her arms: **Gladiia**, Captain of the Abyssal Hunters' Second Company.

blocks.cap: Under the moonlight, Gladiia holds the sleeping Specter.

blocks.x: Skadi had believed they all died after fighting desperately to get the two of them out. Gladiia said she was glad Skadi still remembered the songs of Ægir, but there was not a trace of gladness on her face.
Asked where she was taking Specter, Gladiia did not answer. She had only come, she said, to let Skadi know she was taking back one of her own Hunters.
Then, with Specter in her arms, Gladiia vanished through the window into the moonlight. All she left behind was a single place name: 'Sal Viento.'
Whether it was a plea for help or a deception, there was no telling. Still, Skadi had to go.
2. Skadi the Wandering Singer
On the road in search of Sal Viento, a band of bounty hunters lay in wait for Skadi in the wastes. She brought them down, but took no lives.

Her old acquaintance **José** was there. He was the only information broker in the region who knew the name Sal Viento, and he said nothing had been left in that city for decades. Half a month earlier, a dozen or so bounty hunters had set out for it. None had come back.

José's son Juan had died without ever knowing who killed him, and it was Skadi who had brought his body back to his father. When Skadi apologized, José told her that the one who would not forgive her was not him, but herself.

blocks.cap: The wastes. The one man who knew of Sal Viento was here.

blocks.x: José took nothing for the map. Instead he handed her a harp and a red dress. No one dressed as a bounty hunter could enter an Iberian city, so from now on, she was a wandering singer.
Don't you die out there. If you must die, it ought to be beside someone you know.
3. The City That Counts

blocks.cap: Iberia, Sal Viento. A city that lost its life long ago.

blocks.x: **Sal Viento**, when she reached it, lay half-buried under dust that smelled of the sea. The people in the streets stood motionless with their eyes open. The only thing that set them apart from statues was that they breathed.
No one answered when she spoke to them. Then a child muttering 'ninety-nine' snatched Skadi's necklace and ran.

In the old tavern she chased the child into were a flimsy trap and two inhabitants who spoke in broken fragments, **Sheetmetal** and **Drywall**. When Skadi knocked them both down, a girl named **Anita** stepped forward and said she was the one who had dug the trap.
With Anita's help, Skadi recovered the necklace from the mouth of the child **Bench**, then went to see **Grandma Petra**, the oldest person in the city.

The old woman spoke of the days when she danced in a red dress, then began to scream: the seawater was alive, it had surged up, and everyone had died. Then she looked at Skadi and cried out. "Monster! You're a monster!"
Anita said that long ago, a priest from the outside had taught them that everyone in these streets was brother and sister, and that since then, the days of fighting one another had ended.
We want to survive, so we must love one another even more. For love is the inseparable bond between us.
The words sounded familiar to Skadi. Hearing that a woman had sometimes stood behind the priest, she set out for the church on the clifftop by the sea.

On the way, Anita mentioned, as if it were nothing, that she had lost her mother when a typhoon brought down their house. Skadi answered that her own home was already gone, too. When Anita asked her to sing, Skadi only said, 'Maybe.'
Anita said that whenever Skadi called her name, she would stop and wait.
4. The Ninety-Ninth Tide

Meanwhile, a man called the **Bishop** told Gladiia that Skadi had entered the city. Reminding Gladiia that she had joined them of her own will, he laughed that he looked forward to seeing whether Skadi, faced with a traitor, would trust in old bonds or drive in a blade.
Back in the city, Anita brought Skadi to her home: the old tavern where she lived with Sheetmetal, Drywall, and Bench. Sheetmetal warned Skadi not to break the rules. He would be watching.

Most people in this city had no names. The man who counted bricks was Brick. The man who lived in the house with the sheet-metal fence was Sheetmetal. Anita, who had been found beneath a picture frame, was called Woodframe. The name Anita she had taken for herself, from a girl who sang well in a story the old woman had told.

Some time later, Skadi went out in search of food and leapt alone from the cliff to the beach. Sheetmetal and Drywall, who had followed her, recited the priest's rule: no one may enter the sea until the tide has come in a hundred times. This was only the ninety-ninth.
Skadi looked over the beach and said there was nothing in the sea. A moment later, something moved beside Drywall. A stone thrown by Skadi smashed it, and she sent the two men back to the city.

blocks.cap: The beach below the church on the cliff.

blocks.x: 5. The Red Shell

That night, Anita traded a half-sewn garment for some shellfish meat. Skadi, who had seen how empty the sea was, demanded to know where this food had come from. At that moment, a cry rang out in the street: 'One hundred!'
People who had been scattered about gathered, and each drew a shell from a jar. It was what they did every time the tide had risen and fallen a hundred times.

Nearly all the shells were white. Only one was red. Whoever drew the red shell would go down to the shore at nightfall and, as the law decreed, 'go to live in the sea.' And the next morning, they said, the beach would be covered with food.

blocks.cap: On the night of the hundredth tide, people gathered before the jar.

blocks.x: Drywall, who had fallen, asked whether the shell he had drawn wasn't the red one. Sheetmetal held out a white shell and told him he had seen wrong. Between the fingers of his tightly clenched hand, a red glint showed.
When Skadi told him not to expect any blessing, Sheetmetal answered: you know nothing. At least I know where I am going.

Then a young member of the Iberian Inquisition, **Inquisitor Irene**, appeared. Calling this practice of sending people into the sea mass murder, she drew her sword. The inhabitants, who held that going to the sea was not death, were not afraid.
Then what is right? You are the Inquisitor. Tell us.
6. She Is Not a Burden

Afterward, Skadi searched the empty houses one by one, and decided to spend the night in one that was half collapsed. Anita, who had followed her, told her it was time to set down the burden she had carried for years: this comrade she kept searching for. Here, only those who set down their burdens lived long.

Skadi answered that the harder she tried not to think about those things, the more they tormented her. Once, on a night spent drinking with José, in a body that even alcohol could not touch, she had asked him this.
They all died, and I lived on. Why was I the only one who lived?
That night, José told her to look for a treasure map of her own in her dreams. Moving forward in silence, he said, was better than circling in place.
When Skadi came back from the memory, the necklace Specter had left behind was clasped in her hand. She said to Anita:
She's not a burden. She... helped me. She showed me the course to follow.
At that moment, Irene broke down the door. She had recognized Skadi as an Ægir from the start and had been tailing her, and she believed every strange thing in this city was the Ægir's doing.

blocks.cap: The Inquisitor's sword was stopped all too easily.

blocks.x: Even as the cramped house was smashed to pieces, Irene's sword never reached Skadi. She fired her hand cannon as well, but all it did was put one more hole in Skadi's dress.
Then a figure carrying a lantern appeared at the end of the street. At the sight of that light, Irene's eyes brightened.
7. Drawn by the Scent of Blood

The one with the lantern was the **High Inquisitor**, whom Irene addressed as 'Commander.' Skadi, who had said she did not want to fight, ended up facing him all the same, and each time the two clashed, buildings along the street came down.
When the dust settled, Skadi was wounded and gone. That night, when Anita found her bleeding in an empty house near the shore, Irene, who had secretly followed, stepped in as well.

At the same hour, on the coast, the High Inquisitor was counting the things crawling up out of the sea. Something was drawing them up into the city, and they were coming from the direction of the church.

Then, through the broken window of the empty house, things that might have been black flowers or might have been fish came pushing in. Irene's lantern was useless, and she had only one round left, but with trembling hands she still tried to get the other two to safety first.
Skadi told Irene to take Anita and hide inside. She would go out and draw the things away herself.
Because they came here looking for me.

blocks.cap: Creatures not of the land packed the street.

blocks.x: Skadi took a step forward.
8. Where Were You Then?
At length the street fell quiet. The monsters' remains rotted away quickly at Skadi's feet, and Irene recognized them as **Sea Terrors**.

Skadi said they had come following the scent of her blood. Irene admitted that Skadi had saved her, but said she could not regard her as a friend. Beside them, the inhabitants were picking up the scraps the Sea Terrors had left behind and swallowing them.
Are they even still human? To Irene's question, Skadi answered that all she knew was that they were struggling to live, and that wanting to live was the same for human and monster alike.
When Irene leveled her sword again, a shell came flying at her. The one who threw it was Grandma Petra.
The old woman said it was not she who was sick, but Sal Viento itself, and the Inquisitor standing before her. The people the Inquisitors had taken away in the past, she said, had never come back.
This thing you are trying to protect. Were we ever part of it?

Irene answered that the nation could only hold together if the Inquisition drew the line between right and wrong. The old woman said she had cried out for help night after night until her voice was gone, and no one had ever come. Did they only come when someone had done wrong?

When the old woman told Irene to take her away and end what remained of her life, Irene did not strike back. She said that anger was only natural, and withdrew, saying she would leave them be for now.
That night, Skadi went with Anita and the old woman. And Sheetmetal, reciting the priest's law, walked alone toward the pitch-black sea. On the way, he picked up the harp Skadi had dropped.
9. A Song in the Ruined Tavern

That night, Skadi dreamed. A dream of finding the singing again soon twisted into screams, and when she stabbed a monster that was gnawing on a person, the face that turned toward her was her own, as if in a mirror.

When she came to, Skadi was pinning Anita down. She told Anita she could kill her easily. Anita answered that she knew Skadi had no intention of doing so. Skadi said that she herself did not know that, and ran outside.

Skadi stopped at the shore on the farthest edge of the city. To Anita, who had chased after her, she said that people had died because of her. She had thought killing the greatest monster would end everything, but after she killed it, a greater problem swallowed her whole.

Anita confessed that she often sneaked out this far because she was curious about the world outside. Last night, seeing a monster clearly for the first time, her heart had pounded. And this morning, for the first time, she had felt that the weather was beautiful.
That isn't sickness. For some people, that is the very proof that they are alive.

Right after, something in the water seized Anita's leg. Trusting Skadi when she told her to close her eyes and let go, Anita was pulled back onto land, and said she wanted to hear a song. Skadi, who had taught her that a deal is a promise, said she would.

When they returned to the city, Sheetmetal was gone. Drywall, who had done nothing but stare at the sea, brought the harp to the tavern a while later. Sheetmetal had picked it up the night before, he said, told him to give it back, and left.
Saying that back home they had spoken to one another in song, but that since she left, every other voice in song had disappeared, Skadi sat down among the silent people and played the harp.

blocks.cap: The wandering singer in the red dress plays the harp in the ruined tavern.

blocks.x: A hunter is walking on seacoast way / With homeland left a mile behind, his path lies ahead / From his forebears and children, he was torn / Into the seas his lover was swept away, floating in the deep, dead
Outside the window, Irene was listening to the song. When it ended, Grandma Petra had fallen asleep with a rare look of peace, and Drywall was crying, saying seawater had gotten into his eyes.

When he asked what crying was, Skadi told him it was a feeling that flows out from somewhere deep in the body. Then the tide came rushing in, and the people poured out onto the beach, calling for 'the priest.'
10. The Priest's Breakfast
Once the tide had passed, the beach was covered with food. The priest whom the inhabitants welcomed like a brother was none other than the Bishop.

blocks.cap: The beach where the sea answered the people's plea.

blocks.x: The Bishop told Gladiia, at his side, that whether to wither along with the land or to follow the sea into a new life was a choice they made for themselves.
Skadi watched Drywall kneeling on the beach, swallowing food without pause. He was hungry. Everyone here was hungry.
When Skadi let go of her hand, Anita ran into the crowd, her eyes shining. And Skadi found Gladiia.
Skadi stabbed at her with a shell drawn from her clothes, but it left not a single mark on Gladiia's hand. Gladiia pinned Skadi to a wall and told her that Specter was, so far, safe.
A hunter chases her prey. She must not lose herself in the chase itself.
In the distance, the Bishop smiled and waved. With the inhabitants exchanging greetings with him, the beach looked like an afternoon in any ordinary Iberian town.

Meanwhile, Anita was singing the singer's song to Bench. 'With homeland left a mile behind, his path lies ahead.' Even if she sang it clumsily, she said, she would get it right if she sang it enough times.

After Gladiia left, Skadi's blood boiled as she looked down at the sea, tangled thick with Sea Terrors. There was no use running. She was a hunter, and what she had to do was turn her steps toward the hunting ground.
At last, Skadi forgave herself, and leapt into the sea full of Sea Terrors.
11. A Sentence to Let Monsters Live
Back from the sea, Skadi left the harp with Bench. This was not goodbye yet, she said. She had something to ask, and after that, she would hand it over in person.

In the meantime, the High Inquisitor had explosives planted in the mountain where the church stood. Irene said the southern half of the city could collapse, and that even if the inhabitants were beings that had to be purified, she wanted to evacuate them first.
By sentencing the monsters to live, you also sentence the citizens to die!

Irene said that the song that Ægir had sung was a song that belonged in Iberia. Asked whether she could bear that responsibility, she answered that she would. The High Inquisitor then gave her leave to carry out her duty.
Calling him 'Teacher,' Irene ran off like the wind. Left behind, the High Inquisitor thought that she still had to fail, and fall apart, a good deal more.
At the same hour, in the church on the cliff, the Bishop received Skadi. "Welcome, wandering singer."
12. The Tank Beneath the Sea

The Bishop said there was a friend who wished to meet Skadi, and added that her own friend was here as well, was she not? The stairway beneath the church's tombs ran down into the dark like the gullet of some enormous creature, and at its end lay a cave beneath the sea.

blocks.cap: Specter in the tank. She looked dead, or perhaps asleep.

blocks.x: When Skadi turned, Gladiia had already closed in on the Bishop with soundless steps. She had been destroying the Church's laboratories one after another, and Specter was now the only remaining specimen of their Originium infection experiments on the Abyssal Hunters.
Only then did Skadi understand. The Bishop belonged to the **Church of the Deep**, and the inhabitants who had gone into the sea had become Sea Terrors.
Just as Gladiia moved to finish the Bishop, something that was not the Bishop pierced her through.

blocks.cap: The thing that pierced Gladiia.

blocks.x: It was a **Seaborn**, the one the Bishop called 'Herald.' Passing by the fallen Gladiia, it spoke to Skadi.
Ishar-mla, my sister. You are we.

Their blood had flowed into the bodies of the Ægir, the Seaborn said, and when Sea Terrors fell upon the Hunters, they were trying to free the kin imprisoned within. Reading the thoughts that drifted to her along with its scent, Skadi knew it was not lying.

Her memories turned over. The patrollers who had watched over the sleeping Hunters had been waiting for those Hunters to turn into monsters. And the enormous thing she had killed in the final battle had not resisted. It had only rested a tentacle lightly on her body.

The conclusion fell on Skadi: those who had killed her mother, her grandmother, and her little sister were Ægir as well, the Church of the Deep. The long vengeance that had held her up turned hollow in an instant.
Then the Seaborn asked: when he fell asleep again before you, did you hear what he said?
Skadi knew the answer. 'The hardship we suffer is eternal.' Just before the words left her mouth, Skadi saw Gladiia rising from a pool of blood.

blocks.cap: Gladiia, rising with a hole through her chest.

blocks.x: You can't even sing. Then... you should die.
13. Hunting Each Other

The Bishop screamed at the Herald to kill the mixed-breeds. The Seaborn said it would. But when Gladiia asked whether it would kill the Bishop if she told it to, it said yes to that as well. To it, both were equally its kin.

Gladiia told it that if it wanted to kill Skadi, it would have to kill her first, and proposed that they hunt each other. The Seaborn chose that path. Pierced in its turn, it curled up and left its last words.
Ishar-mla. Live. It is good to live. Next time, other kin will find you... and they will ask you.
It folded in on itself like a withering flower, and died. Skadi realized that it, too, was nothing more than a living creature.
As the enraged Bishop shrieked, someone spoke from inside the tank. "Forgot about me, did you?"

Skadi kicked open her 'saxophone case,' revealing the greatsword and circular saw she had brought from Rhodes Island all along. She threw the saw, and a pale hand burst through the glass of the tank and caught it.
The awakened Specter laughed that she had spent far too long as a well-behaved nun, and cut down the Bishop in a single stroke. But the Bishop had already become a Seaborn.

blocks.cap: Countless tentacles burst out through the Bishop's body.

blocks.x: As his body swelled until it filled the cave, seawater flooded in, and the three Hunters raced upward toward the church.
14. Three Shooting Stars
Around then, the mountain began to shake. In the collapsing tavern, Irene lifted Grandma Petra in her arms and led the inhabitants outside.
When Irene shielded her from falling rocks with her own body, the dying old woman's hand clutched her sleeve tight. Irene did not shake it off. That song was still in her head, she murmured.

Meanwhile, in the cave, the Bishop, now a monster, writhed in an effort to keep evolving. But the moment he thought of the Seaborn, he understood. The Seaborn were not gods but simply another kind of living creature. Evolution belonged to the species, and he himself would die here and become nourishment for the sea.
It tried to flee into the cave, but the Hunters were already above it, taking aim.
This blade is for my family and my friends, whom you killed. Whether of the sea or of the land.

blocks.cap: Three shooting stars lit up the dark passage.

blocks.x: Dying, the Bishop cursed them: Ægir would surely be destroyed. Gladiia answered.
As long as I am alive, I am Ægir. And while I live, Ægir lives.
Specter said that with one killed, there were two left, but added that she was getting dizzy and could not stay awake forever.

Skadi asked whether Seaborn blood flowed in their bodies, and whether Gladiia had deliberately let the attack land in order to learn why the Seaborn sought Skadi. Gladiia said yes. Asked whether they had won the final battle, she said she did not know.
Are we Ægir's abandoned children? Gladiia answered that they were not.

blocks.cap: Three Abyssal Hunters, together again.

blocks.x: When swarms of Sea Terrors, drawn by the Bishop's corpse, came pouring in, it was **Kal'tsit** who appeared. Her Mon3tr spat a black sphere down beneath the church, the church collapsed, and the Bishop and his secrets were gone forever.
15. The One Who Stays

On the beach below the collapsed church, the High Inquisitor demanded an explanation from Kal'tsit. Kal'tsit said the Church of the Deep had already taken root in Iberia, and was using abandoned cities as footholds to come up onto land.

blocks.cap: Cities like Sal Viento lie scattered all along the Iberian coast.

blocks.x: When the High Inquisitor said the cities' glory was gone and only ruins remained, Kal'tsit replied that this was all the more reason they needed help.

Told that one of the Hunters would have to stay behind to settle the matter of Sal Viento, Specter and Gladiia both stepped forward. But Kal'tsit said she would undergo Iberia's interrogation in their place.

To Gladiia, who said prison walls were no better than sand, Kal'tsit only said not to worry. And to Skadi, who had gone out without authorization, she said that she was still doing far better than before.
There is no way to resolve your dark fate... but you can fight against it.
Epilogue. Next Time, Outside
Skadi returned to the tavern and gave Anita the harp, which Anita had kept safe.
Irene, who had been waiting, apologized for hounding her all this time. Only after realizing she could not save these people, she said, had she resolved to protect them.

Skadi answered that what Irene had done was right, and that she herself had done the same. She had asked enough questions, and once she truly knew the answers, they were nothing much. Now she knew where to go.

When Anita asked whether she would come again, Skadi promised she would, and that she would bring her comrades. The inhabitants called for Woodframe, and Anita ran off. Skadi's eyes lingered on the jar and the red shell.
Skadi called Anita's name. Just as she had promised, the girl stopped, turned around, and smiled.
If next we meet on the outside, I'll still sing for you.
And in the washroom of some ship, Gladiia rubbed at her face in the mirror. You turned hideous in the end, she told it. You should have died in the trench along with them.

blocks.cap: Gladiia before the mirror. A face waiting to become one more monster.

blocks.x: Yet if the Seaborn had sought answers from a hunter, then the Hunters still had a chance. Their gods give no revelation.
Gladiia looked into the mirror no longer. She had to seize the great golden ship, obtain the key, open the doors of the vault, and unleash the volcano.
